descriptions.Get-EtrLimits: Use the Get-EtrLimits cmdlet to show information about mail flow rule (also known as transport rule) limits in Exchange Online, as well the current usage and the largest rule IDs in terms of size and regular expression character count.
descriptions.Remove-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule: Use the Remove-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule cmdlet to remove outbound spam filter rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-EcpVirtualDirectory: Use the Remove-EcpVirtualDirectory cmdlet to remove Exchange Control Panel (ECP) virtual directories from Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers. The ECP virtual directory manages the Exchange admin center.
descriptions.Get-ManagedContentSettings: Use the Get-ManagedContentSettings cmdlet to retrieve managed content settings associated with managed folders.
descriptions.Get-UMServer: Use the Get-UMServer cmdlet to view settings that are associated with the Unified Messaging (UM) server role.
descriptions.Remove-Message: Use the Remove-Message cmdlet to delete a message from a queue on a Mailbox server or an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Set-DynamicDistributionGroup: Use the Set-DynamicDistributionGroup cmdlet to modify existing dynamic distribution groups.
descriptions.Get-AccessToCustomerDataRequest: Use the Get-AccessToCustomerDataRequest cmdlet to view Microsoft 365 Customer Lockbox requests that control access to your data by Microsoft support engineers.
descriptions.Set-ManagedContentSettings: Use the Set-ManagedContentSettings cmdlet to modify existing managed content settings for a managed folder.
descriptions.Update-FileDistributionService: Use the Update-FileDistributionService cmdlet to access the Microsoft Exchange File Distribution service to poll for offline address book (OAB), Group Metrics, and Unified Messaging (UM) configuration and data.
descriptions.New-JournalRule: Use the New-JournalRule cmdlet to create a journal rule in your organization.
descriptions.New-AutodiscoverVirtualDirectory: Use the New-AutodiscoverVirtualDirectory cmdlet to create Autodiscover virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.Disable-DistributionGroup: Use the Disable-DistributionGroup cmdlet to remove email capabilities from existing mail-enabled security groups and distribution groups.
descriptions.Get-ReportSubmissionPolicy: Use the Get-ReportSubmissionPolicy cmdlet to view the report submission policy in your cloud-based organization. The report submission policy controls most of the user reported message settings in the organization.
descriptions.Test-ClientAccessRule: > [!NOTE] > Client access rules were deprecated for all Exchange Online organizations in September 2025. For more information, see Update on Client Access Rules Deprecation in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Set-OMEConfiguration: Use the Set-OMEConfiguration cmdlet to configure Microsoft Purview Message Encryption.
descriptions.Set-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupNetwork: Use the Set-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupNetwork cmdlet to configure a network for a database availability group (DAG).
descriptions.New-InboxRule: Use the New-InboxRule cmdlet to create Inbox rules in mailboxes. Inbox rules process messages in the Inbox based on conditions and take actions such as moving a message to a specified folder or deleting a message.
descriptions.Set-SiteMailboxProvisioningPolicy: Use the Set-SiteMailboxProvisioningPolicy cmdlet to modify an existing site mailbox provisioning policy.
descriptions.Set-FilePlanPropertySubCategory: Use the Set-FilePlanPropertySubCategory cmdlet to modify file plan property subcategories.
descriptions.Get-ApplicationAccessPolicy: Use the Get-ApplicationAccessPolicy cmdlet to view the list of application access policies.
descriptions.New-AntiPhishPolicy: Use the New-AntiPhishPolicy cmdlet to create antiphish policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Disable-UMIPGateway: Use the Disable-UMIPGateway cmdlet to disable a Unified Messaging (UM) IP gateway.
descriptions.Get-ClientAccessArray: Use the Get-ClientAccessArray cmdlet to view legacy RPC Client Access arrays (load-balanced arrays of Client Access servers within a single Active Directory site) that exist in your Exchange organization.
descriptions.Set-UMMailbox: Use the Set-UMMailbox cmdlet to set the Unified Messaging (UM) properties for a user who is currently UM-enabled.
descriptions.Set-UMCallAnsweringRule: Use the Set-UMCallAnsweringRule cmdlet to change properties of an existing UM call answering rule.
descriptions.Remove-SearchDocumentFormat: Use the Remove-SearchDocumentFormat cmdlet to remove a format-specific filter from those used by Exchange search. Only filters added with New-SearchDocumentFormat can be removed.
descriptions.Remove-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy: Use the Remove-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy cmdlet to delete audit log retention policies from the Microsoft Defender portal or the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-RetentionCompliancePolicy: Use the Set-RetentionCompliancePolicy cmdlet to modify existing retention policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-ReportSubmissionRule: Use the New-ReportSubmissionRule cmdlet to create the report submission rule in your cloud-based organization. The report submission rule identifies the reporting mailbox where user reported messages are delivered.
descriptions.Set-PublicFolderMoveRequest: Use the Set-PublicFolderMoveRequest cmdlet to change a public folder move request after the move request is created. You can use the Set-PublicFolderMoveRequest cmdlet to recover from a failed move request.
descriptions.Get-FilePlanPropertyReferenceId: Use the Get-FilePlanPropertyReferenceId cmdlet to view file plan property reference IDs.
descriptions.Get-EdgeSubscription: Use the Get-EdgeSubscription cmdlet to retrieve information about Edge Subscriptions in your organization.
descriptions.Update-ComplianceCaseMember: Use the Update-ComplianceCaseMember cmdlet to replace all members of eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. To add or remove existing members, use the Add-ComplianceCaseMember and Remove-ComplianceCaseMember cmdlets.
descriptions.Remove-StoreMailbox: Use the Remove-StoreMailbox cmdlet to purge the mailbox and all of its message content from the mailbox database. This results in permanent data loss for the mailbox being purged. You can only run this cmdlet against disconnected or soft-deleted mailboxes. Running this command against an active mailbox fails, and you receive an error.
descriptions.Set-CaseHoldRule: Use the Set-CaseHoldRule cmdlet to modify existing case hold rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-X400AuthoritativeDomain: Use the New-X400AuthoritativeDomain cmdlet to create and specify the X.400 authoritative domain for the organization. The X.400 authoritative domain defines the standard fields for the namespace appended to the recipient identity for all mailboxes assigned an X.400 address.
descriptions.Get-RoleAssignmentPolicy: Use the Get-RoleAssignmentPolicy cmdlet to view existing management role assignment policies in your organization.
descriptions.Set-AuthenticationPolicy: Use the Set-AuthenticationPolicy cmdlet to modify authentication policies in your organization.
descriptions.Validate-OutboundConnector: Use the Validate-OutboundConnector cmdlet to test the settings of Outbound connectors in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Set-RemoteDomain: Use the Set-RemoteDomain cmdlet to configure a managed connection for a remote domain.
descriptions.Get-MailboxLocation: Use the Get-MailboxLocation cmdlet to view mailbox location information in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Remove-MalwareFilterPolicy: Use the Remove-MalwareFilterPolicy cmdlet to remove malware filter policies from your organization.
descriptions.Disable-ReportSubmissionRule: Use the Disable-ReportSubmissionRule cmdlet to disable the report submission rule in your cloud-based organization. The report submission rule identifies the reporting mailbox where user reported messages are delivered.
descriptions.Set-CmdletExtensionAgent: Use the Set-CmdletExtensionAgent cmdlet to modify cmdlet extension agents. To enable or disable cmdlet extension agents, use the Enable-CmdletExtensionAgent and Disable-CmdletExtensionAgent cmdlets.
descriptions.Import-JournalRuleCollection: Use the Import-JournalRuleCollection cmdlet to import journal rules from an XML file. You can import a journal rule collection you previously exported as a backup, or import rules you exported from an older version of Exchange.
descriptions.Enable-ReportSubmissionRule: Use the Enable-ReportSubmissionRule cmdlet to enable the report submission rule in your cloud-based organization. The report submission rule identifies the reporting mailbox where user reported messages are delivered.
descriptions.New-MailboxAuditLogSearch: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet will be deprecated in the cloud-based service. To access audit log data, use the Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet. For more information, see this blog post: <https://aka.ms/AuditCmdletBlog>.
descriptions.Restore-Mailbox: Use the Restore-Mailbox cmdlet to extract mailbox content from a restored database.
descriptions.Add-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin: Use the Add-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin cmdlet to add an eDiscovery Administrator in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. To replace all existing eDiscovery Administrators, use the Update-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin cmdlet.
descriptions.New-AvailabilityReportOutage: Use the New-AvailabilityReportOutage cmdlet to create an outage to add unrecorded issues to availability reporting.
descriptions.Get-VivaModuleFeatureEnablement: Use the Get-VivaModuleFeatureEnablement cmdlet to view whether or not a feature in a Viva module is enabled for a specific user or group. Whether or not the feature is enabled is referred to as the feature's "enablement state". The enablement state returned by this cmdlet is based on the access policies set by the admin.
descriptions.New-EdgeSyncServiceConfig: Use the New-EdgeSyncServiceConfig cmdlet to create edge synchronization service settings that control the general synchronization behavior shared by all EdgeSync services.
descriptions.New-CaseHoldPolicy: Use the New-CaseHoldPolicy cmdlet to create new case hold policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-RetentionPolicyTag: Use the Remove-RetentionPolicyTag cmdlet to remove a retention tag.
descriptions.Invoke-MonitoringProbe: Use the Invoke-MonitoringProbe cmdlet to run a Managed Availability probe on a selected server.
descriptions.Send-TextMessagingVerificationCode: Use the Send-TextMessagingVerificationCode cmdlet to send a text messaging verification as part of configuring text message notifications on the mailbox.
descriptions.Set-ForeignConnector: Use the Set-ForeignConnector cmdlet to modify an existing Foreign connector in the Transport service of a Mailbox server.
descriptions.Update-Recipient: Use the Update-Recipient cmdlet to add Exchange attributes to recipient objects.
descriptions.Get-DlpSiDetectionsReport: Use the Get-DlpSiDetectionsReport cmdlet to view information about data loss prevention (DLP) sensitive information type detections in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal for the last 90 days.
descriptions.New-ExoPhishSimOverrideRule: Use the New-ExoPhishSimOverrideRule cmdlet to create non-Microsoft phishing simulation override rules that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Remove-ComplianceTag: Use the Remove-ComplianceTag cmdlet to remove retention labels from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Retention labels apply retention settings to content.
descriptions.New-WebServicesVirtualDirectory: Use the New-WebServicesVirtualDirectory cmdlet to create Exchange Web Services virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.Set-User: Use the Set-User cmdlet to modify user attributes. You can use this cmdlet to modify all objects that have user accounts (for example, user mailboxes, mail users, and user accounts).
descriptions.Set-OutboundConnector: Use the Set-OutboundConnector cmdlet to modify an existing Outbound connector in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-SendConnector: Use the Get-SendConnector cmdlet to view the settings for a Send connector.
descriptions.Get-Contact: Use the Get-Contact cmdlet to view existing contact objects in your organization. This cmdlet returns contacts and mail contacts.
descriptions.Remove-DeviceTenantPolicy: Use the Remove-DeviceTenantPolicy cmdlet to remove your organization's mobile device tenant policy from Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.New-DistributionGroup: Use the New-DistributionGroup cmdlet to create distribution groups and mail-enabled security groups.
descriptions.New-ComplianceSearch: Use the New-ComplianceSearch cmdlet to create compliance searches in Exchange Server 2016 or later and in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. You use this cmdlet to define the search criteria.
descriptions.New-FilePlanPropertyCategory: Use the New-FilePlanPropertyCategory cmdlet to create file plan property categories.
descriptions.New-AcceptedDomain: Use the New-AcceptedDomain cmdlet to create an accepted domain in your organization. An accepted domain is any SMTP namespace for which an Exchange organization sends and receives email.
descriptions.Test-ActiveSyncConnectivity: Use the Test-ActiveSyncConnectivity cmdlet to test connectivity to Microsoft Exchange ActiveSync virtual directories.
descriptions.Get-RecipientPermission: Use the Get-RecipientPermission cmdlet to view information about SendAs permissions that are configured for users in a cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Test-FederationTrustCertificate: Use the Test-FederationTrustCertificate cmdlet to check the status of certificates that are used for federation on all Exchange servers.
descriptions.Test-WebServicesConnectivity: Use the Test-WebServicesConnectivity cmdlet to test client connectivity to Exchange Web Services virtual directories.
descriptions.Start-ManagedFolderAssistant: Use the Start-ManagedFolderAssistant cmdlet to immediately start messaging records management (MRM) processing of mailboxes that you specify.
descriptions.New-GlobalAddressList: Use the New-GlobalAddressList cmdlet to create a global address list (GAL).
descriptions.Set-JournalRule: Use the Set-JournalRule cmdlet to modify an existing journal rule in your organization.
descriptions.Set-MalwareFilterPolicy: Use the Set-MalwareFilterPolicy cmdlet to modify malware filter policies in your organization.
descriptions.Set-DlpEdmSchema: Use the Set-DlpEdmSchema cmdlet to modify exact data match (EDM) data loss prevention (DLP) schemas in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-ComplianceSecurityFilter: Use the New-ComplianceSecurityFilter cmdlet to create compliance security filters in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. These filters allow specified users to search only a subset of mailboxes and SharePoint or OneDrive sites in your Microsoft 365 organization.
descriptions.Get-TransportAgent: Use the Get-TransportAgent cmdlet to view the configuration of a transport agent.
descriptions.Set-UMMailboxPolicy: Use the Set-UMMailboxPolicy cmdlet to modify a Unified Messaging (UM) mailbox policy.
descriptions.Disable-UMMailbox: Use the Disable-UMMailbox cmdlet to disable Unified Messaging (UM) for UM-enabled mailboxes.
descriptions.Set-RetentionPolicyTag: Use the Set-RetentionPolicyTag cmdlet to modify the properties of a retention tag.
descriptions.Get-MailboxImportRequest: Use the Get-MailboxImportRequest cmdlet to view the detailed status of an ongoing import request that was initiated using the New-MailboxImportRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Set-LinkedUser: Use the Set-LinkedUser cmdlet to modify the properties of an existing linked user account. The Outlook Live Directory Sync (OLSync) service account is a linked user.
descriptions.Rotate-DkimSigningConfig: Use the Rotate-DkimSigningConfig cmdlet to rotate the public and private DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) signing policy keys for domains in a cloud-based organization. This cmdlet creates new DKIM keys and uses the alternate DKIM selector.
descriptions.Get-IPAllowListEntry: Use the Get-IPAllowListEntry cmdlet to view the IP address entries in the IP Allow list that's used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Get-DlpDetailReport: Use the Get-DlpDetailReport cmdlet to list details about data loss prevention (DLP) rule matches for Exchange Online, SharePoint, and OneDrive in your cloud-based organization for the last 30 days.
descriptions.Set-IntraOrganizationConnector: Use the Set-IntraOrganizationConnector cmdlet to modify an existing Intra-Organization connector between two on-premises Exchange forests in an organization, between an on-premises Exchange organization and an Exchange Online organization or between two Exchange Online organizations.
descriptions.Get-Message: Use the Get-Message cmdlet to view the details of one or more messages in queues on Mailbox servers or Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Get-ActiveSyncMailboxPolicy: Use the Get-ActiveSyncMailboxPolicy cmdlet to retrieve the Mobile Device mailbox policy settings for a specific Mobile Device mailbox policy.
descriptions.Set-InformationBarrierPolicy: Use the Set-InformationBarrierPolicy cmdlet to modify information barrier policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-SafeAttachmentRule: Use the New-SafeAttachmentRule cmdlet to create safe attachment rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.New-MigrationEndpoint: Use the New-MigrationEndpoint cmdlet to configure the connection settings for cross-forests moves, remote move migrations, cutover or staged Exchange migrations, IMAP migrations, and Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) migrations.
descriptions.Cancel-SensitiveInformationScan: Use the Cancel-SensitiveInformationScan cmdlet to cancel sensitive information scans.
descriptions.Get-Place: Use the Get-Place cmdlet to view the additional metadata that was configured on room mailboxes by using the Set-Place cmdlet. The additional metadata provides a better search and room suggestion experience.
descriptions.Get-EXOMailboxStatistics: Use the Get-EXOMailboxStatistics cmdlet to return information about a mailbox, such as the size of the mailbox, the number of messages it contains, and the last time it was accessed.
descriptions.Update-PublicFolder: Use the Update-PublicFolder cmdlet to start content synchronization of a public folder.
descriptions.Test-AssistantHealth: Use the Test-AssistantHealth cmdlet to verify that the Microsoft Exchange Mailbox Assistants service (MSExchangeMailboxAssistants) is healthy, to recover from health issues, and to report the status of the diagnosis or recovery action.
descriptions.Get-ComplianceRetentionEventType: Use the Get-ComplianceRetentionEventType cmdlet to view retention event types in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Export-PurviewConfig: Use the Export-PurviewConfig cmdlet to export Microsoft Purview diagnostic configuration data for your organization. The exported data is returned as a compressed ZIP file (byte array) containing component-specific diagnostic information.
descriptions.Set-UMDialPlan: Use the Set-UMDialPlan cmdlet to set various properties on a Unified Messaging (UM) dial plan.
descriptions.Get-UserPrincipalNamesSuffix: Use the Get-UserPrincipalNamesSuffix cmdlet to view the user principal name (UPN) suffixes in the Active Directory forest. The UPN suffixes are created in Active Directory Domains and Trusts.
descriptions.Set-ExoPhishSimOverrideRule: Use the Set-ExoPhishSimOverrideRule cmdlet to modify non-Microsoft phishing simulation override rules that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-ComplianceTagStorage: Use the Get-ComplianceTagStorage cmdlet to confirm that you've created the retention label policy by using the Enable-ComplianceTagStorage cmdlet. Retention labels apply retention settings to content.
descriptions.Add-AttachmentFilterEntry: Use the Add-AttachmentFilterEntry cmdlet to add an entry to the attachment filter list that's used by the Attachment Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Remove-MalwareFilterRule: Use the Remove-MalwareFilterRule cmdlet to remove malware filter rules from your organization.
descriptions.Get-SiteMailboxDiagnostics: Use the Get-SiteMailboxDiagnostics cmdlet to view important event-related data for each site mailbox. This information can be used to troubleshoot site mailbox issues.
descriptions.Set-ProtectionAlert: Use the Set-ProtectionAlert cmdlet to modify alert policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-PartnerApplication: Use the Remove-PartnerApplication cmdlet to remove a partner application configuration.
descriptions.Get-FilePlanPropertySubCategory: Use the Get-FilePlanPropertySubCategory cmdlet to view file plan property subcategories.
descriptions.Export-UMCallDataRecord: Use the Export-UMCallDataRecord cmdlet to export Unified Messaging (UM) call data records for UM dial plans and UM IP gateways for a date that you've specified.
descriptions.Get-TeamsProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Get-TeamsProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to view Microsoft Teams protection policy rules.
descriptions.Get-CompromisedUserDetailReport: Use the Get-CompromisedUserDetailReport cmdlet to return detailed information about compromised users for the last 10 days.
descriptions.Get-MailContact: Use the Get-MailContact cmdlet to view existing mail contacts.
descriptions.Export-ActiveSyncLog: Use the Export-ActiveSyncLog cmdlet to parse the Internet Information Services (IIS) logs and return information about Microsoft Exchange ActiveSync usage, either on the screen or in an output file.
descriptions.Remove-RetentionPolicy: Use the Remove-RetentionPolicy cmdlet to remove a retention policy.
descriptions.Get-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation: Use the Get-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation cmdlet to retrieve information about the AuditBypassEnabled property value for user accounts (on-premises Exchange and the cloud) and computer accounts (on-premises Exchange only). You use the Set-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation cmdlet to enable this property to bypass mailbox audit logging.
descriptions.Get-AntiPhishPolicy: Use the Get-AntiPhishPolicy cmdlet to view antiphish policies in your cloud-based organization. This cmdlet returns results only in Exchange Online PowerShell.
descriptions.Update-EmailAddressPolicy: Use the Update-EmailAddressPolicy cmdlet to apply new or updated email address policies to the affected recipients in an on-premises Exchange organization.
descriptions.Remove-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy: Use the Remove-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy cmdlet to remove auto-labeling policies from your organization.
descriptions.Get-DomainController: Use the Get-DomainController cmdlet to view a list of domain controllers that exist in your organization.
descriptions.Set-PopSettings: Use the Set-PopSettings cmdlet to modify the configuration of the Microsoft Exchange POP3 service. This service exists on Exchange servers that have the Client Access server role installed, and is used by POP3 clients to connect to Exchange.
descriptions.Get-HostedConnectionFilterPolicy: Use the Get-HostedConnectionFilterPolicy cmdlet to view the settings of connection filter policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-InboxRule: Use the Set-InboxRule cmdlet to modify existing Inbox rules in mailboxes. Inbox rules process messages in the Inbox based on conditions specified and take actions such as moving a message to a specified folder or deleting a message.
descriptions.Set-RetentionPolicy: Use the Set-RetentionPolicy cmdlet to change the properties of an existing retention policy.
descriptions.New-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy: Use the New-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy cmdlet to create auto-labeling policies in your organization. Create auto-labeling policy rules using the New-AutoSensitivityLabelRule cmdlet and associate them with the policy to complete the policy creation.
descriptions.Get-CalendarProcessing: Use the Get-CalendarProcessing cmdlet to view the calendar processing options for resource mailboxes, which include the Calendar Attendant, resource booking assistant and calendar configuration. The settings returned by this cmdlet are editable only on resource mailboxes.
descriptions.Remove-AdaptiveScope: Use the Remove-AdaptiveScope cmdlet to remove adaptive scopes from your organization.
descriptions.Set-ManagedFolder: Use the Set-ManagedFolder cmdlet to modify the settings of managed folders.
descriptions.Get-RoutingGroupConnector: Use the Get-RoutingGroupConnector cmdlet to view the configuration details of the routing group connectors in a Microsoft Exchange Server 2010 organization.
descriptions.New-MalwareFilterPolicy: Use the New-MalwareFilterPolicy cmdlet to create malware filter policies in your organization.
descriptions.New-MailboxFolder: Use the New-MailboxFolder cmdlet to create folders in your own mailbox. Administrators can't use this cmdlet to create folders in other mailboxes (the cmdlet is available only from the MyBaseOptions user role).
descriptions.New-PartnerApplication: Use the New-PartnerApplication cmdlet to create partner application configurations in on-premises Exchange organizations.
descriptions.Disable-IPv6ForAcceptedDomain: Use the Disable-IPv6ForAcceptedDomain cmdlet to disable or opt-out of support for mail delivery to accepted domains in Exchange Online using IPv6.
descriptions.New-OnPremisesOrganization: Use the New-OnPremisesOrganization cmdlet to create an OnPremisesOrganization object in a Microsoft 365 organization.
descriptions.Remove-AntiPhishPolicy: Use the Remove-AntiPhishPolicy cmdlet to remove antiphish policies from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Invoke-ProvisioningRecipientDiagnostic: Use the Invoke-ProvisioningRecipientDiagnostic cmdlet to identify and repair recipient provisioning failures in cloud-based organizations. Recipients include mailboxes, mail contacts, mail users, and groups.
descriptions.Set-IRMConfiguration: Use the Set-IRMConfiguration cmdlet to configure Information Rights Management (IRM) features on your organization.
descriptions.Remove-HostedContentFilterRule: Use the Remove-HostedContentFilterRule cmdlet to remove spam filter rules (content filter rules) in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Update-SiteMailbox: Use the Update-SiteMailbox cmdlet to trigger a Microsoft SharePoint synchronization. This command synchronizes document content membership and permissions into Microsoft Exchange. You might need to perform this action when troubleshooting document or membership synchronization issues.
descriptions.Start-MailboxAssistant: Use the Start-MailboxAssistant cmdlet to start processing of a mailbox by the specified assistant.
descriptions.Set-ClientAccessRule: > [!NOTE] > Client access rules were deprecated for all Exchange Online organizations in September 2025. For more information, see Update on Client Access Rules Deprecation in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Update-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy: Use the Update-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy cmdlet to update an access policy for a feature in a Viva module in Viva.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderMoveRequest: Use the Get-PublicFolderMoveRequest cmdlet to view the detailed status of an ongoing public folder move that was initiated using the New-PublicFolderMoveRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Disable-SafeLinksRule: Use the Disable-SafeLinksRule cmdlet to disable enabled Safe Links rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Enable-UMServer: Use the Enable-UMServer cmdlet to set the status of a Unified Messaging (UM) server to enabled. This enables the Unified Messaging server to process UM calls.
descriptions.Remove-UMMailboxPolicy: Use the Remove-UMMailboxPolicy cmdlet to delete a Unified Messaging (UM) mailbox policy.
descriptions.Get-IPAllowListConfig: Use the Get-IPAllowListConfig cmdlet to view the configuration information for the IP Allow list that's used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Disable-OutlookProtectionRule: Use the Disable-OutlookProtectionRule cmdlet to disable an existing Microsoft Outlook protection rule.
descriptions.Add-RoleGroupMember: Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group.
descriptions.Start-HistoricalSearch: Use the Start-HistoricalSearch cmdlet to start a new historical search.
descriptions.Get-SettingOverride: **Caution**: Incorrect usage of the setting override cmdlets can cause serious damage to your Exchange organization. This damage could require you to reinstall Exchange. Only use these cmdlets as instructed by product documentation or under the direction of Microsoft Customer Service and Support.
descriptions.Get-UMService: Use the Get-UMService cmdlet to view the settings of the Microsoft Exchange Unified Messaging service on Exchange 2013 or Exchange 2016 Mailbox servers.
descriptions.Get-PolicyTipConfig: Use the Get-PolicyTipConfig cmdlet to view the data loss prevention (DLP) Policy Tips in your organization.
descriptions.Set-ManagedFolderMailboxPolicy: Use the Set-ManagedFolderMailboxPolicy cmdlet to change the settings of a managed folder mailbox policy.
descriptions.Remove-OutboundConnector: Use the Remove-OutboundConnector cmdlet to delete an Outbound connector from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Add-DistributionGroupMember: Use the Add-DistributionGroupMember cmdlet to add a single recipient to distribution groups and mail-enabled security groups. To replace all members, use the Update-DistributionGroupMember cmdlet.
descriptions.Remove-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy: Use the Remove-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy to remove app retention compliance policies.
descriptions.Update-MailboxDatabaseCopy: Use the Update-MailboxDatabaseCopy cmdlet to seed or reseed a mailbox database copy.
descriptions.Set-ExchangeFeature: Use the Set-ExchangeFeature cmdlet to approve or block features flighted via Feature Flighting on Exchange Server.
descriptions.Suspend-MailboxExportRequest: Use the Suspend-MailboxExportRequest cmdlet to suspend an export request any time after the request was created, but before the request reaches the status of Completed. You can resume the request by using the Resume-MailboxExportRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Disable-MetaCacheDatabase: Use the Disable-MetaCacheDatabase cmdlet to disable the metacache database on Exchange 2019 Mailbox servers. The metacache database stores mailbox database indexes and secondary copies of metadata on solid state drives (SSDs) to improve search latency and user logons.
descriptions.Get-UserPhoto: Use the Get-UserPhoto cmdlet to view information about the user photos feature that allows users to associate a picture with their account. User photos appear in client applications, such as Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint.
descriptions.New-OrganizationRelationship: Use the New-OrganizationRelationship cmdlet to create organization relationships. Organization relationships define the settings that are used with external Exchange organizations to access calendar free/busy information or to move mailboxes between on-premises Exchange servers and Exchange Online as part of hybrid deployments.
descriptions.Set-OMEMessageRevocation: Use the Set-OMEMessageRevocation cmdlet to revoke Microsoft Purview Message Encryption for a message. Revoking encryption prevents the recipient from viewing the message in the OME portal.
descriptions.Set-MigrationUser: Use the Set-MigrationUser cmdlet to modify the migration settings of a user in an existing migration batch.
descriptions.New-MailboxImportRequest: Use the New-MailboxImportRequest cmdlet to begin the process of importing a .pst file to a mailbox or archive.
descriptions.Get-ServicePrincipal: Use the Get-ServicePrincipal cmdlet to view information about service principals in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-ComplianceSecurityFilter: Use the Remove-ComplianceSecurityFilter cmdlet to remove compliance security filters from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Disable-AntiPhishRule: Use the Disable-AntiPhishRule cmdlet to disable antiphish rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-ContentFilterPhrase: Use the Get-ContentFilterPhrase cmdlet to view one or all custom words that the Content Filter agent processes.
descriptions.Undo-SoftDeletedMailbox: Use the Undo-SoftDeletedMailbox cmdlet to recover a mailbox that is deleted. Mailboxes can be recovered within 30 days of being deleted.
descriptions.New-FilePlanPropertyCitation: Use the New-FilePlanPropertyCitation cmdlet to create file plan property citations.
descriptions.Get-Recipient: Use the Get-Recipient cmdlet to view existing recipient objects in your organization. This cmdlet returns all mail-enabled objects (for example, mailboxes, mail users, mail contacts, and distribution groups).
descriptions.Set-RoutingGroupConnector: Use the Set-RoutingGroupConnector cmdlet to modify the properties of an existing routing group connector between a Microsoft Exchange Server 2010 routing group and an Exchange Server 2003 routing group. You can also use this cmdlet to configure the maximum message size that can pass across a routing group connector.
descriptions.Remove-ActiveSyncDevice: Use the Remove-ActiveSyncDevice cmdlet to remove mobile device partnerships that identify the devices that are configured to synchronize with user mailboxes.
descriptions.New-RetentionCompliancePolicy: Use the New-RetentionCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create new retention policies and new retention label policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Creating a new policy also requires use of the New-RetentionComplianceRule cmdlet.
descriptions.Set-HVEAccountSettings: Use the Set-HVEAccountSettings cmdlet to modify the account settings of a High Volume Email (HVE) account.
descriptions.Set-UserPhoto: Use the Set-UserPhoto cmdlet to configure the user photos feature that allows users to associate a picture with their account. User photos appear in client applications, such as Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint.
descriptions.New-DeviceConfigurationRule: Use the New-DeviceConfigurationRule cmdlet to create mobile device configuration rules in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Remove-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupServer: Use the Remove-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupServer cmdlet to remove a Mailbox server from a database availability group (DAG). To remove a Mailbox server from a DAG, the Mailbox server must not host any replicated databases.
descriptions.Get-MigrationConfig: Use the Get-MigrationConfig cmdlet to retrieve migration configuration settings for your organization.
descriptions.Get-DynamicDistributionGroup: Use the Get-DynamicDistributionGroup cmdlet to view existing dynamic distribution groups.
descriptions.Remove-RecipientPermission: Use the Remove-RecipientPermission cmdlet to remove SendAs permission from users in a cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-MessageTrackingLog: Use the Get-MessageTrackingLog cmdlet to search for message delivery information stored in the message tracking log.
descriptions.Set-EventsFromEmailConfiguration: Use the Set-EventsFromEmailConfiguration cmdlet to modify the events from email settings on a mailbox. on Outlook clients and Outlook on the web. These settings define whether Outlook or Outlook on the web (formerly known as Outlook Web App) automatically discovers events from email messages and adds them to the user's calendar.
descriptions.Get-ContentMalwareMdoDetailReport: Use the ContentMalwareMdoDetailReport cmdlet to view detection details by Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams in Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
descriptions.New-MailboxDatabase: Use the New-MailboxDatabase cmdlet to create a mailbox database, or a recovery database. Each database you create must have a unique name in the organization.
descriptions.Get-CalendarDiagnosticLog: Although this cmdlet is available in on-premises Exchange and in the cloud-based service, it only works in on-premises Exchange. In cloud-based service, use the Get-CalendarDiagnosticObjects cmdlet instead.
descriptions.Get-ClientAccessServer: Use the Get-ClientAccessServer cmdlet to view settings that are associated with the Client Access server role.
descriptions.Set-MailboxDatabase: Use the Set-MailboxDatabase cmdlet to configure a variety of properties for a mailbox database.
descriptions.Set-ClientAccessArray: Use the Set-ClientAccessArray cmdlet to modify RPC Client Access arrays (load-balanced arrays of Client Access servers within a single Active Directory site).
descriptions.Add-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupServer: Use the Add-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupServer cmdlet to add a Mailbox server to a database availability group (DAG). A DAG is a set of Mailbox servers that use continuous replication and managed availability to provide automatic database-level recovery from database, server, or network failures.
descriptions.Get-TransportRuleAction: Use the Get-TransportRuleAction cmdlet to view the actions that are available for transport rules (mail flow rules).
descriptions.Remove-ComplianceSearchAction: Use the Remove-ComplianceSearch cmdlet to remove compliance search actions from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy: Use the Remove-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy cmdlet to delete an access policy for a feature in a Viva module in Viva. Once you delete a policy, the policy is permanently deleted. You can't undo the deletion.
descriptions.New-ManagedFolderMailboxPolicy: Use the New-ManagedFolderMailboxPolicy cmdlet to create a managed folder mailbox policy.
descriptions.Set-SafeLinksPolicy: Use the Set-SafeLinksPolicy cmdlet to modify Safe Links policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-ExchangeServerAccessLicense: Use the Get-ExchangeServerAccessLicense cmdlet to return a list of licenses in use in your Exchange organization. This refers to the specific legal name of the license, as defined in the Microsoft Product List and is representative of your licenses when you run this cmdlet.
descriptions.Set-AuthServer: Use the Set-AuthServer cmdlet to configure an authorization server that partner applications can use to obtain tokens recognized by Microsoft Exchange.
descriptions.Set-IPAllowListConfig: Use the Set-IPAllowListConfig cmdlet to modify the IP Allow list configuration that's used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderMailboxDiagnostics: Use the Get-PublicFolderMailboxDiagnostics cmdlet to view event-level information about a public folder mailbox. This information can be used to troubleshoot public folder issues.
descriptions.Set-ClassificationRuleCollection: Use the Set-ClassificationRuleCollection cmdlet to update existing classification rule collections in your organization.
descriptions.New-ComplianceRetentionEventType: Use the New-ComplianceRetentionEventType cmdlet to create retention event types in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-RoleAssignmentPolicy: Use the New-RoleAssignmentPolicy cmdlet to create management role assignment policies in your organization.
descriptions.Get-AddressList: Use the Get-AddressList cmdlet to view address lists.
descriptions.Get-ComplianceTag: Use the Get-ComplianceTag cmdlet to view retention labels in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Retention labels apply retention settings to content.
descriptions.Remove-GlobalMonitoringOverride: Use the Remove-GlobalMonitoringOverride cmdlet to remove a managed availability global override that is configured for a probe, monitor or responder.
descriptions.Get-MessageTraceDetail: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet is replaced by the Get-MessageTraceDetailV2 cmdlet and will eventually be deprecated.
descriptions.Get-ServerMonitoringOverride: Use the Get-ServerMonitoringOverride cmdlet to return all overrides created on the specified server.
descriptions.New-UMHuntGroup: Use the New-UMHuntGroup cmdlet to create a Unified Messaging (UM) hunt group used to link incoming calls to a specific UM dial plan.
descriptions.Disable-EOPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Disable-EOPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to turn off the Standard preset security policy or the Strict preset security policy. If your organization has Defender for Office 365, you also need to use the Disable-ATPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to turn off the policy.
descriptions.Set-FeatureConfiguration: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet is currently available in Public Preview, isn't available in all organizations, and is subject to change.
descriptions.Get-DeviceConditionalAccessRule: Use the Get-DeviceConditionalAccessRule cmdlet to view mobile device conditional access rules in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Set-DeviceConditionalAccessPolicy: Use the Set-DeviceConditionalAccessPolicy cmdlet to modify mobile device conditional access policies in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Get-MonitoringItemIdentity: Use the Get-MonitoringItemIdentity cmdlet to discover the monitoring items that you can use to return health information about your Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-SweepRule: Use the Remove-SweepRule cmdlet to remove Sweep rules from mailboxes.
descriptions.Set-MigrationEndpoint: Use the Set-MigrationEndpoint cmdlet to edit settings for cutover or staged Exchange migrations, IMAP migrations, Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) migrations, and remote moves.
descriptions.Enable-Mailbox: Use the Enable-Mailbox cmdlet to create mailboxes for existing users who don't already have mailboxes. You can also use this cmdlet to create In-Place archives for existing mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-ReviewItems: Use the Get-ReviewItems to retrieve a list of disposition review items that are either pending review or already disposed for a specific retention label. It can also be used to retrieve a list of disposed items for a specific record label.
descriptions.Set-PartnerApplication: Use the Set-PartnerApplication cmdlet to configure partner application configurations in on-premises Exchange organizations.
descriptions.Set-RoleAssignmentPolicy: Use the Set-RoleAssignmentPolicy cmdlet to modify existing management role assignment policies in your organization.
descriptions.Remove-ProtectionAlert: Use the Remove-ProtectionAlert cmdlet to remove alert policies from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-AuthRedirect: Use the Get-AuthRedirect cmdlet to view OAuth redirection objects that are used for legacy Microsoft Exchange 2010 Client Access servers in your organization.
descriptions.Add-IPAllowListProvider: Use the Add-IPAllowListProvider cmdlet to create IP Allow list providers that are used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Enable-InboxRule: Use the Enable-InboxRule cmdlet to enable an Inbox rule. Inbox rules are used to process messages in the Inbox based on conditions specified and take actions such as moving a message to a specified folder or deleting a message.
descriptions.Set-ComplianceTag: Use the Set-ComplianceTag cmdlet to modify retention labels in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Retention labels apply retention settings to content.
descriptions.Set-DeviceTenantRule: Use the Set-DeviceTenantRule cmdlet to modify your organization's mobile device tenant rule in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Set-RecipientFilterConfig: Use the Set-RecipientFilterConfig cmdlet to enable and configure the Recipient Filter agent.
descriptions.Remove-MapiVirtualDirectory: Use the Remove-MapiVirtualDirectory cmdlet to remove Message Application Programming Interface (MAPI) virtual directories from Exchange servers. A MAPI virtual directory is used by supported versions of Microsoft Outlook to connect to mailboxes by using the MAPIHTTP protocol.
descriptions.Get-UMCallDataRecord: Use the Get-UMCallDataRecord cmdlet to display Unified Messaging (UM) call data records for a specific UM-enabled user's mailbox.
descriptions.Remove-HoldCompliancePolicy: Use the Remove-HoldCompliancePolicy cmdlet to remove preservation policies from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-RecordReviewNotificationTemplateConf: Use the Set-RecordReviewNotificationTemplateConfig cmdlet to set up the customized record review notification and reminder that's sent when an item requires review.
descriptions.Set-RoleGroup: Use the Set-RoleGroup cmdlet to modify who can add or remove members to or from management role groups or change the name of the role group.
descriptions.New-ClientAccessRule: > [!NOTE] > Client access rules were deprecated for all Exchange Online organizations in September 2025. For more information, see Update on Client Access Rules Deprecation in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Get-ExchangeCertificate: Use the Get-ExchangeCertificate cmdlet to view Exchange certificates that are installed on Exchange servers. This cmdlet returns Exchange self-signed certificates, certificates that were issued by a certification authority and pending certificate requests (also known as certificate signing requests or CSRs).
descriptions.Get-OnPremisesOrganization: Use the Get-OnPremisesOrganization cmdlet to retrieve settings for the OnPremisesOrganization object that is created for a hybrid deployment.
descriptions.Export-AutoDiscoverConfig: Use the Export-AutoDiscoverConfig cmdlet to create or update a service connection point for an Autodiscover service pointer in a target Exchange forest.
descriptions.Remove-ActiveSyncMailboxPolicy: Use the Remove-ActiveSyncMailboxPolicy cmdlet to remove mobile device mailbox policies.
descriptions.Get-CompromisedUserAggregateReport: Use the Get-CompromisedUserAggregateReport cmdlet to return general data about compromised users for the last 10 days.
descriptions.Get-IPAllowListProvider: Use the Get-IPAllowListProvider cmdlet to view IP Allow list providers that are used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Import-DlpPolicyTemplate: Use the Import-DlpPolicyTemplate cmdlet to import data loss prevention (DLP) policy template files that are based on transport rules (mail flow rules) into your Exchange organization.
descriptions.Set-ManagementRoleEntry: Use the Set-ManagementRoleEntry cmdlet to change the available parameters on an existing management role entry.
descriptions.New-MoveRequest: Use the New-MoveRequest cmdlet to begin the process of an asynchronous mailbox or personal archive move. You can also check mailbox readiness to be moved by using the WhatIf parameter.
descriptions.Get-GlobalMonitoringOverride: Use the Get-GlobalMonitoringOverride cmdlet to view the overrides of the thresholds and parameters of the managed availability probes, monitors and responders that are configured for all Exchange 2013 or later servers in your organization.
descriptions.New-AntiPhishRule: Use the New-AntiPhishRule cmdlet to create antiphish rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-OutlookProtectionRule: Use the Get-OutlookProtectionRule cmdlet to retrieve Microsoft Outlook protection rules configured in an organization.
descriptions.Get-TransportServer: Use the Get-TransportServer cmdlet to view settings that are associated with the Hub Transport server role or the Edge Transport server role.
descriptions.Test-CalendarConnectivity: Use the Test-CalendarConnectivity cmdlet to verify that anonymous calendar sharing is enabled and working properly. The Calendar virtual directory is a subdirectory of the Microsoft Outlook on the web virtual directories. When you run this command without any parameters, the command tests calendar connectivity against all Outlook on the web virtual directories.
descriptions.Disable-UMService: Use the Disable-UMService cmdlet to set the status of an Exchange Server 2010 Unified Messaging server to disabled. This prevents the UM server from processing UM incoming calls.
descriptions.Get-CmdletExtensionAgent: Use the Get-CmdletExtensionAgent cmdlet to view cmdlet extension agents.
descriptions.Set-CalendarProcessing: Use the Set-CalendarProcessing cmdlet to modify calendar processing options for resource mailboxes, which include the Calendar Attendant, resource booking assistant, and calendar configuration. This cmdlet is effective only on resource mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-MessageTrackingReport: Use the Get-MessageTrackingReport cmdlet to return data for a specific message tracking report. This cmdlet is used by the delivery reports feature.
descriptions.Enable-HostedContentFilterRule: Use the Enable-HostedContentFilterRule cmdlet to enable spam filter rules (content filter rules) in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Update-PublicFolderHierarchy: Use the Update-PublicFolderHierarchy cmdlet to start content synchronization of the public folder hierarchy.
descriptions.New-MigrationBatch: Use the New-MigrationBatch cmdlet to submit a new migration request for a batch of users.
descriptions.Remove-DlpSensitiveInformationType: Use the Remove-DlpSensitiveInformationType cmdlet to remove sensitive information type rules that use document fingerprints. You can't use this cmdlet to remove built-in sensitive information type rules.
descriptions.Remove-DlpCompliancePolicy: Use the Remove-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to remove data loss prevention (DLP) policies from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Disconnect-ExchangeOnline: Use the Disconnect-ExchangeOnline cmdlet in the Exchange Online PowerShell module to disconnect the connections that you created using the Connect-ExchangeOnline or Connect-IPPSSession cmdlets.
descriptions.Add-ADPermission: Use the Add-ADPermission cmdlet to add permissions to an Active Directory object.
descriptions.New-SettingOverride: **Caution**: Incorrect usage of the setting override cmdlets can cause serious damage to your Exchange organization. This damage could require you to reinstall Exchange. Only use these cmdlets as instructed by product documentation or under the direction of Microsoft Customer Service and Support.
descriptions.Resume-MailboxDatabaseCopy: Use the Resume-MailboxDatabaseCopy cmdlet to unblock activation or resume log copying and replay for a passive mailbox database copy.
descriptions.New-SyncMailPublicFolder: The New-SyncMailPublicFolder cmdlet is used by the Import-MailPublicFoldersForMigration.ps1 and Sync-MailPublicFolders.ps1 scripts to create mail-enabled public folder recipient objects in Exchange Online (the scripts synchronize mail-enabled public folder objects from the source on-premises Exchange organization to Exchange Online). Don't use this cmdlet unless you are directed to do so by Microsoft Customer Service and Support or by specific documentation.
descriptions.Get-SupervisoryReviewReport: Use the Get-SupervisoryReviewReport cmdlet to view supervisory review events in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal for the last 90 days.
descriptions.New-ThrottlingPolicy: Use the New-ThrottlingPolicy cmdlet to create a non-default user throttling policy.
descriptions.Remove-RoleGroupMember: Use the Remove-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to remove a member of a management role group.
descriptions.Invoke-ProvisioningCompanyObjectDiagnost: Use the Invoke-ProvisioningCompanyObjectDiagnostic cmdlet to validate and fix core Microsoft 365 tenant information and service plan configuration in cloud-based organizations.
descriptions.Remove-ActiveSyncDeviceClass: Use the Remove-ActiveSyncDeviceClass cmdlet to clean up the list of mobile devices synchronizing with Microsoft Exchange.
descriptions.Set-UMCallRouterSettings: Use the Set-UMCallRouterSettings cmdlet to modify the configuration of the Microsoft Exchange Unified Messaging Call Router service. This service exists on Exchange servers that have the Client Access server role installed, and is used by telephony clients to connect to Exchange.
descriptions.Get-AvailabilityReportOutage: Use the Get-AvailabilityReportOutage cmdlet to return the daily downtime (if any) for each service entity and its overridden value (if set) to the overall reported availability for the day.
descriptions.Connect-IPPSSession: Use the Connect-IPPSSession cmdlet in the Exchange Online PowerShell module to connect to Security & Compliance PowerShell using modern authentication. The cmdlet works for MFA or non-MFA enabled accounts.
descriptions.Suspend-PublicFolderReplication: Use the Suspend-PublicFolderReplication cmdlet to stop public folder replication for the organization.
descriptions.Remove-RoleGroup: Use the Remove-RoleGroup cmdlet to remove a management role group.
descriptions.Set-FilePlanPropertyDepartment: Use the Set-FilePlanPropertyDepartment cmdlet to modify file plan property departments.
descriptions.Remove-AddressBookPolicy: Use the Remove-AddressBookPolicy cmdlet to delete an address book policy. You can't remove the address book policy if it's still assigned to a user's mailbox.
descriptions.Remove-ComplianceCase: Use the Remove-ComplianceCase cmdlet to remove compliance cases from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal or the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-UnifiedGroup: Use the New-UnifiedGroup cmdlet to create Microsoft 365 Groups in your cloud-based organization. To add members, owners, and subscribers to Microsoft 365 Groups, use the Add-UnifiedGroupLinks cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-LinkedUser: Use the Get-LinkedUser cmdlet to view existing linked user accounts.
descriptions.Remove-ClientAccessArray: Use the Remove-ClientAccessArray cmdlet to remove RPC Client Access arrays (load-balanced arrays of Client Access servers within a single Active Directory site).
descriptions.Get-DlpIncidentDetailReport: Use the Get-DlpIncidentDetailReport cmdlet to view the details of incidents that happened in the last 30 days.
descriptions.Set-FrontendTransportService: Use the Get-FrontEndTransportService cmdlet to modify the configuration of the Front End Transport service on Exchange 2013 or later servers that have the Client Access server role installed.
descriptions.Enable-SweepRule: Use the Enable-SweepRule cmdlet to enable Sweep rules in mailboxes.
descriptions.Install-UnifiedCompliancePrerequisite: Use the Install-UnifiedCompliancePrerequisite cmdlet to view, create, or configure the Compliance Policy Center in Microsoft SharePoint. The Compliance Policy Center is a site collection that's used by the Microsoft Purview compliance portal to store preservation policies that act on content in SharePoint sites.
descriptions.Get-ConfigAnalyzerPolicyRecommendation: Use the Get-ConfigAnalyzerPolicyRecommendation cmdlet to compare the settings in your existing security policies to the settings that are used in the Standard or Strict preset security policies. Settings that are below the recommend value are returned in the results.
descriptions.Remove-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupNetwork: Use the Remove-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupNetwork cmdlet to remove a database availability group (DAG) network.
descriptions.Set-DeviceConditionalAccessRule: Use the Set-DeviceConditionalAccessRule cmdlet to modify mobile device conditional access rules in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Mount-Database: Use the Mount-Database cmdlet to mount mailbox databases on Exchange servers. The cmdlet mounts the database only if the Microsoft Exchange Information Store service and the Microsoft Exchange Replication service are running.
descriptions.New-AuthenticationPolicy: Use the New-AuthenticationPolicy cmdlet to create authentication policies in your organization.
descriptions.Remove-SendConnector: Use the Remove-SendConnector cmdlet to delete a Send connector.
descriptions.Set-ExchangeAssistanceConfig: Use the Set-ExchangeAssistanceConfig cmdlet to modify the Microsoft Exchange Help configurations for your organization.
descriptions.Set-PolicyTipConfig: Use the Set-PolicyTipConfig cmdlet to modify custom Policy Tips in your organization. You can't modify built-in Policy Tips.
descriptions.Suspend-Queue: Use the Suspend-Queue cmdlet to stop processing for a queue on a Mailbox server or an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Get-PhishSimOverridePolicy: Use the Get-PhishSimOverridePolicy cmdlet to view non-Microsoft phishing simulation override policies that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Set-DefaultTenantBriefingConfig: Use the Set-DefaultTenantBriefingConfig cmdlet to modify the default Briefing email configuration in cloud-based organizations. For details about configuring the Briefing email, see Configure Briefing email.
descriptions.Get-EXORecipientPermission: Use the Get-EXORecipientPermission cmdlet to view information about SendAs permissions that are configured for users in a cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-MailboxPermission: Use the Get-MailboxPermission cmdlet to retrieve permissions on a mailbox.
descriptions.Enable-MalwareFilterRule: Use the Enable-MalwareFilterRule cmdlet to enable malware filter rules in your organization.
descriptions.Disable-SweepRule: Use the Disable-SweepRule cmdlet to disable Sweep rules in mailboxes.
descriptions.New-TeamsProtectionPolicy: Use the New-TeamsProtectionPolicy cmdlet to create Microsoft Teams protection policies.
descriptions.Enable-MailContact: Use the Enable-MailContact cmdlet to add email capabilities to existing contacts that aren't already mail-enabled.
descriptions.Set-HostedConnectionFilterPolicy: Use the Set-HostedConnectionFilterPolicy cmdlet to modify the settings of connection filter policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-TransportServer: Use the Set-TransportServer cmdlet to modify settings that are associated with the Hub Transport server role or the Edge Transport server role.
descriptions.Test-SenderId: Use the Test-SenderId cmdlet to test whether a specified IP address is the legitimate sending address for a specified SMTP address.
descriptions.Get-ExchangeFeature: Use the Get-ExchangeFeature cmdlet to return information about features that are flighted on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-DkimSigningConfig: Use the Remove-DkimSigningConfig cmdlet to remove the DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) signing policy settings for domains in a cloud-based organization.
descriptions.New-SecOpsOverridePolicy: Use the New-SecOpsOverridePolicy cmdlet to create SecOps mailbox override policies that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-MalwareFilterPolicy: Use the Get-MalwareFilterPolicy cmdlet to view the malware filter policies in your organization.
descriptions.Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy: Use the Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy cmdlet to add a new access policy for a specific feature in Viva. The attributes of the policy are defined using the cmdlet parameters. Policies are used to restrict or grant access to the specified feature for specific users, groups, or the entire tenant.
descriptions.Set-ManagementScope: Use the Set-ManagementScope cmdlet to change an existing management scope.
descriptions.Import-FilePlanProperty: Use the Import-FilePlanProperty cmdlet to import file plan properties.
descriptions.Get-SecOpsOverridePolicy: Use the Get-SecOpsOverridePolicy cmdlet to view SecOps mailbox override policies that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-IPBlockListProvidersConfig: Use the Get-IPBlockListProvidersConfig cmdlet to view the settings that affect all IP Block list providers that are configured on an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Enable-SafeAttachmentRule: Use the Enable-SafeAttachmentRule cmdlet to enable safe attachment rules in your cloud-based organization. This cmdlet is also responsible for disabling complete Safe Attachments policies in the admin center, which consist of the safe attachment rule and the corresponding assigned safe attachment policy in PowerShell.
descriptions.Test-Message: Use the Test-Message cmdlet to simulate and report on the effects of mail flow rules (transport rules) and unified DLP rules on test email messages. Because this cmdlet introduces email into the DLP evaluation pipeline, actions such as Block, Moderate, etc. can take place on the test message. Related notifications are also sent to any configured recipients.
descriptions.Compare-TextMessagingVerificationCode: Use the Compare-TextMessagingVerificationCode cmdlet to verify the text messaging verification code that the user specified as part of configuring text message notifications on the mailbox.
descriptions.Get-DlpPolicy: Use the Get-DlpPolicy cmdlet to view existing data loss prevention (DLP) policies that are based on transport rules (mail flow rules) in your organization.
descriptions.Set-PublicFolder: Use the Set-PublicFolder cmdlet to set the attributes of public folders.
descriptions.Set-InboundConnector: Use the Set-InboundConnector cmdlet to change an existing Inbound connector in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-FilePlanPropertyCategory: Use the Set-FilePlanPropertyCategory cmdlet to modify file plan property categories.
descriptions.New-AddressBookPolicy: Use the New-AddressBookPolicy cmdlet to create an address book policy. Address book policies define the global address list (GAL), offline address book (OAB), room list, and address lists shown to mailbox users who are assigned the policy.
descriptions.Validate-RetentionRuleQuery: Use the Validate-RetentionRuleQuery cmdlet to validate the Keyword Query Language (KQL) content search filters for retention rules.
descriptions.Get-EdgeSyncServiceConfig: Use the Get-EdgeSyncServiceConfig cmdlet to retrieve the edge synchronization services settings that control the general synchronization behavior shared by all Microsoft Exchange EdgeSync services.
descriptions.Get-DeliveryAgentConnector: Use the Get-DeliveryAgentConnector cmdlet to retrieve information about a specific delivery agent connector in your organization.
descriptions.Import-DlpPolicyCollection: Use the Import-DlpPolicyCollection cmdlet to import data loss prevention (DLP) policy collections that are based on transport rules (mail flow rules) into your organization.
descriptions.Get-HoldComplianceRule: Use the Get-HoldComplianceRule to view preservation rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup: Use the Get-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup cmdlet to obtain a variety of configuration settings, status and other information about a database availability group (DAG).
descriptions.Get-MailboxRestoreRequestStatistics: Use the Get-MailboxRestoreRequestStatistics cmdlet to view detailed information about restore requests.
descriptions.Get-MailDetailTransportRuleReport: Use the Get-MailDetailTransportRuleReport cmdlet to view the details of messages that matched the conditions defined by any transport rules for the last 10 days.
descriptions.Get-PopSettings: Use the Get-POPSettings cmdlet to view the configuration of the Microsoft Exchange POP3 service. This service exists on Exchange servers that have the Client Access server role installed and is used by POP3 clients to connect to Exchange.
descriptions.Move-ActiveMailboxDatabase: Use the Move-ActiveMailboxDatabase cmdlet to perform a database or server switchover.
descriptions.Get-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicyAssign: Use the Get-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicyAssignment cmdlet to view the currently assigned Microsoft 365 data-at-rest encryption policy.
descriptions.Remove-ExchangeCertificate: Use the Remove-ExchangeCertificate cmdlet to remove existing Exchange certificates or pending certificate requests (also known as certificate signing requests or CSRs) from Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-DataClassification: Use the Remove-DataClassification cmdlet to remove data classification rules that use document fingerprints. You can't use this cmdlet to remove built-in data classification rules.
descriptions.Get-SharingPolicy: Use the Get-SharingPolicy cmdlet to view existing sharing policies that control how users inside your organization can share free/busy and contact information with users outside your organization.
descriptions.Get-ResourceConfig: Use the Get-ResourceConfig cmdlet to view custom room and equipment mailbox properties that you've configured by using the Set-ResourceConfig cmdlet.
descriptions.New-ForeignConnector: Use the New-ForeignConnector cmdlet to create a new Foreign connector in the Transport service of a Mailbox server.
descriptions.Remove-PowerShellVirtualDirectory: Use the Remove-PowerShellVirtualDirectory cmdlet to remove existing Windows PowerShell virtual directories from Internet Information Services (IIS) on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-DlpSensitiveInformationTypeRulePa: Use the Remove-DlpSensitiveInformationTypeConfig cmdlet to remove data loss prevention (DLP) sensitive information type rule packages from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-Group: Use the Get-Group cmdlet to view existing group objects in your organization. In all environments, this cmdlet returns mail-enabled security groups, distribution groups, role groups, and room lists. For details about other supported group types in on-premises Exchange environments, see the RecipientTypeDetails parameter description.
descriptions.Get-DlpComplianceRule: Use the Get-DlpComplianceRule to view data loss prevention (DLP) rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. DLP rules identify and protect sensitive information.
descriptions.Remove-AttachmentFilterEntry: Use the Remove-AttachmentFilterEntry cmdlet to remove an entry from the attachment filter list that's used by the Attachment Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Get-ATPBuiltInProtectionRule: Use the Get-ATPBuiltInProtectionRule cmdlet to view the rule for the Built-in protection preset security policy that effectively provides default policies for Safe Links and Safe Attachments in Microsoft Defender for Office 365. The rule specifies exceptions to the policy.
descriptions.Remove-FederationTrust: Use the Remove-FederationTrust cmdlet to remove an existing federation trust from an Exchange organization.
descriptions.Set-QuarantinePermissions: Use the Set-QuarantinePermissions cmdlet to modify quarantine permissions objects that were created by the New-QuarantinePermissions and stored as a variable in the current PowerShell session. You use the variable as a value for the EndUserQuarantinePermission parameter on the New-QuarantinePolicy or Set-QuarantinePolicy cmdlets in the same PowerShell session.
descriptions.Enable-UMIPGateway: Use the Enable-UMIPGateway cmdlet to enable a Unified Messaging (UM) IP gateway.
descriptions.Get-ExchangeSettings: Use the Get-ExchangeSettings cmdlet to view customized Exchange setting objects that are stored in Active Directory. Use the New-ExchangeSettings to create the settings object, and the Set-ExchangeSettings cmdlet to define the actual settings.
descriptions.Get-AuthConfig: Use the Get-AuthConfig cmdlet to get the authorization configuration for partner applications.
descriptions.Clear-ActiveSyncDevice: Use the Clear-ActiveSyncDevice cmdlet to delete all data from a mobile device.
descriptions.New-PublicFolderMoveRequest: Use the New-PublicFolderMoveRequest cmdlet to begin the process of moving public folder contents between public folder mailboxes. Moving public folders only moves the physical contents of the public folder; it doesn't change the logical hierarchy. When the move request is completed, you must run the Remove-PublicFolderMoveRequest cmdlet to remove the request or wait until the time specified in the CompletedRequestAgeLimit parameter has passed. The request must be removed before you can run another move request.
descriptions.Start-InformationBarrierPoliciesApplicat: Use the Start-InformationBarrierPoliciesApplication cmdlet to apply active information barrier policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-ContentFilterConfig: Use the Get-ContentFilterConfig cmdlet to view the content filter configuration for the computer on which the cmdlet is run.
descriptions.Remove-InboxRule: Use the Remove-InboxRule cmdlet to remove an Inbox rule.
descriptions.Get-StoreUsageStatistics: Use the Get-StoreUsageStatistics cmdlet to aid in diagnosing performance issues with your servers or databases.
descriptions.Disable-MailboxQuarantine: Use the Disable-MailboxQuarantine cmdlet to release quarantined mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-DlpEdmSchema: Use the Get-DlpEdmSchema cmdlet to view exact data match (EDM) data loss prevention (DLP) schemas in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-MailboxJunkEmailConfiguration: Use the Get-MailboxJunkEmailConfiguration cmdlet to view the junk email settings on mailboxes.
descriptions.Set-SafeAttachmentRule: Use the Set-SafeAttachmentRule cmdlet to modify safe attachment rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-MessageClassification: Use the Remove-MessageClassification cmdlet to delete an existing message classification instance from your organization.
descriptions.Get-AuthServer: Use the Get-AuthServer cmdlet to view the settings of authorization servers in the Exchange organization.
descriptions.Enable-OrganizationCustomization: You might be prompted to run the EnableOrganizationCustomization cmdlet before you create or modify objects in your Exchange Online organization.
descriptions.Get-InboxRule: Use the Get-InboxRule cmdlet to view Inbox rule properties. Inbox rules are used to process messages in the Inbox based on conditions specified and take actions such as moving a message to a specified folder or deleting a message.
descriptions.New-FilePlanPropertyReferenceId: Use the New-FilePlanPropertyReferenceId cmdlet to create file plan property reference IDs.
descriptions.Restore-RecoverableItems: Use the Restore-RecoverableItems items cmdlet to restore deleted items in mailboxes. You use the Get-RecoverableItems cmdlet to find the deleted items to recover.
descriptions.Set-MailboxPlan: Use the Set-MailboxPlan cmdlet to modify the settings of mailbox plans in the cloud-based service.
descriptions.New-MailboxRepairRequest: Use the New-MailboxRepairRequest cmdlet to detect and fix mailbox corruption issues.
descriptions.New-DeviceConditionalAccessRule: Use the New-DeviceConditionalAccessRule cmdlet to create mobile device conditional access rules in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Get-SecurityPrincipal: Use the Get-SecurityPrincipal cmdlet to return a list of security principals. Security principals are entities, such as users or security groups, which can be assigned permissions and user rights.
descriptions.Get-SafeAttachmentPolicy: Use the Get-SafeAttachmentPolicy cmdlet to view safe attachment policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-PublicFolderDatabase: Use the Remove-PublicFolderDatabase cmdlet to delete public folder databases.
descriptions.Undo-SoftDeletedUnifiedGroup: Use the Undo-SoftDeletedUnifiedGroup cmdlet to restore soft-deleted Microsoft 365 Groups in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-X400AuthoritativeDomain: Use the Remove-X400AuthoritativeDomain cmdlet to remove an X.400 authoritative domain. When you remove an X.400 authoritative domain, the X.400 authoritative domain object is deleted from Active Directory.
descriptions.Enable-CmdletExtensionAgent: Use the Enable-CmdletExtensionAgent cmdlet to enable existing cmdlet extension agents.
descriptions.Get-IntraOrganizationConnector: Use the Get-IntraOrganizationConnector cmdlet to view the settings of Intra-Organization connectors.
descriptions.Get-RemoteMailbox: Use the Get-RemoteMailbox cmdlet to retrieve the mail-related attributes of users in the on-premises organization that have associated mailboxes in the cloud-based service.
descriptions.Set-HybridConfiguration: Use the Set-HybridConfiguration cmdlet to modify the hybrid deployment between your on-premises Exchange organization and Exchange Online in Microsoft 365 for enterprises.
descriptions.Test-ApplicationAccessPolicy: Use the Test-ApplicationAccessPolicy cmdlet to test access right of an application to a specific user/mailbox.
descriptions.Set-MailboxCalendarConfiguration: Use the Set-MailboxCalendarConfiguration cmdlet to modify mailbox calendar settings for Outlook on the web. This affects how the user's calendar looks and how reminders work in Outlook on the web. This also affects settings that define how meeting invitations, responses, and notifications are sent to the user.
descriptions.Remove-SafeAttachmentPolicy: Use the Remove-SafeAttachmentPolicy cmdlet to remove safe attachment policies from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-DeliveryAgentConnector: Use the Set-DeliveryAgentConnector cmdlet to configure a specific delivery agent connector in your organization.
descriptions.Get-MailTrafficSummaryReport: Use the Get-MailTrafficSummaryReport cmdlet to view summary information about message traffic in your organization for the last 90 days.
descriptions.Get-ThrottlingPolicyAssociation: Use the Get-ThrottlingPolicyAssociation cmdlet to view existing throttling policy associations in your organization. Throttling policies can be associated with mailboxes, user accounts, mail contacts, mail users, and Exchange server computer accounts.
descriptions.New-HostedContentFilterRule: Use the New-HostedContentFilterRule cmdlet to create spam filter rules (content filter rules) in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-HoldComplianceRule: Use the Set-HoldComplianceRule cmdlet to modify existing preservation rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-OutboundConnector: Use the New-OutboundConnector cmdlet to create a new Outbound connector in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Add-VivaOrgInsightsDelegatedRole: Use the Add-VivaOrgInsightsDelegatedRole cmdlet to add delegate access to the specified account (the delegate) so they can view organizational insights like the leader (the delegator).
descriptions.New-SearchDocumentFormat: Use the New-SearchDocumentFormat cmdlet to add a format-specific filter to those used by Exchange search.
descriptions.Get-ForeignConnector: Use the Get-ForeignConnector cmdlet to view the configuration information for a Foreign connector in the Transport service of a Mailbox server.
descriptions.Test-OutlookConnectivity: Use the Test-OutlookConnectivity cmdlet to test end-to-end Microsoft Outlook client connectivity in the Microsoft Exchange organization. This includes testing for both Outlook Anywhere (RPC over HTTP) and MAPI over HTTP connections.
descriptions.Set-TransportService: Use the Set-TransportService cmdlet to modify the settings of the Transport service on Exchange 2013 or later Mailbox servers or Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.New-ServicePrincipal: Use the New-ServicePrincipal cmdlet to create service principals in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-EXOCasMailbox: Use the Get-EXOCasMailbox cmdlet to view the Client Access settings that are configured on mailboxes.
descriptions.Remove-SafeAttachmentRule: Use the Remove-SafeAttachmentRule cmdlet to remove safe attachment rules from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-DeviceConditionalAccessRule: Use the Remove-DeviceConditionalAccessRule cmdlet to remove mobile device conditional access rules from Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Remove-MailContact: Use the Remove-MailContact cmdlet to delete existing mail contacts.
descriptions.Get-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy: Use the Get-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy cmdlet to view the access policies for a specified feature in a Viva module in Viva. Policies are used to restrict or grant access to the specified feature for specific users, groups, or the entire tenant. This cmdlet provides details about the policies, including the policy's identifier, name, and creation date. The cmdlet can filter policies based on MemberIds, allowing admins to view policies specific to certain users or groups.
descriptions.Enable-MailPublicFolder: Use the Enable-MailPublicFolder cmdlet to mail-enable public folders.
descriptions.Get-DetailsTemplate: Use the Get-DetailsTemplate cmdlet to retrieve the attributes for details templates.
descriptions.Get-TeamsProtectionPolicy: Use the Get-TeamsProtectionPolicy cmdlet to view Microsoft Teams protection policies.
descriptions.Set-ADServerSettings: Use the Set-ADServerSettings cmdlet to manage the Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) environment in the current Exchange Management Shell session. The Set-ADServerSettings cmdlet replaces the AdminSessionADSettings session variable that was used in Exchange Server 2007.
descriptions.Test-SmtpConnectivity: Use the Test-SmtpConnectivity cmdlet to diagnose whether an SMTP connection can successfully be established to the Receive connectors on a specific server. Although you can run this cmdlet manually to verify SMTP connectivity for a specified server, it's primarily used by Microsoft System Center Operations Manager 2007 to test your transport servers' ability to receive SMTP connections to each of the bindings on all the Receive connectors on those servers.
descriptions.Remove-ForeignConnector: Use the Remove-ForeignConnector cmdlet to delete a Foreign connector in the Transport service of a Mailbox server.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderDatabase: Use the Get-PublicFolderDatabase cmdlet to view public folder database settings for Microsoft Exchange Server 2010 or earlier public folders.
descriptions.Set-AntiPhishPolicy: Use the Set-AntiPhishPolicy cmdlet to modify antiphish policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-AppRetentionComplianceRule: Use the Set-AppRetentionComplianceRule to modify app retention compliance rules.
descriptions.Export-ContentExplorerData: Use the Export-ContentExplorerData cmdlet to export data classification file details in Microsoft Purview compliance.
descriptions.Get-AggregateZapReport: Use the Get-AggregateZapReport cmdlet to view aggregate information about zero-hour auto purge (ZAP) activity. By default, the cmdlet shows the last three days of activity, but you can specify up to ten days.
descriptions.Remove-DlpPolicy: Use the Remove-DlpPolicy cmdlet to remove existing data loss prevention (DLP) policies that are based on transport rules (mail flow rules) from your organization.
descriptions.Get-EmailAddressPolicy: Use the Get-EmailAddressPolicy cmdlet to view email address policies. In Exchange Online, email address policies are available only for Microsoft 365 Groups.
descriptions.Set-Clutter: Use the Set-Clutter cmdlet to configure Clutter settings for mailboxes in your organization.
