descriptions.New-SensitiveInformationScan: Use the New-SensitiveInformationScan cmdlet to create new on-demand classification scans. Learn more about on-demand classifications at On-demand classification.
descriptions.Test-ArchiveConnectivity: Use the Test-ArchiveConnectivity cmdlet to verify archive functionality for a mailbox user.
descriptions.Remove-QuarantinePolicy: Use the Remove-QuarantinePolicy cmdlet to remove quarantine policies from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Expedite-Delicensing: Use the Expedite-Delicensing cmdlet to end the delay for removing mailbox licenses from users. After you remove the delay, the licenses are removed from mailboxes within 24 hours. You configure delayed mailbox license removal using the DelayedDelicensingEnabled parameter on the Set-OrganizationConfig cmdlet.
descriptions.Start-MailboxSearch: Use the Start-MailboxSearch cmdlet to restart or resume a mailbox search that's been stopped.
descriptions.Set-AdminAuditLogConfig: Use the Set-AdminAuditLogConfig cmdlet to configure the administrator audit logging configuration settings.
descriptions.Get-MailDetailDlpPolicyReport: Use the Get-MailDetailDlpPolicyReport cmdlet to view the details of messages that matched the conditions defined by any data loss prevention (DLP) policies. This cmdlet works on messages that were sent within the last seven days.
descriptions.New-AddressList: Use the New-AddressList cmdlet to create address lists and apply them to recipients.
descriptions.Remove-AuthRedirect: Use the Remove-AuthRedirect cmdlet to remove OAuth redirection objects that are used for legacy Microsoft Exchange 2010 Client Access servers in your organization.
descriptions.Connect-Mailbox: Use the Connect-Mailbox cmdlet to connect disconnected mailboxes to existing user accounts that don't already have mailboxes.
descriptions.Set-MailboxSentItemsConfiguration: Use the Set-MailboxSentItemsConfiguration cmdlet to modify the Sent Items settings for mailboxes in your organization.
descriptions.Get-AuthenticationPolicy: Use the Get-AuthenticationPolicy cmdlet to view authentication policies in your organization. For information about the parameter sets in the Syntax section below, see Exchange cmdlet syntax.
descriptions.Test-OwaConnectivity: Use the Test-OwaConnectivity cmdlet to verify that Microsoft Office Outlook Web App is running as expected. The Test-OwaConnectivity cmdlet can be used to test Outlook Web App connectivity for all Microsoft Exchange Server 2010 virtual directories on a specified Client Access server for all mailboxes on servers running Exchange that are in the same Active Directory site. The Test-OwaConnectivity cmdlet can also be used to test the connectivity for an individual Exchange Outlook Web App URL.
descriptions.Get-ServiceDeliveryReport: Use the Get-ServiceDeliveryReport cmdlet to view information about the message delivery path for a specified recipient.
descriptions.Remove-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin: Use the Remove-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin cmdlet to remove an eDiscovery Administrator from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. To replace all eDiscovery Administrators, use the Update-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-Trust: Use the Get-Trust cmdlet to return external and forest trusts.
descriptions.Export-RecipientDataProperty: Use the Export-RecipientDataProperty cmdlet to download the picture or spoken name audio file of a mailbox or mail contact.
descriptions.Disable-MalwareFilterRule: Use the Disable-MalwareFilterRule cmdlet to disable malware filter rules in your organization.
descriptions.Set-SensitiveInformationScan: Use the Set-SensitiveInformationScan cmdlet to modify on-demand classification scans.
descriptions.Get-LabelPolicy: Use the Get-LabelPolicy cmdlet to view sensitivity label policies in your organization.
descriptions.Set-DeviceConfigurationRule: Use the Set-DeviceConfigurationRule cmdlet to modify mobile device configuration rules in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Remove-MobileDeviceMailboxPolicy: Use the Remove-MobileDeviceMailboxPolicy cmdlet to remove mobile device mailbox policies from Exchange servers.
descriptions.Set-FilePlanPropertyReferenceId: Use the Set-FilePlanPropertyReferenceId cmdlet to modify file plan property reference IDs.
descriptions.Move-OfflineAddressBook: Use the Move-OfflineAddressBook cmdlet to designate a new server that's responsible for generating the offline address book (OAB) in Exchange Server 2010. This cmdlet isn't used on OABs in Exchange Server 2016 or Exchange Server 2013. To perform this task in Exchange 2016 or Exchange 2013, use the Set-OfflineAddressBook cmdlet with the GeneratingMailbox parameter.
descriptions.Remove-EOPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Remove-EOPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to remove rules for the built-in security features for all cloud mailboxes in preset security policies. The rules specify recipient conditions and exceptions for the protection, and also allow you to turn on and turn off the associated preset security policies.
descriptions.Get-SafeLinksDetailReport: Use the Get-SafeLinksDetailReport cmdlet to return detailed information about Safe Links results for the last 7 days. Yesterday is the most recent date that you can specify.
descriptions.New-MessageClassification: Use the New-MessageClassification cmdlet to create a message classification instance in your organization.
descriptions.Set-MailboxCalendarFolder: Use the Set-MailboxCalendarFolder cmdlet to configure calendar publishing or sharing settings on a mailbox for the visibility of calendar information to external users. To add or modify the permissions so internal users can access the calendar, use the Add-MailboxFolderPermission or Set-MailboxFolderPermission cmdlets.
descriptions.New-QuarantinePolicy: Use the New-QuarantinePolicy cmdlet to create quarantine policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-App: Use the Set-App cmdlet to modify the availability of organization apps.
descriptions.Get-TenantAllowBlockListItems: Use the Get-TenantAllowBlockListItems cmdlet to view entries in the Tenant Allow/Block List in the Microsoft Defender portal.
descriptions.Get-UMAutoAttendant: Use the Get-UMAutoAttendant cmdlet to retrieve the properties and the values for a Unified Messaging (UM) auto attendant.
descriptions.Get-TextMessagingAccount: Use the Get-TextMessagingAccount cmdlet to view the text notification settings on mailboxes.
descriptions.New-FilePlanPropertyDepartment: Use the New-FilePlanPropertyDepartment cmdlet to create file plan property departments.
descriptions.Remove-DeviceConditionalAccessPolicy: Use the Remove-DeviceConditionalAccessPolicy cmdlet to remove mobile device conditional access policies from Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Get-MessageCategory: Use the Get-MessageCategory cmdlet to retrieve a message category from the specified mailbox.
descriptions.Restore-DetailsTemplate: Use the Restore-DetailsTemplate cmdlet to restore the specified template to its default state.
descriptions.New-OwaVirtualDirectory: Use the New-OwaVirtualDirectory cmdlet to create Outlook on the web virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services on Exchange servers. Typically, you create virtual directories on Exchange servers that have the Client Access server role installed.
descriptions.Set-FocusedInbox: Use the Set-FocusedInbox cmdlet to enable or disable Focused Inbox for mailboxes in your organization.
descriptions.Export-MigrationReport: The Export-MigrationReport is used by the Exchange migration process to enable an administrator to download a CSV file that contains migration errors for a selected migration batch. This cmdlet isn't run by an administrator in Windows PowerShell.
descriptions.Get-AdminAuditLogConfig: Use the Get-AdminAuditLogConfig cmdlet to view the administrator audit logging configuration settings.
descriptions.Get-OMEMessageStatus: Use the Get-OMEMessageStatus cmdlet to view the Microsoft Purview Message Encryption revocation status for a specific message.
descriptions.Enable-MetaCacheDatabase: Use the Enable-MetaCacheDatabase cmdlet to enable the metacache database on Exchange 2019 Mailbox servers. The metacache database stores mailbox database indexes and secondary copies of metadata on solid state drives (SSDs) to improve search latency and user logons.
descriptions.Get-RemoteDomain: Use the Get-RemoteDomain cmdlet to view the configuration information for the remote domains configured in your organization. You can view the remote domain configuration from inside the Exchange organization or from an Edge Transport server in the perimeter network.
descriptions.Get-TransportPipeline: Use the Get-TransportPipeline cmdlet to view transport agents and the SMTP event where the transport agent is registered.
descriptions.Set-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation: Use the Set-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation cmdlet to configure mailbox audit logging bypass for user or computer accounts such as service accounts for applications that access mailboxes frequently.
descriptions.Set-CASMailboxPlan: Use the Set-CASMailboxPlan cmdlet to modify Client Access services (CAS) mailbox plans in cloud-based organizations.
descriptions.Get-MailboxTransportService: Use the Get-MailboxTransportService cmdlet to view the configuration of the Mailbox Transport service on Exchange 2013 or later Mailbox servers.
descriptions.New-RpcClientAccess: Use the New-RpcClientAccess cmdlet to create configuration information for the Exchange RPC Client Access service on a Client Access server. This set up task is performed by default on new installations of the Client Access server role on Microsoft Exchange Server 2010.
descriptions.Remove-DistributionGroup: Use the Remove-DistributionGroup cmdlet to remove distribution groups and mail-enabled security groups.
descriptions.Test-OutlookWebServices: Use the Test-OutlookWebServices cmdlet to verify the Autodiscover service settings for Microsoft Outlook on a computer running Microsoft Exchange Server 2010 that has the Client Access server role installed.
descriptions.Get-SensitiveInformationScan: Use the Get-SensitiveInformationScan cmdlet to view the properties of sensitive information scans.
descriptions.New-DeviceTenantRule: Use the New-DeviceTenantRule cmdlet to create your organization's mobile device tenant rule in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Enable-ServiceEmailChannel: Use the Enable-ServiceEmailChannel cmdlet to enable the .NET service channel for a specific user.
descriptions.Get-ComplianceSecurityFilter: Use the Get-ComplianceSecurityFilter cmdlet to view compliance security filters in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. These filters allow specified users to search only a subset of mailboxes and SharePoint or OneDrive sites in your Microsoft 365 organization.
descriptions.New-ExchangeSettings: Use the New-ExchangeSettings cmdlet to create customized Exchange setting objects that are stored in Active Directory. Use the Set-ExchangeSettings cmdlet to configure the actual settings.
descriptions.Set-Contact: Use the Set-Contact cmdlet to modify contact object settings. If the contact is a mail contact, you can use the Set-MailContact cmdlet to modify other Microsoft Exchange settings that aren't available by using the Set-Contact cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-ClientAccessRule: > [!NOTE] > Client access rules were deprecated for all Exchange Online organizations in September 2025. For more information, see Update on Client Access Rules Deprecation in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Export-DlpPolicyCollection: Use the Export-DlpPolicyCollection cmdlet to export data loss prevention (DLP) policy collections that are based on transport rules (mail flow rules) from your organization to a file.
descriptions.Get-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule: Use the Get-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule cmdlet to view outbound spam filter rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.New-DlpSensitiveInformationType: Use the New-DlpSensitiveInformationType cmdlet to create sensitive information type rules that use document fingerprints.
descriptions.Set-PolicyConfig: Use the Set-PolicyConfig cmdlet to modify the endpoint restrictions that are configured in the organization.
descriptions.New-ExchangeCertificate: Use the New-ExchangeCertificate cmdlet to create and renew self-signed certificates, and to create certificate requests (also known as certificate signing requests or CSRs) for new certificates and certificate renewals from a certification authority (CA).
descriptions.Remove-ResubmitRequest: Use the Remove-ResubmitRequest cmdlet to remove requests to replay redundant copies of messages from Safety Net after a mailbox database recovery.
descriptions.New-AutoSensitivityLabelRule: Use the New-AutoSensitivityLabelRule cmdlet to create auto-labeling rules and associate then with auto-labeling policies in your organization.
descriptions.Disable-MailUser: Use the Disable-MailUser cmdlet to remove email capabilities from existing mail users.
descriptions.Get-RetentionCompliancePolicy: Use the Get-RetentionCompliancePolicy to view existing retention policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-FederatedOrganizationIdentifier: Use the Set-FederatedOrganizationIdentifier cmdlet to configure the federated organization identifier for the Exchange organization.
descriptions.Remove-AvailabilityReportOutage: Use the Remove-AvailabilityReportOutage cmdlet to remove existing outages that have been added with the New-AvailabilityReportOutage cmdlet. Other outages must be modified with the Set-AvailabilityReportOutage cmdlet.
descriptions.New-DeliveryAgentConnector: The New-DeliveryAgentConnector cmdlet creates a delivery agent connector in your organization.
descriptions.New-OutlookProvider: Use the New-OutlookProvider cmdlet to create the AutoDiscoverConfig object and then populate the object with relevant settings.
descriptions.Get-InformationBarrierRecipientStatus: Use the Get-InformationBarrierRecipientStatus cmdlet to return information about recipients and their relationship to information barrier policies.
descriptions.Enable-UMService: Use the Enable-UMService cmdlet to set the status of an Exchange Server 2010 Unified Messaging (UM) server to enabled. This setting enables the Unified Messaging server to process UM calls.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxFolderPermission: Use the Remove-MailboxFolderPermission cmdlet to remove folder-level permissions for users in mailboxes.
descriptions.Enable-AntiPhishRule: Use the Enable-AntiPhishRule cmdlet to enable antiphish rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-CalendarDiagnosticObjects: Use the Get-CalendarDiagnosticObjects cmdlet to collect a range of calendar logs. The calendar diagnostic logs track important calendar-related event data for each mailbox, and can be used to troubleshoot calendar issues that occur in mailboxes. The logs track all calendar items and meeting messages.
descriptions.Set-IPBlockListConfig: Use the Set-IPBlockListConfig cmdlet to modify the IP Block list configuration that's used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Set-DlpSensitiveInformationTypeRulePacka: Use the Set-DlpSensitiveInformationTypeRulePackage cmdlet to update existing data loss prevention (DLP) sensitive information type rule packages in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-DlpCompliancePolicy: Use the New-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. DLP policies contain DLP rules that identify, monitor, and protect sensitive information.
descriptions.Update-AddressList: Use the Update-AddressList cmdlet to update the recipients included in address lists.
descriptions.Start-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup: Use the Start-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup cmdlet to reincorporate one or more previously failed members of a database availability group (DAG).
descriptions.Get-MailboxImportRequestStatistics: Use the Get-MailboxImportRequestStatistics cmdlet to view detailed information about import requests.
descriptions.Set-ServerComponentState: Use the Set-ServerComponentState cmdlet to configure and update Microsoft Exchange components and endpoints on servers you specify.
descriptions.New-TeamsProtectionPolicyRule: Use the New-TeamsProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to create Microsoft Teams protection policy rules.
descriptions.New-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy: Use the New-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy cmdlet to create outbound spam filter policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-MailboxExportRequestStatistics: Use the Get-MailboxExportRequestStatistics cmdlet to view detailed information about export requests.
descriptions.Set-OrganizationRelationship: Use the Set-OrganizationRelationship cmdlet to modify existing organization relationships. Organization relationships define the settings that are used with external Exchange organizations to access calendar free/busy information or to move mailboxes between on-premises Exchange servers and Exchange Online as part of hybrid deployments.
descriptions.Get-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupNetwork: Use the Get-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupNetwork cmdlet to display configuration and state information for a database availability group (DAG) network.
descriptions.New-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup: Use the New-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup cmdlet to create a database availability group (DAG).
descriptions.Get-DetailZapReport: Use the Get-DetailZapReport cmdlet to view details about zero-hour auto purge (ZAP) activity. By default, the cmdlet shows the last three days of activity, but you can specify up to ten days.
descriptions.Suspend-PublicFolderMoveRequest: Use the Suspend-PublicFolderMoveRequest cmdlet to suspend a move request any time after the move request was created, but before it reaches the status of CompletionInProgress. You can resume the move request by using the Resume-PublicFolderMoveRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Invoke-ChangeMeetingOrganizer: Use the Invoke-ChangeMeetingOrganizer cmdlet to change the organizer of an existing meeting or meeting series.
descriptions.New-ProtectionAlert: Use the New-ProtectionAlert cmdlet to create alert policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal and the Microsoft Defender portal. Alert policies contain conditions that define the user activities to monitor, and the notification options for email alerts and entries.
descriptions.Set-MailboxFolderPermission: Use the Set-MailboxFolderPermission cmdlet to modify folder-level permissions for users in mailboxes. This cmdlet differs from the Add-MailboxFolderPermission cmdlet in that it modifies existing permission entries. To configure calendar publishing or sharing settings for a mailbox so calendar information is visible to external users, use the Set-MailboxCalendarFolder cmdlet.
descriptions.Set-LdapDirectory: Use the Set-LdapDirectory cmdlet to modify LDAP directory configurations.
descriptions.Restore-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup: Use the Restore-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup cmdlet as part of a datacenter switchover of a database availability group (DAG).
descriptions.Remove-ManagementRole: Use the Remove-ManagementRole cmdlet to remove custom management roles that you don't need anymore.
descriptions.Remove-OutlookProvider: Use the Remove-OutlookProvider cmdlet to delete the AutoDiscoverConfig object from Active Directory.
descriptions.Set-CalendarNotification: The Set-CalendarNotification cmdlet allows users to set text message notification options for calendar events in their own calendar. By default, the MyTextMessaging end-user role gives access to this cmdlet, so admins can't configure text messaging notification for calendar events in user calendars.
descriptions.Set-TenantAllowBlockListItems: Use the Set-TenantAllowBlockListItems cmdlet to modify entries in the Tenant Allow/Block List in the Microsoft Defender portal.
descriptions.Get-RetentionPolicyTag: Use the Get-RetentionPolicyTag cmdlet to retrieve settings for a retention tag.
descriptions.New-DkimSigningConfig: Use the New-DkimSigningConfig cmdlet to create the DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) signing policy settings for domains in a cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Redirect-Message: Use the Redirect-Message cmdlet to drain the active messages from all the delivery queues on a Mailbox server, and transfer those messages to another Mailbox server.
descriptions.Get-HistoricalSearch: Use the Get-HistoricalSearch cmdlet to view information about historical searches that have been performed within the last ten days.
descriptions.Set-ResourceConfig: Use the Set-ResourceConfig cmdlet to create custom resource properties that you can add to room and equipment mailboxes.
descriptions.New-DlpKeywordDictionary: Use the New-DlpKeywordDictionary cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) keyword dictionaries in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-HVEAppAccess: Use the Remove-HVEAppAccess cmdlet to remove applications from the Allowed Apps list of a High Volume Email (HVE) account.
descriptions.Test-MigrationServerAvailability: Use the Test-MigrationServerAvailability cmdlet to test the availability of the target server in preparation to perform cross-forest mailbox moves, migration of on-premises mailboxes to Exchange Online, or to migrate on-premises mailbox data from an IMAP server to Exchange Online mailboxes. For all migration types, the cmdlet attempts to verify the connection settings used to connect to the target server.
descriptions.Set-AttachmentFilterListConfig: Use the Set-AttachmentFilterListConfig cmdlet to modify the configuration of the Attachment Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Get-FilePlanPropertyCitation: Use the Get-FilePlanPropertyCitation cmdlet to view file plan property citations.
descriptions.Get-FrontendTransportService: Use the Get-FrontEndTransportService cmdlet to view the configuration of the Front End Transport service on Exchange 2013 or later servers that have the Client Access server role installed.
descriptions.Set-SweepRule: Use the Set-SweepRule cmdlet to modify Sweep rules in mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-FederatedOrganizationIdentifier: Use the Get-FederatedOrganizationIdentifier cmdlet to retrieve the Exchange organization's federated organization identifier and related details, such as federated domains, organization contact and status.
descriptions.Disable-TransportAgent: Use the Disable-TransportAgent cmdlet to disable a transport agent.
descriptions.New-EOPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the New-EOPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to create rules for the built-in security features for all cloud mailboxes in preset security policies. The rules specify recipient conditions and exceptions for the protection, and also allow you to turn on and turn off the associated preset security policies.
descriptions.Get-Mailbox: Use the Get-Mailbox cmdlet to view mailbox objects and attributes, populate property pages, or supply mailbox information to other tasks.
descriptions.Get-MailboxRepairRequest: Use the Get-MailboxRepairRequest cmdlet to display information about current mailbox repair requests. Mailbox repair requests are created using the New-MailboxRepairRequest cmdlet to detect and fix mailbox corruptions.
descriptions.Get-AppRetentionComplianceRule: Use the Get-AppRetentionComplianceRule to view app retention compliance rules.
descriptions.New-RemoteDomain: Use the New-RemoteDomain cmdlet to create a managed connection for a remote domain. When you create a remote domain, you can control mail flow with more precision, apply message formatting and messaging policies and specify acceptable character sets for messages sent to and received from the remote domain.
descriptions.Set-IPBlockListProvidersConfig: Use the Set-IPBlockListProvidersConfig cmdlet to modify the settings that affect all IP Block list providers that are configured on an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Set-UMAutoAttendant: Use the Set-UMAutoAttendant cmdlet to modify an existing Unified Messaging (UM) auto attendant.
descriptions.Get-DataEncryptionPolicy: Use the Get-DataEncryptionPolicy cmdlet to view data encryption policies in Exchange Online.
descriptions.New-ManagementRoleAssignment: Use the New-ManagementRoleAssignment cmdlet to assign a management role to a management role group, management role assignment policy, user, or universal security group (USG).
descriptions.Remove-Label: Use the Remove-Label cmdlet to remove sensitivity labels from your organization.
descriptions.Set-AtpPolicyForO365: Use the Set-AtpPolicyForO365 cmdlet to modify the settings for the following features in Microsoft Defender for Office 365:
descriptions.Get-MailboxExportRequest: Use the Get-MailboxExportRequest cmdlet to view the detailed status of an ongoing export request that was initiated by using the New-MailboxExportRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Search-MailboxAuditLog: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet will be deprecated in the cloud-based service. To access audit log data, use the Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet. For more information, see this blog post: <https://aka.ms/AuditCmdletBlog>.
descriptions.Set-ComplianceSecurityFilter: Use the Set-ComplianceSecurityFilter cmdlet to modify compliance security filters in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-DataClassification: Use the Set-DataClassification cmdlet to modify data classification rules that use document fingerprints.
descriptions.Get-AdaptiveScope: Use the Get-AdaptiveScope cmdlet to view adaptive scopes in your organization. Adaptive scopes (or static scopes) are used in retention policies and retention label policies.
descriptions.Set-OrganizationConfig: Use the Set-OrganizationConfig cmdlet to configure various settings of an Exchange organization.
descriptions.Remove-OMEConfiguration: Use the Remove-OMEConfiguration cmdlet to remove custom Microsoft Purview Message Encryption configurations. You can't use this cmdlet to remove the default OME configuration.
descriptions.Add-MailboxDatabaseCopy: Use the Add-MailboxDatabaseCopy cmdlet to create a passive copy of an existing active mailbox database.
descriptions.Get-IPBlockListProvider: Use the Get-IPBlockListProvider cmdlet to view IP Block list providers that are used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Set-MalwareFilteringServer: Use the Set-MalwareFilteringServer cmdlet to configure the Malware agent settings in the Transport service on a Mailbox server.
descriptions.Get-TransportRulePredicate: Use the Get-TransportRulePredicate cmdlet to view the predicates (conditions and exceptions) that are available for transport rules (mal flow rules).
descriptions.Get-RoleGroupMember: Use the Get-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to retrieve a list of members of a management role group.
descriptions.Enable-SafeLinksRule: Use the Enable-SafeLinksRule cmdlet to enable disabled Safe Links rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Test-EcpConnectivity: Use the Test-EcpConnectivity cmdlet to test connectivity to Exchange Control Panel (ECP) virtual directories.
descriptions.Remove-ContentFilterPhrase: Use the Remove-ContentFilterPhrase cmdlet to remove one or all custom words that the Content Filter agent processes.
descriptions.Set-RegulatoryComplianceUI: Use the Set-RegulatoryComplianceUI cmdlet to display the UI option in retention label settings to mark content as a regulatory record.
descriptions.Test-SystemHealth: Use the Test-SystemHealth cmdlet to gather data about your Microsoft Exchange system and to analyze the data according to best practices.
descriptions.Get-TransportRule: Use the Get-TransportRule cmdlet to view transport rules (mail flow rules) in your organization.
descriptions.Get-ActiveSyncDeviceAccessRule: Use the Get-ActiveSyncDeviceAccessRule cmdlet to retrieve an access group of Exchange mobile devices along with their access level.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolder: Use the Get-PublicFolder cmdlet to retrieve the attributes of a public folder or a set of public folders.
descriptions.New-FilePlanPropertySubCategory: Use the New-FilePlanPropertySubCategory cmdlet to create file plan property subcategories.
descriptions.New-PublicFolderDatabase: Use the New-PublicFolderDatabase cmdlet to create a public folder database.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxUserConfiguration: Use the Remove-MailboxUserConfiguration cmdlet to remove user configuration items from mailboxes. Typically, after you delete a user configuration item, it's automatically recreated the next time the user uses that feature in their mailbox.
descriptions.New-RemoteMailbox: Use the New-RemoteMailbox cmdlet to create a mail user in the on-premises Active Directory and also create an associated mailbox in the cloud-based service.
descriptions.Remove-IPAllowListProvider: Use the Remove-IPAllowListProvider cmdlet to remove IP Allow list providers that are used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Add-GlobalMonitoringOverride: Use the Add-GlobalMonitoringOverride cmdlet to override the thresholds and parameters of the managed availability probes, monitors and responders on all Exchange 2013 or later servers in your organization. The cmdlet enables monitoring changes and threshold tuning to the environment.
descriptions.Get-MailFlowStatusReport: Use the Get-MailFlowStatusReport cmdlet to return the message counts for a specific date range organized by the final disposition of the message for the last 90 days.
descriptions.Get-FailedContentIndexDocuments: Use the Get-FailedContentIndexDocuments cmdlet to retrieve a list of documents for a mailbox, mailbox database, or Mailbox server that couldn't be indexed by Exchange Search.
descriptions.Get-EcpVirtualDirectory: Use the Get-EcpVirtualDirectory cmdlet to view Exchange Control Panel (ECP) virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers. The Exchange admin center (EAC) uses the ECP virtual directories.
descriptions.Set-ReportSubmissionRule: Use the Set-ReportSubmissionRule cmdlet to modify the report submission rule in your cloud-based organization. The report submission rule identifies the reporting mailbox where user reported messages are delivered.
descriptions.Add-IPBlockListEntry: Use the Add-IPBlockListEntry cmdlet to add IP Block list entries to the IP Block list that's used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Get-MoveRequestStatistics: Use the Get-MoveRequestStatistics cmdlet to view detailed information about move requests.
descriptions.Get-InboundConnector: Use the Get-InboundConnector cmdlet to view the settings for an Inbound connector in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Import-TransportRuleCollection: Use the Import-TransportRuleCollection cmdlet to import a transport rule collection. You can import a rule collection you previously exported as a backup, or import rules that you've exported from an older version of Exchange.
descriptions.Remove-DynamicDistributionGroup: Use the Remove-DynamicDistributionGroup cmdlet to delete dynamic distribution groups.
descriptions.Get-OabVirtualDirectory: Use the Get-OabVirtualDirectory cmdlet to view offline address book (OAB) virtual directories(OAB distribution points) that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.Get-PerimeterConfig: Use the Get-PerimeterConfig cmdlet to view the list of gateway server and internal mail server IP addresses that have been added to the cloud-based safelists.
descriptions.New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy: Use the New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy to create app retention compliance policies. App retention & labeling policies target new ways to scope and manage policies.
descriptions.Get-AdministrativeUnit: Use the Get-AdministrativeUnit cmdlet to view administrative units, which are Microsoft Entra containers of resources. You can use administrative units to delegate administrative permissions and apply policies to different groups of users.
descriptions.Remove-PublicFolder: Use the Remove-PublicFolder cmdlet to remove an existing public folder.
descriptions.Get-AddressRewriteEntry: Use the Get-AddressRewriteEntry cmdlet to view an existing address rewrite entry that rewrites sender and recipient email addresses in messages sent to or sent from your organization through an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.New-Mailbox: Use the New-Mailbox cmdlet to create mailboxes and user accounts at the same time.
descriptions.Get-HybridMailflowDatacenterIPs: This cmdlet is deprecated and is no longer used.
descriptions.New-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupNetwork: Use the New-DatabaseAvailabilityGroupNetwork cmdlet to create a database availability group (DAG) network.
descriptions.Set-ExchangeSettings: Use the Set-ExchangeSettings cmdlet to configure Exchange setting objects that you created with the New-ExchangeSettings cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-EventsFromEmailConfiguration: Use the Get-EventsFromEmailConfiguration cmdlet to view the events from email settings on a mailbox. These settings define whether Outlook or Outlook on the web (formerly known as Outlook Web App) automatically discovers events from email messages and adds them to the user's calendar.
descriptions.Remove-App: Use the Remove-App cmdlet to uninstall an app.
descriptions.Get-MailboxRegionalConfiguration: Use the Get-MailboxRegionalConfiguration cmdlet to view the regional settings of a mailbox. You can view the date format, time format, time zone, and language of the mailbox.
descriptions.Remove-BlockedConnector: Use the Remove-BlockedConnector cmdlet to unblock inbound connectors that have been detected as potentially compromised. Blocked connectors are prevented from sending email.
descriptions.Set-TransportRule: Use the Set-TransportRule cmdlet to modify existing transport rules (mail flow rules) in your organization.
descriptions.New-SafeLinksPolicy: Use the New-SafeLinksPolicy cmdlet to create Safe Links policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-UnifiedGroup: Use the Remove-UnifiedGroup cmdlet to remove Microsoft 365 Groups from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.New-TenantAllowBlockListItems: Use the New-TenantAllowBlockListItems cmdlet to add entries to the Tenant Allow/Block List in the Microsoft Defender portal.
descriptions.Get-BlockedSenderAddress: Use the Get-BlockedSenderAddress cmdlet to view users in your Microsoft 365 organization that are affected by the protection system. These users sent multiple messages that were classified as spam, so they're blocked from sending messages.
descriptions.Enable-EOPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Enable-EOPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to turn on the Standard preset security policy or the Strict preset security policy. If your organization has Defender for Office 365, you also need to use the Enable-ATPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to turn on the policy.
descriptions.Remove-DistributionGroupMember: Use the Remove-DistributionGroupMember cmdlet to remove a single member from distribution groups or mail-enabled security groups. To replace all members, use the Update-DistributionGroupMember cmdlet.
descriptions.Remove-DeviceConfigurationPolicy: Use the Remove-DeviceConfigurationPolicy cmdlet to remove mobile device configuration policies from Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Get-FilePlanPropertyCategory: Use the Fet-FilePlanPropertyCategory cmdlet to view file plan property categories.
descriptions.Get-MailboxMessageConfiguration: Use the Get-MailboxMessageConfiguration cmdlet to view the Outlook on the web settings that are applied to specific mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-QuarantineMessage: Use the Get-QuarantineMessage cmdlet to view quarantined messages and files in your cloud-based organization. Files are quarantined by Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.
descriptions.Set-DlpCompliancePolicy: Use the Set-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to modify data loss prevention (DLP) policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-ActiveSyncMailboxPolicy: Use the New-ActiveSyncMailboxPolicy cmdlet to create a Microsoft Mobile Device mailbox policy object.
descriptions.New-DeviceConfigurationPolicy: Use the New-DeviceConfigurationPolicy cmdlet to create mobile device configuration policies in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Add-UnifiedGroupLinks: Use the Add-UnifiedGroupLinks cmdlet to add members, owners and subscribers to Microsoft 365 Groups in your cloud-based organization. To remove members, owners, and subscribers, use the Remove-UnifiedGroupLinks cmdlet. To modify other properties of Microsoft 365 Groups, use the Set-UnifiedGroup cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-ADServerSettings: Use the Get-ADServerSettings cmdlet to view the Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) environment settings in the current Exchange Management Shell session. The Get-ADServerSettings cmdlet replaces the AdminSessionADSettings session variable that was used in Exchange Server 2007.
descriptions.Set-TeamsProtectionPolicy: Use the Set-TeamsProtectionPolicy cmdlet to modify Microsoft Teams protection policies.
descriptions.Get-WebServicesVirtualDirectory: Use the Get-WebServicesVirtualDirectory cmdlet to view Exchange Web Services (EWS) virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.Get-EXOMailboxFolderPermission: Use the Get-ExOMailboxFolderPermission cmdlet to view folder-level permissions in mailboxes.
descriptions.New-UMMailboxPolicy: Use the New-UMMailboxPolicy cmdlet to create a Unified Messaging (UM) mailbox policy.
descriptions.Get-ExternalInOutlook: Use the Get-ExternalInOutlook cmdlet to view the configuration of external sender identification that's available in Outlook, Outlook for Mac, Outlook on the web, and Outlook for iOS and Android.
descriptions.Disable-SmtpDaneInbound: Use the Disable-SMTPDaneInbound cmdlet to disable SMTP DNS-based Authentication of Named Entities (DANE) for inbound mail to accepted domains in Exchange Online.
descriptions.New-AdminAuditLogSearch: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet has been deprecated in the cloud-based service. To access audit log data, use the Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet. For more information, see this blog post: <https://aka.ms/AdminAuditCmdletBlog>.
descriptions.Enable-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule: Use the Enable-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule cmdlet to enable outbound spam filter rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-DeviceTenantRule: Use the Get-DeviceTenantRule cmdlet to view your organization's mobile device tenant rule in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Set-MailboxTransportService: Use the Set-MailboxTransportService cmdlet to modify the configuration of the Mailbox Transport service on Exchange 2013 or later Mailbox servers.
descriptions.New-CaseHoldRule: Use the New-CaseHoldRule cmdlet to create new case hold rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Enable-ATPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Enable-ATPProtectionPolicyRule and Enable-EOPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlets together to turn on the Standard preset security policy or the Strict preset security policy in organizations with Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
descriptions.Set-MailboxIRMAccess: Use the Set-MailboxIRMAccess cmdlet to block delegate access to IRM-protected messages in other mailboxes (shared mailboxes or user mailboxes where delegates have Full Access permission).
descriptions.Disable-HostedContentFilterRule: Use the Disable-HostedContentFilterRule cmdlet to disable spam filter rules (content filter rules) in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-ManagementRoleEntry: Use the Remove-ManagementRoleEntry cmdlet to remove existing management role entries.
descriptions.Retry-Queue: Use the Retry-Queue cmdlet to force a connection attempt for a queue on a Mailbox server or an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Set-ATPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Set-ATPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to modify rules that are associated with Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protections in preset security policies.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxSearch: Use the Remove-MailboxSearch cmdlet to remove a mailbox search.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxPermission: Use the Remove-MailboxPermission cmdlet to remove permissions from a user's mailbox or from an Exchange Server 2016, Exchange Server 2019 or Exchange Online mail user.
descriptions.Remove-ComplianceCaseMember: Use the Remove-ComplianceCaseMember cmdlet to remove a single member from an eDiscovery search in Security & Compliance. To replace all existing members, use the Update-ComplianceCaseMember cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-AddressBookPolicy: Use the Get-AddressBookPolicy cmdlet to return address book policies that match the specified conditions.
descriptions.Remove-UMIPGateway: Use the Remove-UMIPGateway cmdlet to delete a Unified Messaging (UM) IP gateway.
descriptions.Remove-AcceptedDomain: Use the Remove-AcceptedDomain cmdlet to remove an accepted domain. When you remove an accepted domain, the accepted domain object is deleted.
descriptions.Set-HVEAccountBillingPolicy: Use the Set-HVEAccountBillingPolicy cmdlet to modify the billing policy mapping for a specified High Volume Email (HVE) account.
descriptions.Remove-SiteMailboxProvisioningPolicy: Use the Remove-SiteMailboxProvisioningPolicy cmdlet to remove site mailbox provisioning policies.
descriptions.Add-PublicFolderAdministrativePermission: Use the Add-PublicFolderAdministrativePermission cmdlet to add administrative permissions to a public folder or a public folder hierarchy.
descriptions.New-QuarantinePermissions: Use the New-QuarantinePermissions cmdlet to create a variable that contains a quarantine permissions object to use with the EndUserQuarantinePermission parameter on the New-QuarantinePolicy or Set-QuarantinePolicy cmdlets in the same PowerShell session.
descriptions.Get-SiteMailbox: Use the Get-SiteMailbox cmdlet to view information about site mailboxes. This cmdlet is primarily used by Microsoft SharePoint and Exchange to display information to users in the user interface. However, you mightht find it helpful for discovering information such as the site mailbox's owners, members, and lifecycle status.
descriptions.Set-SiteMailbox: Use the Set-SiteMailbox cmdlet to change a site mailbox's settings, such as the Microsoft SharePoint URL. This cmdlet is primarily used by the SharePoint and Microsoft Exchange user interfaces, such as the SharePoint URL. This cmdlet should only be used for diagnostic and troubleshooting purposes.
descriptions.Get-FilePlanPropertyDepartment: Use the Get-FilePlanPropertyDepartment cmdlet to view file plan property departments.
descriptions.Set-QuarantinePolicy: Use the Set-QuarantinePolicy cmdlet to modify quarantine policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-EventLogLevel: Use the Set-EventLogLevel cmdlet to set the event log level registry value for the specified category.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderAdministrativePermission: Use the Get-PublicFolderAdministrativePermission cmdlet to get the administrative permissions for a public folder or a public folder hierarchy.
descriptions.Get-MalwareFilteringServer: Use the Get-MalwareFilteringServer cmdlet to view the Malware agent settings in the Transport service on a Mailbox server.
descriptions.Get-OrganizationConfig: Use the Get-OrganizationConfig cmdlet to get configuration data for an Exchange organization.
descriptions.Set-OwaMailboxPolicy: Use the Set-OwaMailboxPolicy cmdlet to configure existing Outlook on the web mailbox policies.
descriptions.Remove-OwaVirtualDirectory: Use the Remove-OwaVirtualDirectory cmdlet to remove Outlook on the web virtual directories from Internet Information Services (IIS) on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-OwaMailboxPolicy: Use the Remove-OwaMailboxPolicy cmdlet to remove Outlook on the web mailbox policies from the organization.
descriptions.Get-EventLogLevel: Use the Get-EventLogLevel cmdlet to display a list of Exchange event categories and the corresponding log levels on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-PolicyTipConfig: Use the Remove-PolicyTipConfig cmdlet to remove custom data loss prevention (DLP) Policy Tips from your organization. You can't remove built-in Policy Tips.
descriptions.Get-VivaInsightsSettings: Use the Get-VivaInsightsSettings cmdlet to check whether a user has access to features in Microsoft Viva Insights in Microsoft Teams. Only users with provisioned Exchange Online mailboxes can access features within the Viva Insights app in Teams.
descriptions.Suspend-Message: Use the Suspend-Message cmdlet to prevent delivery of a particular message in a queue on a Mailbox server or an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.New-SendConnector: Use the New-SendConnector cmdlet to create a new Send connector.
descriptions.Get-MailboxCalendarConfiguration: Use the Get-MailboxCalendarConfiguration cmdlet to show the calendar settings for a specified mailbox.
descriptions.Remove-InformationBarrierPolicy: Use the Remove-InformationBarrierPolicy cmdlet to remove information barrier policies from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-HoldComplianceRule: Use the Remove-HoldComplianceRule cmdlet to remove preservation rules from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-IntraOrganizationConfiguration: Use the Get-IntraOrganizationConfiguration cmdlet to view the component settings of a hybrid Exchange deployment.
descriptions.Stop-HistoricalSearch: Use the Stop-HistoricalSearch cmdlet to stop an existing historical search that has a status value of NotStarted.
descriptions.Remove-TransportRule: Use the Remove-TransportRule cmdlet to remove transport rules (mail flow rules) from your organization.
descriptions.Get-AuditLogSearch: Use the Get-AuditLogSearch cmdlet to return a list of current audit log searches that were created with the New-AdminAuditLogSearch or New-MailboxAuditLogSearch cmdlets. The Get-AuditLogSearch cmdlet also returns audit log searches that are initiated whenever an administrator uses the Exchange admin center (EAC) to export audit logs.
descriptions.Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy: Use the Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy cmdlet to modify outbound spam filter policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-SpoofMailReport: Use the Get-SpoofMailReport cmdlet to view information about spoofed senders in your cloud-based organization for the past 90 days. Spoofing is where the sender of the inbound message is different than the actual source of the message (for example, the sender is lila@contoso.com, but the message was sent from the email infrastructure of fabrikam.com).
descriptions.Set-MailPublicFolder: Use the Set-MailPublicFolder cmdlet to configure the mail-related settings of mail-enabled public folders. If you want to configure basic settings that aren't mail-related, use the Set-PublicFolder cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-IPBlockListEntry: Use the Get-IPBlockListEntry cmdlet to view the IP Block list entries that are used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Set-EmailTenantSettings: Use the Set-EmailTenantSettings cmdlet to enable or disable priority account protection in your Microsoft Defender for Office 365 organization. For more information about priority accounts, see Manage and monitor priority accounts.
descriptions.Add-MailboxFolderPermission: Use the Add-MailboxFolderPermission cmdlet to add folder-level permissions for users in mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy: Use the Get-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy cmdlet to view outbound spam filter policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.New-SharingPolicy: Use the New-SharingPolicy cmdlet to create a sharing policy to regulate how users inside your organization can share calendar and contact information with users outside the organization. Users can only share this information after federation is configured in Exchange. After federation is configured, users can send sharing invitations that comply with a sharing policy to external recipients in other Exchange Server 2010 or later organizations that have federation enabled. A sharing policy needs to get assigned to a mailbox to be effective. If a mailbox doesn't have a specific sharing policy assigned, a default policy enforces the level of sharing permitted for this mailbox.
descriptions.New-FilePlanPropertyAuthority: Use the New-FilePlanPropertyAuthority cmdlet to create file plan property authorities.
descriptions.Get-Clutter: Use the Get-Clutter cmdlet to view Clutter settings for mailboxes in your organization.
descriptions.Disable-PushNotificationProxy: Use the Disable-PushNotificationProxy cmdlet to disable the push notification proxy that's configured between an on-premises Microsoft Exchange organization and a Microsoft 365 organization.
descriptions.Get-ManagementRoleAssignment: Use the Get-ManagementRoleAssignment cmdlet to retrieve management role assignments.
descriptions.Get-ThrottlingPolicy: Use the Get-ThrottlingPolicy cmdlet to view the user throttling settings for one or more throttling policies.
descriptions.Get-ExchangeAssistanceConfig: Use the Get-ExchangeAssistanceConfig cmdlet to view the configuration information for the URLs that Microsoft Exchange Help uses to connect to the source of the documentation.
descriptions.Get-UserBriefingConfig: Use the Get-UserBriefingConfig cmdlet to get the current state of the Briefing email flag for the specified user. For more details about configuring the Briefing email, see Configure Briefing email.
descriptions.Set-SettingOverride: **Caution**: Incorrect usage of the setting override cmdlets can cause serious damage to your Exchange organization. This damage could require you to reinstall Exchange. Only use these cmdlets as instructed by product documentation or under the direction of Microsoft Customer Service and Support.
descriptions.Remove-PublicFolderMailboxMigrationReque: Use the Remove-PublicFolderMailboxMigrationRequest cmdlet to remove individual jobs from public folder migration batches that were created by using the New-MigrationBatch cmdlet.
descriptions.New-MailboxSearch: Use the New-MailboxSearch cmdlet to create a mailbox search and either get an estimate of search results, place search results on In-Place Hold or copy them to a Discovery mailbox. You can also place all contents in a mailbox on hold by not specifying a search query, which accomplishes similar results as Litigation Hold.
descriptions.Set-UserBriefingConfig: Use the Set-UserBriefingConfig cmdlet to enable or disable the Briefing email for a user. For more details about configuring the Briefing email, see Configure Briefing email.
descriptions.Get-DeviceTenantPolicy: Use the Get-DeviceTenantPolicy cmdlet to view your organization's mobile device tenant policy in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Set-ResubmitRequest: Use the Set-ResubmitRequest cmdlet to enable or disable requests to replay redundant copies of messages from Safety Net after a mailbox database recovery.
descriptions.New-RetentionPolicy: Use the New-RetentionPolicy cmdlet to create a retention policy.
descriptions.Get-AgentLog: Use the Get-AgentLog cmdlet to parse log files that you specify as parameters and collect raw statistics from the filtering that anti-spam agents apply during a time period that you specify.
descriptions.Get-MigrationStatistics: Use the Get-MigrationStatistics cmdlet to view detailed information about migration requests.
descriptions.Get-SupervisoryReviewOverallProgressRepo: Use the Get-SupervisoryReviewOverallProgressReport cmdlet to view the total number of supervised communications classified as Pending, Resolved, Compliant, Non-compliant, and Questionable.
descriptions.Remove-ReportSubmissionPolicy: Use the Remove-ReportSubmissionPolicy cmdlet to remove the report submission policy from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-RpcClientAccess: Use the Get-RpcClientAccess cmdlet to view the settings of the Microsoft Exchange RPC Client Access service on Exchange servers that have the Client Access server role installed. These settings affect Outlook clients that connect by using Outlook Anywhere (RPC over HTTP).
descriptions.Get-DeviceConfigurationPolicy: Use the Get-DeviceConfigurationPolicy cmdlet to view mobile device configuration policies in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Set-AvailabilityReportOutage: Use the Set-AvailabilityReportOutage cmdlet to set the outages that contribute to the overall reported availability for the day.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxDatabaseCopy: Use the Remove-MailboxDatabaseCopy cmdlet to remove a passive copy of a mailbox database.
descriptions.Set-UMService: Use the Set-UMService cmdlet to modify the properties of the Microsoft Exchange Unified Messaging service on Exchange 2013 or Exchange 2016 Mailbox servers.
descriptions.Remove-AuthenticationPolicy: Use the Remove-AuthenticationPolicy cmdlet to remove authentication policies from your organization.
descriptions.Get-UMActiveCalls: Use the Get-UMActiveCalls cmdlet to return information about the calls that are active and being processed by the Mailbox server running the Microsoft Exchange Unified Messaging service.
descriptions.Export-TransportRuleCollection: Use the Export-TransportRuleCollection cmdlet to export the transport rules in your organization.
descriptions.Get-MessageClassification: Use the Get-MessageClassification cmdlet to view existing message classifications in your organization.
descriptions.Get-CalendarDiagnosticAnalysis: Although this cmdlet is available in on-premises Exchange and in the cloud-based service, it only works in on-premises Exchange.
descriptions.Get-MailboxRestoreRequest: Use the Get-MailboxRestoreRequest cmdlet to view detailed status of an ongoing restore request that was initiated by using the New-MailboxRestoreRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Enable-OutlookAnywhere: Use the Enable-OutlookAnywhere cmdlet to enable Outlook Anywhere on a computer running Microsoft Exchange Server 2010 that has the Client Access server role installed. Running the Enable-OutlookAnywhere cmdlet enables the server to accept requests from Microsoft Office Outlook 2007 and Outlook 2003 client computers from the Internet by using Outlook Anywhere, also known as RPC over HTTP.
descriptions.Disable-DnssecForVerifiedDomain: Use the Disable-DnssecForVerifiedDomain cmdlet to disable Domain Name System Security (DNSSEC) for inbound mail to accepted domains in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Set-ADSite: Use the Set-ADSite cmdlet to configure the Exchange settings of Active Directory sites.
descriptions.New-AuthServer: Use the New-AuthServer cmdlet to create an authorization server object in Microsoft Exchange and specify its AuthMetadataUrl. Exchange honors tokens issued by the authorization server for access by a partner application.
descriptions.Set-FilePlanPropertyAuthority: Use the Set-FilePlanPropertyAuthority cmdlet to modify file plan property authorities.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderStatistics: Use the Get-PublicFolderStatistics cmdlet to retrieve statistical information about public folders, such as folder size and last logon time.
descriptions.Get-CalendarNotification: Use the Get-CalendarNotification cmdlet to view calendar text message notification settings for a mailbox.
descriptions.New-PublicFolder: Use the New-PublicFolder cmdlet to create a public folder with the specified name.
descriptions.Enable-TransportAgent: Use the Enable-TransportAgent cmdlet to enable a transport agent.
descriptions.Set-DefaultTenantMyAnalyticsFeatureConfi: Use the Set-DefaultTenantMyAnalyticsFeatureConfig cmdlet to update the availability and status of Viva Insights features for the cloud-based organization: digest email, add-in, dashboard, meeting effectiveness survey, and schedule send suggestions.
descriptions.Get-ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory: Use the Get-ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory cmdlet to view Exchange ActiveSync virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.Test-ExchangeSearch: Use the Test-ExchangeSearch cmdlet to test that Exchange Search is currently enabled and is indexing new email messages in a timely manner.
descriptions.Remove-ManagedFolderMailboxPolicy: Use the Remove-ManagedFolderMailboxPolicy cmdlet to delete managed folder mailbox policies.
descriptions.Set-ServerMonitor: Use the Set-ServerMonitor cmdlet to edit or set a parameter on a single monitor on an Exchange server.
descriptions.New-SafeAttachmentPolicy: Use the New-SafeAttachmentPolicy cmdlet to create safe attachment policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Resume-PublicFolderMigrationRequest: Use the Resume-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet to resume serial public folder migration requests (requests created by the New-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet) that have failed or have been suspended (manually or automatically).
descriptions.Disable-AddressListPaging: Use the Disable-AddressListPaging cmdlet to disable Active Directory virtual list view for address lists. Virtual list view displays address lists in your organization as pages instead of loading and viewing the entire directory.
descriptions.Get-ActiveSyncDeviceClass: Use the Get-ActiveSyncDeviceClass cmdlet to retrieve a list of ActiveSync devices that have connected to your organization. The cmdlet returns the mobile device type and model information.
descriptions.Set-ManagementRoleAssignment: Use the Set-ManagementRoleAssignment cmdlet to modify existing management role assignments.
descriptions.Remove-WebServicesVirtualDirectory: Use the Remove-WebServicesVirtualDirectory cmdlet to remove existing Exchange Web Services virtual directories from Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-Mailbox: Use the Remove-Mailbox cmdlet to delete mailboxes and the associated user accounts.
descriptions.Export-Message: Use the Export-Message cmdlet to copy a message from a queue on a Mailbox server or an Edge Transport server to a specified file path in your organization.
descriptions.Get-MailDetailEncryptionReport: Use the Get-MailDetailEncryptionReport cmdlet to view the details of encryption in your cloud-based organization for the last 10 days.
descriptions.Set-MailboxRegionalConfiguration: Use the Set-MailboxRegionalConfiguration cmdlet to modify the regional settings of a mailbox. You can modify the date format, time format, time zone and language of the mailbox.
descriptions.Disable-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule: Use the Disable-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule cmdlet to disable outbound spam filter rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-DnssecStatusForVerifiedDomain: Use the Get-DnssecStatusForVerifiedDomain cmdlet to view information about Domain Name System Security (DNSSEC) for accepted domains in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Enable-UMAutoAttendant: Use the Enable-UMAutoAttendant cmdlet to enable an existing Unified Messaging (UM) auto attendant that's disabled.
descriptions.New-ClassificationRuleCollection: Use the New-ClassificationRuleCollection cmdlet to import new classification rule collections into your organization.
descriptions.Search-UnifiedAuditLog: Use the Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet to search the unified audit log. This log contains events from Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Teams, Power BI, and other Microsoft 365 services. You can search for all events in a specified date range, or you can filter the results based on specific criteria, such as the user who performed the action, the action, or the target object.
descriptions.Get-UMHuntGroup: Use the Get-UMHuntGroup cmdlet to display the properties and values for an existing Unified Messaging (UM) hunt group.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxIRMAccess: Use the Remove-MailboxIRMAccess cmdlet to allow (unblock) delegate access to IRM-protected messages in other mailboxes (shared mailboxes or user mailboxes where delegates have Full Access permission).
descriptions.Remove-ComplianceSearch: Use the Remove-ComplianceSearch cmdlet to remove compliance searches from Exchange Server 2016 and from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. The searches must be stopped or completed.
descriptions.Get-Queue: Use the Get-Queue cmdlet to view configuration information for queues on Mailbox servers or Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Remove-SyncMailPublicFolder: The Remove-SyncMailPublicFolder cmdlet is used by the Sync-MailPublicFolders.ps1 script to remove mail-enabled public folder recipient objects from Exchange Online (the script synchronizes mail-enabled public folder objects from the source on-premises Exchange organization to Exchange Online). Don't use this cmdlet unless you are directed to do so by Microsoft Customer Service and Support or by specific documentation.
descriptions.New-ReceiveConnector: Use the New-ReceiveConnector cmdlet to create Receive connectors on Mailbox servers and Edge Transport servers. Receive connectors listen for inbound SMTP connections on the Exchange server.
descriptions.Get-User: Use the Get-User cmdlet to view existing user objects in your organization. This cmdlet returns all objects that have user accounts (for example, user mailboxes, mail users, and user accounts).
descriptions.Remove-IPBlockListEntry: Use the Remove-IPBlockListEntry cmdlet to remove IP block list entries that are used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Resume-MailboxImportRequest: Use the Resume-MailboxImportRequest cmdlet to resume an import request that was suspended or failed.
descriptions.Set-ActiveSyncMailboxPolicy: Use the Set-ActiveSyncMailboxPolicy cmdlet to apply a variety of Mobile Device mailbox policy settings to a server. You can set any of the parameters by using one command.
descriptions.Set-EdgeSyncServiceConfig: Use the Set-EdgeSyncServiceConfig cmdlet to modify the configuration of edge synchronization service settings that control the general synchronization behavior shared by all EdgeSync services.
descriptions.New-IntraOrganizationConnector: Use the New-IntraOrganizationConnector cmdlet to create an Intra-Organization connector between two on-premises Exchange forests in an organization, between an Exchange on-premises organization and an Exchange Online organization, or between two Exchange Online organizations. This connector enables feature availability and service connectivity across the organizations using a common connector and connection endpoints.
descriptions.Get-OwaVirtualDirectory: Use the Get-OwaVirtualDirectory cmdlet to view Outlook on the web virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.Set-HoldCompliancePolicy: Use the Set-HoldCompliancePolicy cmdlet to modify existing preservation policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-BillingPolicy: Use the Get-BillingPolicy cmdlet to return detailed information about Microsoft 365 pay-as-you-go billing policies for High Volume Email configured for your organization.
descriptions.Get-MigrationUser: Use the Get-MigrationUser cmdlet to view information about move and migration users.
descriptions.Get-ExchangeDiagnosticInfo: Use the Get-ExchangeDiagnosticInfo cmdlet to return information about processes that are running on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Set-ReceiveConnector: Use the Set-ReceiveConnector cmdlet to modify Receive connectors on Mailbox servers and Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Set-MailboxJunkEmailConfiguration: Use the Set-MailboxJunkEmailConfiguration cmdlet to configure the junk email settings on mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-OfflineAddressBook: Use the Get-OfflineAddressBook cmdlet to view offline address books (OABs).
descriptions.Disable-RemoteMailbox: Use the Disable-RemoteMailbox cmdlet to remove user mailboxes from the cloud-based service but keep the associated user objects in the on-premises Active Directory.
descriptions.New-UMAutoAttendant: Use the New-UMAutoAttendant cmdlet to create a Unified Messaging (UM) auto attendant.
descriptions.Remove-ApplicationAccessPolicy: Use the Remove-ApplicationAccessPolicy cmdlet to remove application access policies. These changes might take up to 30 minutes to go live.
descriptions.Set-SafeLinksRule: Use the Set-SafeLinksRule cmdlet to create Safe Links rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicyAssign: Use the Set-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicyAssignment cmdlet to assign a Microsoft 365 data-at-rest encryption policy at the tenant level.
descriptions.Get-OnlineMeetingConfiguration: Use the Get-OnlineMeetingConfiguration cmdlet to view status and usage information about Skype Meetings and Skype for Business Online for mailboxes. Skype Meetings automatically includes Skype for Business Online conference join information in Exchange Online meeting invitations.
descriptions.Remove-RetentionComplianceRule: Use the Remove-RetentionComplianceRule cmdlet to remove retention rules from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-UnifiedGroupLinks: Use the Remove-UnifiedGroupLinks cmdlet to remove members, owners, and subscribers from Microsoft 365 Groups in your cloud-based organization. To add members, owners and subscribers, use the Add-UnifiedGroupLinks cmdlet. To modify other properties of Microsoft 365 Groups, use the Set-UnifiedGroup cmdlet.
descriptions.New-InformationBarrierPolicy: Use the New-InformationBarrierPolicy cmdlet to create information barrier policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-HybridConfiguration: Use the Remove-HybridConfiguration cmdlet to delete the HybridConfigurationActive Directory object for your on-premises Exchange organization.
descriptions.Get-MailPublicFolder: Use the Get-MailPublicFolder cmdlet to retrieve mail-related information about mail-enabled public folders. If you want information about the basic (not mail-related) settings of mail-enabled public folders, use the Get-PublicFolder cmdlet instead.
descriptions.Get-ExoInformationBarrierPolicy: Use the Get-ExoInformationBarrierPolicy cmdlet to view information barrier policies in your Exchange Online organization.
descriptions.Set-OabVirtualDirectory: Use the Set-OABVirtualDirectory cmdlet to modify offline address book (OAB) virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Install-TransportAgent: Use the Install-TransportAgent cmdlet to register transport agents on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-LabelPolicy: Use the Remove-LabelPolicies cmdlet to remove sensitivity label policies from your organization.
descriptions.Remove-DeviceConfigurationRule: Use the Remove-DeviceConfigurationRule cmdlet to remove mobile device configuration rules from Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Test-MAPIConnectivity: Use the Test-MapiConnectivity cmdlet to verify server functionality by logging on to the mailbox that you specify. If you don't specify a mailbox, the cmdlet logs on to the SystemMailbox on the database that you specify.
descriptions.Get-FilePlanPropertyStructure: Use the Get-FilePlanPropertyStructure cmdlet to the view file plan property structure in your organization.
descriptions.Export-ExchangeCertificate: Use the Export-ExchangeCertificate cmdlet to export existing certificates and pending certificate requests (also known as certificate signing requests or CSRs) from Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-AutoSensitivityLabelRule: Use the Remove-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy cmdlet to remove auto-labeling policy rules from your organization.
descriptions.Get-EXOMailbox: Use the Get-EXOMailbox cmdlet to view mailbox objects and attributes, populate property pages, or supply mailbox information to other tasks.
descriptions.New-SupervisoryReviewRule: Use the New-SupervisoryReviewRule cmdlet to create supervisory review rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Supervisory review lets you define policies that capture communications in your organization so they can be examined by internal or external reviewers.
descriptions.Get-ExchangeServerAccessLicenseUser: Use the Get-ExchangeServerAccessLicenseUser cmdlet to return a list of unique users for the specified license name. Each object contains the FQDN or primary SMTP address of the mailbox and the license that's associated with it.
descriptions.Get-SearchDocumentFormat: Use the Get-SearchDocumentFormat cmdlet to retrieve details of file formats supported by Exchange Search.
descriptions.Get-CASMailbox: Use the Get-CASMailbox cmdlet to view the Client Access settings that are configured on mailboxes.
descriptions.Remove-SupervisoryReviewPolicyV2: Use the Remove-SupervisoryReviewPolicyV2 cmdlet to remove supervisory review policies from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-ExoInformationBarrierRelationship: Use the Get-ExoInformationBarrierRelationship cmdlet to view information barrier relationships in your Exchange Online organization.
descriptions.Get-ADSite: Use the Get-ADSite cmdlet to display configuration information about one or more Active Directory sites.
descriptions.Get-AntiPhishRule: Use the Get-AntiPhishRule cmdlet to view antiphish rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-AddressBookPolicy: Use the Set-AddressBookPolicy cmdlet to change the settings of an address book policy.
descriptions.Get-HybridConfiguration: Use the Get-HybridConfiguration cmdlet to view the hybrid configuration for the Microsoft Exchange organization.
descriptions.Set-DkimSigningConfig: Use the Set-DkimSigningConfig cmdlet to modify the DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) signing policy settings for domains in a cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-InformationBarrierPoliciesApplicatio: Use the Get-InformationBarrierPoliciesApplicationStatus cmdlet to view the application status of information barrier policies.
descriptions.Get-MailboxIRMAccess: Use the Get-MailboxIRMAccess cmdlet to view delegate access to IRM-protected messages in other mailboxes (shared mailboxes or user mailboxes where delegates have Full Access permission).
descriptions.Remove-ReceiveConnector: Use the Remove-ReceiveConnector cmdlet to remove Receive connectors from Mailbox servers and Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Get-RoleGroup: Use the Get-RoleGroup cmdlet to retrieve a list of management role groups.
descriptions.Stop-MigrationBatch: Use the Stop-MigrationBatch cmdlet to stop the processing of a migration batch that's in progress.
descriptions.Get-FeatureConfiguration: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet is currently available in Public Preview, isn't available in all organizations, and is subject to change.
descriptions.Set-TenantAllowBlockListSpoofItems: Use the Set-TenantAllowBlockListSpoofItems cmdlet to modify spoofed sender entries in the Tenant Allow/Block List.
descriptions.Set-ThrottlingPolicy: Use the Set-ThrottlingPolicy cmdlet to modify the settings for a user throttling policy.
descriptions.Export-QuarantineMessage: Use the Export-QuarantineMessage cmdlet to export quarantined messages and files from your cloud-based organization. Messages are exported to .eml message files so you can open them in Outlook.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderMigrationRequestStatisti: Use the Get-PublicFolderMigrationRequestStatistics cmdlet to view detailed information about serial public folder migration requests (requests created by the New-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet).
descriptions.Get-IPBlockListConfig: Use the Get-IPBlockListConfig cmdlet to view the IP Block list configuration information that's used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.New-DataClassification: Use the New-DataClassification cmdlet to create data classification rules that use document fingerprints.
descriptions.Stop-InformationBarrierPoliciesApplicati: Use the Stop-InformationBarrierPoliciesApplication cmdlet to stop the process of applying information barrier policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-AuthServer: Use the Remove-AuthServer cmdlet to remove an authorization server.
descriptions.New-EdgeSubscription: Use the New-EdgeSubscription cmdlet to export an Edge Subscription file from an Edge Transport server and to import the Edge Subscription file to a Mailbox server.
descriptions.Complete-MigrationBatch: Use the Complete-MigrationBatch cmdlet to finalize a migration batch that has successfully finished initial synchronization.
descriptions.New-MapiVirtualDirectory: Use the New-MapiVirtualDirectory cmdlet to create Messaging Application Programming Interface (MAPI) virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers. A MAPI virtual directory is used by supported versions of Microsoft Outlook to connect to mailboxes by using the MAPIHTTP protocol.
descriptions.Set-AntiPhishRule: Use the Set-AntiPhishRule cmdlet to modify antiphish rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-HoldCompliancePolicy: Use the Get-HoldCompliancePolicy to view existing preservation policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-OabVirtualDirectory: Use the New-OABVirtualDirectory cmdlet to create offline address book (OAB) virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers. The OAB virtual directory configures the server as a web distribution point for an offline address book (OAB). Typically, you create virtual directories on Exchange servers that have the Client Access server role installed.
descriptions.Set-MoveRequest: Use the Set-MoveRequest cmdlet to change move request options after the move request is created. You can use the Set-MoveRequest cmdlet to recover from failed move requests.
descriptions.New-SweepRule: Use the New-SweepRule cmdlet to create Sweep rules in mailboxes. Sweep rules run at regular intervals to help keep your Inbox clean.
descriptions.Get-AutodiscoverVirtualDirectory: Use the Get-AutodiscoverVirtualDirectory cmdlet to view Autodiscover virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.New-SiteMailbox: The New-SiteMailbox cmdlet is used by the Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Exchange user interfaces to create site mailboxes. We recommend that you don't use this cmdlet; instead use SharePoint to create the site mailbox. This cmdlet should only be used for diagnostic and troubleshooting purposes.
descriptions.Reset-ProvisioningCache: The Reset-ProvisioningCache cmdlet clears the Windows PowerShell provisioning cache of frequently used Active Directory objects. This cmdlet is only used for diagnostic purposes.
descriptions.Update-SafeList: Use the Update-SafeList cmdlet to update the safelist aggregation data in Active Directory. Safelist aggregation data is used in the built-in anti-spam filtering in Microsoft Exchange. EdgeSync replicates safelist aggregation data to Edge Transport servers in the perimeter network.
descriptions.Stop-ManagedFolderAssistant: Use the Stop-ManagedFolderAssistant cmdlet to immediately stop messaging records management (MRM) from processing users' mailboxes on the specified servers.
descriptions.Set-RemoteMailbox: Use the Set-RemoteMailbox cmdlet to modify remote mailboxes. A remote mailbox is a mail user in Active Directory that's associated with a mailbox in the cloud-based service.
descriptions.Get-MailboxCalendarFolder: Use the Get-MailboxCalendarFolder cmdlet to retrieve the publishing or sharing settings for a specified mailbox calendar folder.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxRepairRequest: Use the Remove-MailboxRepairRequest cmdlet to remove mailbox repair requests from a mailbox database that were created using the New-MailboxRepairRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Clear-MobileDevice: Use the Clear-MobileDevice cmdlet to delete all data from a mobile phone. This action is often called a remote device wipe.
descriptions.Suspend-PublicFolderMigrationRequest: Use the Suspend-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet to suspend serial public folder migration requests (requests created by the New-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet). You can suspend active requests before they reach the status CompletionInProgress. You resume suspended requests by using the Resume-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Preview-QuarantineMessage: Use the Preview-QuarantineMessage cmdlet to preview the contents of quarantined messages in your cloud-based organization. This cmdlet doesn't work on files that were quarantined by Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.
descriptions.Test-OrganizationRelationship: Use the Test-OrganizationRelationship cmdlet to verify that the organization relationship is properly configured and functioning as expected.
descriptions.Remove-MigrationEndpoint: Use the Remove-MigrationEndpoint cmdlet to remove existing migration endpoints for source or destination servers for cutover or staged Exchange migrations, IMAP migrations and remote moves.
descriptions.Resume-MoveRequest: Use the Resume-MoveRequest cmdlet to resume a move request that is suspended or has failed.
descriptions.Add-ComplianceCaseMember: Use the Add-ComplianceCaseMember cmdlet to add an individual member to an eDiscovery case in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. To replace all existing members, use the Update-ComplianceCaseMember cmdlet.
descriptions.New-ComplianceCase: Use the New-ComplianceCase cmdlet to create eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. You use eDiscovery cases to place content locations on hold, perform Content Searches associated with the case, and export search results.
descriptions.Remove-AppRetentionComplianceRule: Use the Remove-AppRetentionComplianceRule to remove app retention compliance rules.
descriptions.Get-DlpSensitiveInformationType: Use the Get-DlpSensitiveInformationType cmdlet to list the sensitive information types that are defined for your organization in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Sensitive information types are used by data loss prevention (DLP) rules to check for sensitive information such as social security, passport, or credit card numbers.
descriptions.Get-BlockedConnector: Use the Get-BlockedConnector cmdlet to view inbound connectors that have been detected as potentially compromised. Blocked connectors are prevented from sending email.
descriptions.Get-ReceiveConnector: Use the Get-ReceiveConnector cmdlet to view Receive connectors on Mailbox servers and Edge Transport servers. Receive connectors listen for inbound SMTP connections on the Exchange server.
descriptions.Update-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin: Use the Update-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin cmdlet to replace all existing eDiscovery Administrators in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. To add or remove individual eDiscovery Administrators, use the Add-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin and Remove-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin cmdlets.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderMailboxMigrationRequestS: Use the Get-PublicFolderMailboxMigrationRequestStatistics cmdlet to view the detailed status of individual jobs in a public folder migration batch created using New-MigrationBatch cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration: Use the Get-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration cmdlet to retrieve Automatic Replies settings for a specific mailbox.
descriptions.Test-ImapConnectivity: Use the Test-ImapConnectivity cmdlet to verify that connectivity to the Microsoft Exchange IMAP4 service is working as expected.
