descriptions.Set-ExchangeServer: Use the Set-ExchangeServer cmdlet to set Exchange attributes in Active Directory for a specified server.
descriptions.Set-OrganizationSegment: Use the Set-OrganizationSegment cmdlet to modify organization segments in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Organization Segments are not in effect until you apply information barrier policies.
descriptions.Set-OutlookAnywhere: Use the Set-OutlookAnywhere cmdlet to modify Outlook Anywhere virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers. Outlook Anywhere uses virtual directories that contain "rpc" in the name.
descriptions.Set-AccessToCustomerDataRequest: Use the Set-AccessToCustomerDataRequest cmdlet to approve, deny, or cancel Microsoft 365 customer lockbox requests that control access to your data by Microsoft support engineers.
descriptions.Set-MailboxMessageConfiguration: Use the Set-MailboxMessageConfiguration cmdlet to configure the Outlook on the web settings that are applied to specific mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-SupervisoryReviewTopCasesReport: Use the Get-SupervisoryReviewTopCasesReport cmdlet to view the current status of the top supervision policies configured in your organization.
descriptions.Clear-TextMessagingAccount: The Clear-TextMessagingAccount cmdlet allows a user to remove the text messaging settings from their own mailbox. An administrator can't use this cmdlet to remove the text messaging settings from another user's mailbox.
descriptions.Get-SupervisoryReviewActivity: Use the Get-SupervisoryReviewActivity cmdlet to view all activities performed by a reviewer for a specific supervision policy. This information might be useful if reviewer activities are required in regulatory compliance audits or in litigation.
descriptions.Get-HostedContentFilterRule: Use the Get-HostedContentFilterRule cmdlet to view spam filter rules (content filter rules) in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-PublicFolderMigrationRequest: Use the Set-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet to modify serial public folder migration requests (requests created by the New-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet). You can use this cmdlet to recover from failed migration requests.
descriptions.Set-SendConnector: Use the Set-SendConnector cmdlet to modify a Send connector.
descriptions.Set-AuditConfig: Use the Set-AuditConfig cmdlet to configure the auditing configuration in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-OfflineAddressBook: Use the Set-OfflineAddressBook cmdlet to modify offline address book (OAB) settings.
descriptions.New-OwaMailboxPolicy: Use the New-OwaMailboxPolicy cmdlet to create Outlook on the web mailbox policies.
descriptions.Get-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy: Use the Get-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy cmdlet to view auto-labeling policies in your organization.
descriptions.New-ATPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the New-ATPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to create rules for Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protections in preset security policies. The rules specify recipient conditions and exceptions for the protection, and also allow you to turn on and turn off the associated preset security policies.
descriptions.Get-OwaMailboxPolicy: Use the Get-OwaMailboxPolicy cmdlet to view Outlook on the web mailbox policies in the organization.
descriptions.Get-DlpPolicyTemplate: Use the Get-DlpPolicyTemplate cmdlet to view existing data loss prevention (DLP) policy templates that are based on transport rules (mail flow rules) in your Exchange organization.
descriptions.Get-UMCallSummaryReport: Use the Get-UMCallSummaryReport cmdlet to return statistics about all calls received or placed by Mailbox servers running the Microsoft Exchange Unified Messaging service in an organization.
descriptions.Resume-Message: Use the Resume-Message cmdlet to enable delivery of a previously suspended message in a queue on a Mailbox server or Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Get-ComplianceRetentionEvent: Use the Get-ComplianceRetentionEvent cmdlet to view compliance retention events in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-ActiveSyncOrganizationSettings: Use the Get-ActiveSyncOrganizationSettings cmdlet to view the Microsoft Exchange ActiveSync settings for your organization.
descriptions.Get-AtpPolicyForO365: Use the Get-AtpPolicyForO365 cmdlet to view the settings for the following features in Microsoft Defender for Office 365:
descriptions.New-HoldComplianceRule: Use the New-HoldComplianceRule cmdlet to create new preservation rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-SupervisoryReviewPolicyV2: Use the Get-SupervisoryReviewPolicyV2 cmdlet to view supervisory review policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Supervisory review lets you define policies that capture communications in your organization so they can be examined by internal or external reviewers.
descriptions.Test-DataClassification: Use the Test-DataClassification cmdlet to find the confidence and count of a sensitive information type that's found in a specified text string.
descriptions.Remove-ServicePrincipal: Use the Remove-ServicePrincipal cmdlet to remove service principals from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-RecoverableItems: Use the Get-RecoverableItems items cmdlet to view deleted items in mailboxes. After you find the deleted items, you use the Restore-RecoverableItems cmdlet to restore them.
descriptions.Get-MonitoringItemHelp: Use the Get-MonitoringItemHelp cmdlet to discover the monitoring items that you can use to return health information about your Exchange servers. Monitoring items are preconfigured to help you with your server health and monitoring.
descriptions.Disable-JournalArchiving: Use the Disable-JournalArchiving cmdlet to disable journal archiving for specific users. Microsoft 365 journal archiving uses mailboxes in Exchange Online to record or journal messages for mailboxes in on-premises organizations.
descriptions.Get-GlobalAddressList: Use the Get-GlobalAddressList cmdlet to view a global address list (GAL) or a set of GALs.
descriptions.Write-AdminAuditLog: Use the Write-AdminAuditLog cmdlet to write a comment to the administrator audit log.
descriptions.Add-PublicFolderClientPermission: Use the Add-PublicFolderClientPermission cmdlet to add permissions to public folders.
descriptions.Remove-ExoPhishSimOverrideRule: Use the Remove-ExoPhishSimOverrideRule cmdlet to remove non-Microsoft phishing simulation override rules that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Update-StoreMailboxState: Use the Update-StoreMailboxState cmdlet to synchronize the mailbox state for a mailbox in the Exchange mailbox store with the state of the corresponding Active Directory user account.
descriptions.Remove-ClientAccessRule: > [!NOTE] > Client access rules were deprecated for all Exchange Online organizations in September 2025. For more information, see Update on Client Access Rules Deprecation in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Get-DataClassificationConfig: Use the Get-DataClassificationConfig cmdlet to view the data classification configuration for your organization.
descriptions.Get-ResubmitRequest: Use the Get-ResubmitRequest cmdlet to view requests to replay redundant copies of messages from Safety Net after a mailbox database recovery.
descriptions.Get-MailboxUserConfiguration: Use the Get-MailboxUserConfiguration cmdlet to view user configuration items in mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-IRMConfiguration: Use the Get-IRMConfiguration cmdlet to view the Information Rights Management (IRM) configuration in your organization.
descriptions.Disable-App: Use the Disable-App cmdlet to disable (turn off) a specific app for a specific user.
descriptions.Get-MailboxFolderPermission: Use the Get-MailboxFolderPermission cmdlet to view folder-level permissions in mailboxes.
descriptions.Set-AdaptiveScope: Use the Set-AdaptiveScope cmdlet to modify adaptive scopes in your organization.
descriptions.Set-MapiVirtualDirectory: Use the Set-MapiVirtualDirectory cmdlet to modify Messaging Application Programming Interface (MAPI) virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers. A MAPI virtual directory is used by supported versions of Microsoft Outlook to connect to mailboxes by using the MAPIHTTP protocol.
descriptions.Set-MailboxImportRequest: Use the Set-MailboxImportRequest cmdlet to change import request options after the request is created. You can use the Set-MailboxImportRequest cmdlet to recover from failed import requests.
descriptions.Get-RecipientStatisticsReport: Use the Get-RecipientStatisticsReport cmdlet to view the recipient statistics report.
descriptions.Remove-OfflineAddressBook: Use the Remove-OfflineAddressBook cmdlet to remove (delete) offline address books (OABs).
descriptions.Set-X400AuthoritativeDomain: Use the Set-X400AuthoritativeDomain cmdlet to edit an existing X.400 authoritative domain for your organization. The X.400 authoritative domain defines the standard fields for the namespace appended to the recipient identity for all mailboxes assigned an X.400 address.
descriptions.Get-EOPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Get-EOPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to view rules for the built-in security features for all cloud mailboxes in preset security policies. The rules specify recipient conditions and exceptions for the protection, and also allow you to turn on and turn off the associated preset security policies.
descriptions.New-PolicyTipConfig: Use the Set-PolicyTipConfig cmdlet to create custom Policy Tips in your organization.
descriptions.Set-UnifiedGroup: Use the Set-UnifiedGroup cmdlet to modify Microsoft 365 Groups in your cloud-based organization. To modify members, owners, and subscribers of Microsoft 365 Groups, use the Add-UnifiedGroupLinks and Remove-UnifiedGroupLinks cmdlets.
descriptions.Get-SystemMessage: Use the Get-SystemMessage cmdlet to view default or custom system messages. System messages are delivery status notifications (also known as DSNs, non-delivery reports, NDRs or bounce messages) and quota messages.
descriptions.Enable-DnssecForVerifiedDomain: Use the Enable-DnssecForVerifiedDomain cmdlet to enable Domain Name System Security (DNSSEC) for inbound mail to accepted domains in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Get-SafeLinksAggregateReport: Use the Get-SafeLinksAggregateReport cmdlet to return general information about Safe Links results for the last 90 days. Yesterday is the most recent date that you can specify.
descriptions.Enable-IPv6ForAcceptedDomain: Use the Enable-IPv6ForAcceptedDomain cmdlet to enable support for mail delivery to accepted domains in Exchange Online using IPv6.
descriptions.Set-HostedContentFilterPolicy: Use the Set-HostedContentFilterPolicy cmdlet to modify spam filter policies (content filter policies) in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-ServerHealth: Use the Get-ServerHealth cmdlet to return health information related to the server you specify.
descriptions.Set-UMIPGateway: Use the Set-UMIPGateway cmdlet to modify the configuration settings for a single Unified Messaging (UM) IP gateway or to return a list of configuration settings that can be modified on a specified UM IP gateway.
descriptions.Disable-TransportRule: Use the Disable-TransportRule cmdlet to disable transport rules (mail flow rules) in your organization.
descriptions.Set-SharingPolicy: Use the Set-SharingPolicy cmdlet to modify existing sharing policies that control how users inside your organization can share free/busy and contact information with users outside your organization.
descriptions.Set-IPAllowListProvider: Use the Set-IPAllowListProvider cmdlet to modify IP Allow list providers that are used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Remove-DlpComplianceRule: Use the Remove-DlpComplianceRule cmdlet to remove Data Loss Prevention (DLP) rules from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-RetentionComplianceRule: Use the New-RetentionComplianceRule cmdlet to create new retention rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-DlpSensitiveInformationTypeRulePacka: Use the New-DlpSensitiveInformationTypeConfig cmdlet to import data loss prevention (DLP) sensitive information type rule packages in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-ClientAccessService: Use the Set-ClientAccessService cmdlet to modify settings that are associated with the Client Access server role.
descriptions.Set-MailUser: Use the Set-MailUser cmdlet to modify mail users. Mail users (also known as mail-enabled users) have email addresses and accounts in the Exchange organization, but they don't have Exchange mailboxes.
descriptions.Set-IPAllowListProvidersConfig: Use the Set-IPAllowListProvidersConfig cmdlet to modify the settings that affect all IP Allow list providers that are configured on an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Get-AvailabilityAddressSpace: Use the Get-AvailabilityAddressSpace cmdlet to view existing availability address space objects that are used to share free/busy data across Exchange organizations.
descriptions.Remove-ADPermission: Use the Remove-ADPermission cmdlet to remove permissions from an Active Directory object.
descriptions.Remove-RpcClientAccess: Use the Remove-RpcClientAccess cmdlet to remove the configuration information that allows RPC access through the Client Access server role on Microsoft Exchange Server 2010. After you remove the configuration information, the Exchange RPC Client Access service stops and no longer starts.
descriptions.Remove-IntraOrganizationConnector: Use the Remove-IntraOrganizationConnector cmdlet to remove existing Intra-Organization connectors.
descriptions.Get-DistributionGroup: Use the Get-DistributionGroup cmdlet to view existing distribution groups or mail-enabled security groups. To view the members of a group, use the Get-DistributionGroupMember cmdlet.
descriptions.Enable-ExchangeCertificate: Use the Enable-ExchangeCertificate cmdlet to enable an existing certificate on the Exchange server for Exchange services such as Internet Information Services (IIS), SMTP, POP, IMAP and Unified Messaging (UM). Once you enable a certificate for a service, you can't disable it.
descriptions.Add-IPBlockListProvider: Use the Add-IPBlockListProvider cmdlet to create IP Block list providers that are used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.New-MailContact: Use the New-MailContact cmdlet to create mail contacts.
descriptions.Get-DevicePolicy: Use the Get-DevicePolicy cmdlet to view all types of Basic Mobility and Security policies in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Get-CaseHoldPolicy: Use the Get-CaseHoldPolicy to view existing case hold policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. To get relevant information about how the hold was applied and the affected locations, you need to include the DistributionDetail switch.
descriptions.Uninstall-TransportAgent: Use the Uninstall-TransportAgent cmdlet to unregister transport agents from Exchange servers.
descriptions.Import-RecipientDataProperty: Use the Import-RecipientDataProperty cmdlet to add a picture or a spoken name audio file to a mailbox or mail contact.
descriptions.Update-HybridConfiguration: Use the Update-HybridConfiguration cmdlet to define the credentials that are used to update the hybrid configuration object.
descriptions.New-DeviceTenantPolicy: Use the New-DeviceTenantPolicy cmdlet to create your organization's mobile device tenant policy in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Remove-ManagedContentSettings: Use the Remove-ManagedContentSettings cmdlet to delete managed content settings from a managed folder.
descriptions.Get-ActiveSyncDeviceStatistics: Use the Get-ActiveSyncDeviceStatistics cmdlet to retrieve the list of mobile devices configured to synchronize with a specified user's mailbox and return a list of statistics about the mobile devices.
descriptions.Set-ClientAccessServer: Use the Set-ClientAccessServer cmdlet to modify settings that are associated with the Client Access server role.
descriptions.Get-MessageTrace: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet is replaced by the Get-MessageTraceV2 cmdlet and will eventually be deprecated.
descriptions.Set-ComplianceSearch: Use the Set-ComplianceSearch cmdlet to modify non-running compliance searches in Exchange Server 2016 or later and in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-IPBlockListProvider: Use the Set-IPBlockListProvider cmdlet to modify IP Block list providers that are used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Get-UMMailboxPin: Use the Get-UMMailboxPin cmdlet to return information from a Unified Messaging (UM)-enabled user's mailbox.
descriptions.Remove-OutlookProtectionRule: Use the Remove-OutlookProtectionRule cmdlet to remove Outlook protection rules.
descriptions.Get-AdaptiveScopeMembers: Use the Get-AdaptiveScopeMembers cmdlet to retrieve current and past members of adaptive scopes in your organization. Adaptive scopes are used in retention policies, Insider Risk Management policies and retention label policies.
descriptions.Set-AddressRewriteEntry: Use the Set-AddressRewriteEntry cmdlet to modify an existing address rewrite entry that rewrites sender and recipient email addresses in messages sent to or sent from your organization through an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Set-TextMessagingAccount: The Set-TextMessagingAccount cmdlet allows a user to configure the text messaging settings on their own mailbox. An administrator can't use this cmdlet to configure the text messaging settings on another user's mailbox.
descriptions.Get-MailboxServer: Use the Get-MailboxServer cmdlet to view information about Mailbox servers in your organization.
descriptions.Remove-ManagementScope: Use the Remove-ManagementScope cmdlet to remove an existing management scope.
descriptions.Get-App: Use the Get-App cmdlet to view installed apps.
descriptions.Get-SafeLinksRule: Use the Get-SafeLinksRule cmdlet to view Safe Links rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-UMMailbox: Use the Get-UMMailbox cmdlet to view existing mailboxes that are Unified Messaging (UM) enabled.
descriptions.Set-DeviceTenantPolicy: Use the Set-DeviceTenantPolicy cmdlet to modify your organization's mobile device tenant policy in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Remove-MigrationUser: Use the Remove-MigrationUser cmdlet to remove a migration user from a batch.
descriptions.Add-ServerMonitoringOverride: Use the Add-ServerMonitoringOverride cmdlet to override the thresholds and parameters of managed availability probes, monitors, and responders on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Set-Place: Use the Set-Place cmdlet to update room mailboxes with additional metadata, which provides a better search and room suggestion experience.
descriptions.Start-EdgeSynchronization: Use the Start-EdgeSynchronization cmdlet to immediately start synchronization of configuration data from Active Directory to the subscribed Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Remove-ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory: Use the Remove-ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory cmdlet to remove existing Exchange ActiveSync virtual directories from Internet Information Services (IIS) virtual directories on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Get-FederationInformation: Use the Get-FederationInformation cmdlet to get federation information from an external Exchange organization.
descriptions.Remove-UMDialPlan: Use the Remove-UMDialPlan cmdlet to delete an existing Unified Messaging (UM) dial plan.
descriptions.Remove-UMAutoAttendant: Use the Remove-UMAutoAttendant cmdlet to delete a Unified Messaging (UM) auto attendant.
descriptions.Remove-RemoteDomain: Use the Remove-RemoteDomain cmdlet to remove a remote domain. When you remove a remote domain, the remote domain object is deleted. Removing a remote domain doesn't disable mail flow to that domain.
descriptions.Get-AvailabilityConfig: Use the Get-AvailabilityConfig cmdlet to view information about the sharing of free/busy information between organizations:
descriptions.Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule: Use the Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule cmdlet to modify the settings of outbound spam filter rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-SupervisoryReviewRule: Use the Get-SupervisoryReviewRule cmdlet to modify supervisory review rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Supervisory review lets you define policies that capture communications in your organization so they can be examined by internal or external reviewers.
descriptions.Set-PendingFederatedDomain: The Set-PendingFederatedDomain cmdlet is used by the Exchange admin center to configure pending domains with the federated organization identifier in the federation trust for the Exchange organization. You shouldn't use this cmdlet to attempt to manually configure a federation trust.
descriptions.Remove-CalendarEvents: Use the Remove-CalendarEvents cmdlet to cancel future meetings in user or resource mailboxes. Cancelling future meetings removes them from attendee and resource calendars (for example, you're going to remove the mailbox, or the user is going on a leave of absence).
descriptions.Set-SenderFilterConfig: Use the Set-SenderFilterConfig cmdlet to modify the Sender Filter agent configuration.
descriptions.Suspend-MailboxImportRequest: Use the Suspend-MailboxImportRequest cmdlet to suspend an import request any time after the request was created, but before the request reaches the status of Completed. You can resume the move request by using the Resume-MailboxImportRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.New-App: Use the New-App cmdlet to install apps for Outlook.
descriptions.Upgrade-DistributionGroup: Use the Upgrade-DistributionGroup cmdlet to upgrade distribution groups to Microsoft 365 Groups. This cmdlet only works on distribution groups, not mail-enabled security groups.
descriptions.Set-DlpComplianceRule: Use the Set-DlpComplianceRule to modify data loss prevention (DLP) rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. DLP rules define sensitive information to be protected and the actions to take on rule violations.
descriptions.Get-IPAllowListProvidersConfig: Use the Get-IPAllowListProvidersConfig cmdlet to view the settings that affect all IP Allow list providers that are configured on an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Get-EXOMobileDeviceStatistics: Use the Get-EXOMobileDeviceStatistics cmdlet to retrieve the list of mobile devices configured to synchronize with a specified user's mailbox and return a list of statistics about the mobile devices.
descriptions.Get-MalwareFilterRule: Use the Enable-MalwareFilterRule cmdlet to view malware filter rules in your organization.
descriptions.Get-OrganizationalUnit: Use the Get-OrganizationalUnit cmdlet to view a list of organizational units (OUs) that exist in your organization.
descriptions.Get-FederationTrust: Use the Get-FederationTrust cmdlet to view the federation trust configured for the Exchange organization.
descriptions.Remove-PublicFolderMigrationRequest: Use the Remove-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet to cancel or complete serial public folder migration requests (requests created by the New-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet). You need to use this cmdlet to remove an existing serial public folder migration request before you can create another one.
descriptions.Set-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicy: Use the Set-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicy cmdlet to modify Microsoft 365 data-at-rest encryption policies in Exchange Online.
descriptions.New-Label: Use the New-Label cmdlet to create sensitivity labels in your organization.
descriptions.Export-JournalRuleCollection: Use the Export-JournalRuleCollection cmdlet to export the journal rules in your organization to an XML file.
descriptions.Get-DataClassification: Use the Get-DataClassification cmdlet to view the data classification rules in your organization. This cmdlet shows built-in data classification rules and rules that you created that use document fingerprints.
descriptions.Set-RetentionComplianceRule: Use the Set-RetentionComplianceRule cmdlet to modify existing retention rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-DlpEdmSchema: Use the New-DlpEdmSchema cmdlet to create exact data match (EDM)-based classification schemas in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Such schemas can be used with data loss prevention (DLP) policies.
descriptions.New-TenantAllowBlockListSpoofItems: Use the New-TenantAllowBlockListSpoofItems cmdlet to create spoofed sender entries in the Tenant Allow/Block List.
descriptions.Remove-EmailAddressPolicy: Use the Remove-EmailAddressPolicy cmdlet to remove existing email address policies and update the affected recipients. In Exchange Online, email address policies are available only for Microsoft 365 Groups.
descriptions.Get-UMCallRouterSettings: Use the Get-UMCallRouterSettings cmdlet to view the settings of the Microsoft Exchange Unified Messaging Call Router service. This service exists on Exchange servers that have the Client Access server role installed, and is used by telephony clients to connect to Exchange.
descriptions.Test-IPBlockListProvider: Use the Test-IPBlockListProvider cmdlet to test IP Block list providers on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Enable-DistributionGroup: Use the Enable-DistributionGroup cmdlet to mail-enable existing universal security groups and universal distribution groups that aren't already mail-enabled.
descriptions.Set-MailboxServer: Use the Set-MailboxServer cmdlet to modify the mailbox configuration settings and attributes of Mailbox servers.
descriptions.Get-MigrationBatch: Use the Get-MigrationBatch cmdlet to retrieve status information about the current migration batch.
descriptions.Remove-WorkforceInsightsDelegationAccess: Use the Remove-WorkforceInsightsDelegationAccess cmdlet to remove delegate access from the specified account (the delegate) so they can't view organizational insights like the leader (the delegator).
descriptions.Get-UMMailboxPolicy: Use the Get-UMMailboxPolicy cmdlet to display the properties and values of a Unified Messaging (UM) mailbox policy.
descriptions.Get-MailboxSearch: Use the Get-MailboxSearch cmdlet to view mailbox searches that are in progress, complete or stopped.
descriptions.Remove-ReportSubmissionRule: Use the Remove-ReportSubmissionRule cmdlet to remove the report submission rule from your cloud-based organization. The report submission rule identifies the reporting mailbox where user reported messages are delivered.
descriptions.Get-SCInsights: Use the Get-SCInsights cmdlet to view Microsoft 365 insights information.
descriptions.Get-EligibleDistributionGroupForMigratio: Use the Get-EligibleDistributionGroupForMigration cmdlet to identify distribution groups that can be upgraded to Microsoft 365 Groups. You can't upgrade mail-enabled security groups to Microsoft 365 Groups.
descriptions.New-DeviceConditionalAccessPolicy: Use the New-DeviceConditionalAccessPolicy cmdlet to create mobile device conditional access policies in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Set-DistributionGroup: Use the Set-DistributionGroup cmdlet to modify the settings of existing distribution groups or mail-enabled security groups. To add or remove group members, use the Add-DistributionGroupMember, Remove-DistributionGroupMember or Update-DistributionGroupMember cmdlets.
descriptions.Get-MailboxFolder: Use the Get-MailboxFolder cmdlet to view folders in your own mailbox. Administrators can't use this cmdlet to view folders in other mailboxes (the cmdlet is available only from the MyBaseOptions user role).
descriptions.Remove-SystemMessage: Use the Remove-SystemMessage cmdlet to remove custom system messages. System messages are delivery status notifications (also known as DSNs, non-delivery reports, NDRs or bounce messages) and quota messages.
descriptions.Get-MobileDeviceStatistics: Use the Get-MobileDeviceStatistics cmdlet to retrieve the list of mobile devices configured to synchronize with a specified user's mailbox and return a list of statistics about the mobile devices.
descriptions.Get-AcceptedDomain: Use the Get-AcceptedDomain cmdlet to view the configuration information for the accepted domains in your organization.
descriptions.Set-SupervisoryReviewPolicyV2: Use the Set-SupervisoryReviewPolicyV2 cmdlet to modify supervisory review policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-Notification: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet will be deprecated in the cloud-based service. The classic Exchange admin center was deprecated in the cloud-based service in 2023.
descriptions.Get-ATPTotalTrafficReport: Use the Get-ATPTotalTrafficReport to view details about message traffic in your Microsoft Defender for Office 365 organization.
descriptions.New-MailboxRestoreRequest: Use the New-MailboxRestoreRequest cmdlet to restore a soft-deleted or disconnected mailbox. This cmdlet starts the process of moving content from the soft-deleted mailbox, disabled mailbox, or any mailbox in a recovery database into a connected primary or archive mailbox.
descriptions.Set-AuthConfig: Use the Set-AuthConfig cmdlet to modify the authorization configuration for your Exchange organization.
descriptions.Remove-OrganizationSegment: Use the Remove-OrganizationSegment cmdlet to remove organization segments from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-MobileDeviceMailboxPolicy: Use the Set-MobileDeviceMailboxPolicy cmdlet to modify mobile device mailbox policies.
descriptions.Get-InformationBarrierPolicy: Use the Get-InformationBarrierPolicy cmdlet to view information barrier policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-RoleGroup: Use the New-RoleGroup cmdlet to create management role groups.
descriptions.Get-QuarantinePolicy: Use the Get-QuarantinePolicy cmdlet to view quarantine policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-Notification: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet will be deprecated in the cloud-based service. The classic Exchange admin center was deprecated in the cloud-based service in 2023.
descriptions.Disable-MailPublicFolder: Use the Disable-MailPublicFolder cmdlet to mail-disable a public folder.
descriptions.Remove-ServerMonitoringOverride: Use the Remove-ServerMonitoringOverride cmdlet to remove a managed availability local server override that is configured for a probe, monitor or responder.
descriptions.Set-MailboxExportRequest: Use the Set-MailboxExportRequest cmdlet to change export request options after the request is created. You can use the Set-MailboxExportRequest cmdlet to recover from failed export requests.
descriptions.Set-AutoSensitivityLabelRule: Use the Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy cmdlet to modify auto-labeling policy rules in your organization.
descriptions.Set-MailboxDatabaseCopy: Use the Set-MailboxDatabaseCopy cmdlet to configure the properties of a database copy.
descriptions.Get-JournalRule: Use the Get-JournalRule cmdlet to view the journal rules in your organization.
descriptions.Remove-InboundConnector: Use the Remove-InboundConnector cmdlet to delete an Inbound connector from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Enable-MailboxQuarantine: Use the Enable-MailboxQuarantine cmdlet to quarantine mailboxes that affect the availability of the mailbox database.
descriptions.Invoke-ComplianceSearchActionStep: This cmdlet is reserved for internal Microsoft use.
descriptions.Get-ManagedFolderMailboxPolicy: Use the Get-ManagedFolderMailboxPolicy cmdlet to return all attributes of one or more managed folder mailbox policies.
descriptions.Update-GlobalAddressList: Use the Update-GlobalAddressList cmdlet to update the recipients included in a global address list (GAL).
descriptions.Get-PendingDelicenseUser: Use the Get-PendingDelicenseUser cmdlet to view information about mailboxes that have delayed mailbox license removal requests. You configure delayed mailbox license removal using the DelayedDelicensingEnabled parameter on the Set-OrganizationConfig cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-ComplianceSearchAction: Use the Get-ComplianceSearchAction cmdlet to view information about compliance search actions.
descriptions.Get-DeviceConfigurationRule: Use the Get-DeviceConfigurationRule cmdlet to view mobile device configuration rules in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Set-UMMailboxPIN: Use the Set-UMMailboxPIN cmdlet to reset the PIN for a Unified Messaging (UM)-enabled mailbox.
descriptions.Set-SmimeConfig: Use the Set-SmimeConfig cmdlet to modify the S/MIME configuration for Outlook on the web (formerly known as Outlook Web App or OWA) and new Outlook for Windows.
descriptions.Enable-UMMailbox: Use the Enable-UMMailbox cmdlet to enable Unified Messaging (UM) for existing mailbox users.
descriptions.Get-FocusedInbox: Use the Get-FocusedInbox cmdlet to view the Focused Inbox configuration for mailboxes in your organization.
descriptions.New-AdaptiveScope: Use the New-AdaptiveScope cmdlet to create adaptive scopes in your organization. Adaptive scopes (or static scopes) are used in retention policies and retention label policies.
descriptions.Disable-ServiceEmailChannel: Use the Disable-ServiceEmailChannel cmdlet to disable the .NET service channel for a specific user. The .NET service channel enables Microsoft Exchange to store information that it later forwards to applications or devices that aren't permanently connected to the server running Exchange.
descriptions.New-AppRetentionComplianceRule: Use the New-AppRetentionComplianceRule to create app retention compliance rules.
descriptions.Enable-SmtpDaneInbound: Use the Enable-SMTPDaneInbound cmdlet to enable SMTP DNS-based Authentication of Named Entities (DANE) for inbound mail to accepted domains in Exchange Online.
descriptions.New-OfflineAddressBook: Use the New-OfflineAddressBook cmdlet to create offline address books (OABs).
descriptions.New-SensitiveInformationScanRule: Use the New-SensitiveInformationScan cmdlet to create sensitive information scan rules.
descriptions.Remove-FilePlanPropertyReferenceId: Use the New-FilePlanPropertyReferenceId cmdlet to remove file plan property reference IDs.
descriptions.Test-ServiceHealth: Use the Test-ServiceHealth cmdlet to test whether all the Microsoft Windows services that Exchange requires on a server have started. The Test-ServiceHealth cmdlet returns an error for any service required by a configured role when the service is set to start automatically and isn't currently running.
descriptions.New-LabelPolicy: Use the New-LabelPolicy cmdlet to create sensitivity label policies in your organization.
descriptions.Start-MigrationBatch: Use the Start-MigrationBatch cmdlet to start a move request or migration batch that was created with the New-MigrationBatch cmdlet.
descriptions.Set-AddressList: Use the Set-AddressList cmdlet to modify existing address lists.
descriptions.Move-AddressList: Use the Move-AddressList cmdlet to move an existing address list to a new container under the root address list.
descriptions.Remove-JournalRule: Use the Remove-JournalRule cmdlet to remove an existing journal rule.
descriptions.Enable-RemoteMailbox: Use the Enable-RemoteMailbox cmdlet to create a mailbox in the cloud-based service for an existing user in the on-premises Active Directory.
descriptions.Get-AutoSensitivityLabelRule: Use the Get-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy cmdlet to view auto-labeling policy rules in your organization.
descriptions.Remove-RoleAssignmentPolicy: Use the Remove-RoleAssignmentPolicy cmdlet to remove existing management role assignment policies from your organization.
descriptions.Update-DistributionGroupMember: Use the Update-DistributionGroupMember cmdlet to replace all members of distribution groups and mail-enabled security groups. To add or remove existing group members, use the Add-DistributionGroupMember and Remove-DistributionGroupMember cmdlets.
descriptions.Set-ComplianceRetentionEventType: Use the Set-ComplianceRetentionEventType cmdlet to modify retention event types in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Invoke-ProvisioningVerifyRbacDiagnostic: Use the Invoke-ProvisioningVerifyRbacDiagnostic cmdlet to analyze and repair role-based access control (RBAC) configurations in cloud-based organizations.
descriptions.Remove-BlockedSenderAddress: Use the Remove-BlockedSenderAddress cmdlet to unblock users in your Microsoft 365 organization that were affected by the protection system. These users sent multiple messages that were classified as spam, so they were blocked from sending messages.
descriptions.Test-PowerShellConnectivity: Use the Test-PowerShellConnectivity cmdlet to test client connectivity to Exchange remote PowerShell virtual directories.
descriptions.Set-MigrationConfig: Use the Set-MigrationConfig cmdlet to edit migration configurations on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-UMCallAnsweringRule: Use the Remove-UMCallAnsweringRule cmdlet to remove an existing Unified Messaging (UM) call answering rule.
descriptions.Get-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicy: Use the Get-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicy cmdlet to view existing Microsoft 365 data-at-rest encryption policies.
descriptions.Remove-DlpPolicyTemplate: Use the Remove-DlpPolicyTemplate cmdlet to remove data loss prevention (DLP) policy templates that are based on transport rules (mail flow rules) from your organization.
descriptions.New-MailUser: Use the New-MailUser cmdlet to create mail users. Mail users (also known as mail-enabled users) have email addresses and accounts in the Exchange organization, but they don't have Exchange mailboxes. Email messages sent to mail users are delivered to the specified external email address.
descriptions.Remove-ATPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Remove-ATPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to remove rules from Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protections in preset security policies. The rules specify recipient conditions and exceptions for the protection, and also allow you to turn on and turn off the associated preset security policies.
descriptions.Set-DataEncryptionPolicy: Use the Set-DataEncryptionPolicy cmdlet to modify data encryption policies in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Set-PublicFolderDatabase: Use the Set-PublicFolderDatabase cmdlet to set attributes of public folder databases.
descriptions.Add-ManagementRoleEntry: Use the Add-ManagementRoleEntry cmdlet to add management role entries to an existing management role.
descriptions.Suspend-MailboxRestoreRequest: Use the Suspend-MailboxRestoreRequest cmdlet to suspend a restore request any time after the request was created, but before the request reaches the status of Completed. You can resume the restore request by using the Resume-MailboxRestoreRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderMailboxMigrationRequest: Use the Get-PublicFolderMailboxMigrationRequest cmdlet to view the status of individual jobs in public folder migration batches that were created by using the New-MigrationBatch cmdlet.
descriptions.Remove-ExoSecOpsOverrideRule: Use the Remove-ExoSecOpsOverrideRule cmdlet to remove SecOps mailbox override rules that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Disable-SafeAttachmentRule: Use the Disable-SafeAttachmentRule cmdlet to disable safe attachment rules in your cloud-based organization. This cmdlet is also responsible for disabling complete Safe Attachments policies in the admin center, which consist of the safe attachment rule and the corresponding assigned safe attachment policy in PowerShell.
descriptions.Remove-AddressRewriteEntry: Use the Remove-AddressRewriteEntry cmdlet to remove an existing address rewrite entry that's no longer needed on an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Get-ContentMalwareMdoAggregateReport: Use the Get-ContentMalwareMdoAggregateReport cmdlet to view a summary detections by Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams in Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
descriptions.Get-HealthReport: Use the Get-HealthReport cmdlet to return health information for the Exchange server that you specify. You can use the health values to determine the state of the server. The cmdlet also returns an alert value that provides the specific state of your server.
descriptions.Export-ActivityExplorerData: Use the Export-ActivityExplorerData cmdlet to export activities from Data classification \> Activity Explorer in the Microsoft 365 Purview compliance portal. Activity explorer reports on up to 30 days worth of data.
descriptions.New-PowerShellVirtualDirectory: Use the New-PowerShellVirtualDirectory cmdlet to create Windows PowerShell virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.New-HostedContentFilterPolicy: Use the New-HostedContentFilterPolicy cmdlet to create spam filter policies (content filter policies) in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.New-DataEncryptionPolicy: Use the New-DataEncryptionPolicy cmdlet to create data encryption policies in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Get-ReportSubmissionRule: Use the Get-ReportSubmissionRule cmdlet to view the report submission rule in your cloud-based organization. The report submission rule identifies the reporting mailbox where user reported messages are delivered.
descriptions.Set-EOPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Set-EOPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to modify rules associated with the built-in security features for all cloud mailboxes in preset security policies.
descriptions.Set-PowerShellVirtualDirectory: Use the Set-PowerShellVirtualDirectory cmdlet to modify existing Windows PowerShell virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-MobileDevice: Use the Remove-MobileDevice cmdlet to remove mobile device partnerships that identify the devices that are configured to synchronize with user mailboxes.
descriptions.Set-EcpVirtualDirectory: Use the Set-EcpVirtualDirectory cmdlet to modify Exchange Control Panel (ECP) virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers. The ECP virtual directory manages the Exchange admin center.
descriptions.Start-RetentionAutoTagLearning: Use the Start-RetentionAutoTagLearning cmdlet to start auto-tagging for a specified mailbox or to cross-validate auto-tagging results for the mailbox.
descriptions.Import-ExchangeCertificate: Use the Import-ExchangeCertificate cmdlet to import certificates on Exchange servers. You use this cmdlet to install certificates that were exported from other servers, and to complete pending certification requests (also known as certificate signing requests or CSRs) from certification authorities (CAs).
descriptions.Remove-ActiveSyncDeviceAccessRule: Use the Remove-ActiveSyncDeviceAccessRule cmdlet to remove any existing device access rule.
descriptions.Set-ActiveSyncDeviceAccessRule: Use the Set-ActiveSyncDeviceAccessRule cmdlet to set the level of access for the rule.
descriptions.Set-CASMailbox: Use the Set-CASMailbox cmdlet to configure client access settings on a mailbox. For example, you can configure settings for Exchange ActiveSync, Outlook, Outlook on the web, POP3, and IMAP4.
descriptions.Get-ManagementScope: Use the Get-ManagementScope cmdlet to return a list of management scopes.
descriptions.Get-RMSTemplate: Use the Get-RMSTemplate cmdlet to retrieve the current list of active rights policy templates from the Active Directory Rights Management Services (AD RMS) deployment for the organization.
descriptions.Remove-ComplianceRetentionEventType: Use the Remove-ComplianceRetentionEventType cmdlet to remove retention event types in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-OMEConfiguration: Use the Get-OMEConfiguration cmdlet to view Microsoft Purview Message Encryption configurations.
descriptions.Get-SmimeConfig: Use the Get-SmimeConfig cmdlet to view the S/MIME configuration for Outlook on the web (formerly known as Outlook Web App).
descriptions.Get-ManagedFolder: Use the Get-ManagedFolder cmdlet to retrieve the attributes of one or more managed folders.
descriptions.Disable-MailContact: Use the Disable-MailContact cmdlet to remove email capabilities from existing mail contacts.
descriptions.Get-ActiveSyncDeviceAutoblockThreshold: Use the Get-ActiveSyncDeviceAutoblockThreshold cmdlet to obtain the Autoblock settings for Microsoft Exchange ActiveSync mobile devices.
descriptions.Get-HostedContentFilterPolicy: Use the Get-HostedContentFilterPolicy cmdlet to view the settings of spam filter policies (content filter policies) in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-MoveRequest: Use the Remove-MoveRequest cmdlet to cancel a mailbox move initiated using the New-MoveRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Add-FederatedDomain: Use the Add-FederatedDomain cmdlet to configure a secondary domain with the federated organization identifier in the federation trust for the Exchange organization.
descriptions.Remove-TenantAllowBlockListSpoofItems: Use the Remove-TenantAllowBlockListSpoofItems cmdlet to remove spoofed sender entries from the Tenant Allow/Block List.
descriptions.Get-ActiveSyncDevice: Use the Get-ActiveSyncDevice cmdlet to retrieve the list of devices in your organization that have active Exchange ActiveSync partnerships.
descriptions.Export-UMPrompt: Use the Export-UMPrompt cmdlet to export an audio file being used as a greeting prompt for Unified Messaging (UM) dial plans and auto attendants.
descriptions.Remove-EdgeSubscription: Use the Remove-EdgeSubscription cmdlet to remove Edge Subscription from the Exchange organization and from the subscribed Edge Transport server.
descriptions.New-ReportSubmissionPolicy: Use the New-ReportSubmissionPolicy cmdlet to create the report submission policy in your cloud-based organization. The report submission policy controls most of the user reported message settings in the organization.
descriptions.Set-PhishSimOverridePolicy: Use the Set-PhishSimOverridePolicy cmdlet to modify non-Microsoft phishing simulation override policies that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-MailTrafficPolicyReport: Use the Get-MailTrafficPolicyReport cmdlet to view statistics about messages that were affected by data loss prevention (DLP) policies and transport rules for the last 90 days.
descriptions.Get-SiteMailboxProvisioningPolicy: Use the Get-SiteMailboxProvisioningPolicy cmdlet to view site mailbox provisioning policies.
descriptions.New-UMIPGateway: Use the New-UMIPGateway cmdlet to create a Unified Messaging (UM) IP gateway. A UM IP gateway is used to connect Unified Messaging servers to an IP gateway or a Session Initiation Protocol (SIP)-enabled IP Private Branch eXchange (PBX).
descriptions.New-UMDialPlan: Use the New-UMDialPlan cmdlet to create a Unified Messaging (UM) dial plan to establish a link between UM IP gateways, UM hunt groups, and Mailbox servers to enable communication between Unified Messaging components.
descriptions.Remove-HostedContentFilterPolicy: Use the Remove-HostedContentFilterPolicy cmdlet to remove spam filter policies (content filter policies) from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-EmailAddressPolicy: Use the Set-EmailAddressPolicy cmdlet to modify email address policies. In Exchange Online, email address policies are available only for Microsoft 365 Groups.
descriptions.Set-SafeAttachmentPolicy: Use the Set-SafeAttachmentPolicy cmdlet to modify safe attachment policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-IPv6StatusForAcceptedDomain: Use the Get-IPv6StatusForAcceptedDomain cmdlet to view the status of support for mail delivery to accepted domains in Exchange Online using IPv6.
descriptions.Get-ArcConfig: Use the Get-ArcConfig cmdlet to view the list of trusted Authenticated Received Chain (ARC) sealers that are configured in the cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-ArcConfig: Use the Set-ArcConfig cmdlet to modify the list of trusted Authenticated Received Chain (ARC) sealers that are configured in the cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-ManagementRoleAssignment: Use the Remove-ManagementRoleAssignment cmdlet to remove management role assignments.
descriptions.Remove-SensitiveInformationScan: Use the Remove-SensitiveInformationScan cmdlet to delete on-demand classification scans. You can't delete a scan if estimation or classification is in progress.
descriptions.Test-FederationTrust: Use the Test-FederationTrust cmdlet to verify that the federation trust is properly configured and functioning as expected.
descriptions.Set-FilePlanPropertyCitation: Use the Set-FilePlanPropertyCitation cmdlet to modify file plan property citations.
descriptions.Remove-MailUser: Use the Remove-MailUser cmdlet to remove existing mail users.
descriptions.Remove-RemoteMailbox: Use the Remove-RemoteMailbox cmdlet to remove a mail-enabled user in the on-premises Active Directory and the associated mailbox in the cloud-based service.
descriptions.Set-ApplicationAccessPolicy: Use the Set-ApplicationAccessPolicy cmdlet to modify the description of an application access policy.
descriptions.Get-ADSiteLink: Use the Get-ADSiteLink cmdlet to view configuration information about an Active Directory IP site link.
descriptions.Remove-IPBlockListProvider: Use the Remove-IPBlockListProvider cmdlet to remove IP Block list providers that are used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Get-AttachmentFilterEntry: Use the Get-AttachmentFilterEntry cmdlet to view the list of attachment filter entries that are used by the Attachment Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderClientPermission: Use the Get-PublicFolderClientPermission cmdlet to retrieve the user permissions for a public folder.
descriptions.Update-ExchangeHelp: Use the Update-ExchangeHelp cmdlet to find, download and install the latest available help articles for the Exchange Management Shell on the local computer. If an available version is found based your installed version and languages of Exchange, the cmdlet downloads and integrates the updated version of Help in the Exchange Management Shell. This cmdlet is a required substitute for the Update-Help cmdlet that's available in Windows PowerShell.
descriptions.Stop-MigrationUser: Use the Stop-MigrationUser cmdlet to stop the migration of a user in an existing migration batch.
descriptions.New-AddressRewriteEntry: Use the New-AddressRewriteEntry cmdlet to create an address rewrite entry that rewrites sender and recipient email addresses in messages sent to or sent from your organization through an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Remove-UserPhoto: Use the Remove-UserPhoto cmdlet to delete the photo associated with a user's account. The user photo feature allows users to associate a picture with their account. User photos appear in client applications, such as Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint.
descriptions.Remove-FilePlanPropertySubCategory: Use the Remove-FilePlanPropertySubCategory cmdlet to remove file plan property subcategories.
descriptions.Remove-CaseHoldPolicy: Use the Remove-CaseHoldPolicy cmdlet to remove case hold policies from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Delete-QuarantineMessage: Use the Delete-QuarantineMessage cmdlet to delete quarantine messages from your cloud-based organization
descriptions.Get-OrganizationRelationship: Use the Get-OrganizationRelationship cmdlet to retrieve settings for an organization relationship that is created for federated sharing with other federated Exchange organizations or for hybrid deployments with Exchange Online.
descriptions.Get-OrganizationSegment: Use the Get-OrganizationSegment cmdlet to view organization segments in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-PendingFederatedDomain: The Get-PendingFederatedDomain cmdlet is used by the Exchange admin center to display a list of pending federated domains for the federation trust for your Exchange organization. You shouldn't use this cmdlet to attempt to manually configure a federation trust.
descriptions.Remove-DlpEdmSchema: Use the Remove-DlpEdmSchema cmdlet to remove exact data match (EDM) data loss prevention (DLP) schemas from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-FeatureConfiguration: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet is currently available in Public Preview, isn't available in all organizations, and is subject to change.
descriptions.New-ManagementRole: Use the New-ManagementRole cmdlet to create a management role based on an existing role or create an unscoped management role.
descriptions.Remove-ClassificationRuleCollection: Use the Remove-ClassificationRuleCollection to remove classification rule collections from your organization.
descriptions.Set-VivaInsightsSettings: Use the Set-VivaInsightsSettings cmdlet to control user access to features in Viva Insights. Only users with provisioned Exchange Online mailboxes can access features within the Viva Insights app in Teams.
descriptions.Get-CaseHoldRule: Use the Get-CaseHoldRule to view case hold rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-AutodiscoverVirtualDirectory: Use the Remove-AutodiscoverVirtualDirectory cmdlet to remove an existing Autodiscover virtual directory from Internet Information Services (IIS).
descriptions.Get-ExchangeServer: Use the Get-ExchangeServer cmdlet to view the properties of Exchange servers.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxDatabase: Use the Remove-MailboxDatabase cmdlet to delete a mailbox database object.
descriptions.Get-ClassificationRuleCollection: Use the Get-ClassificationRuleCollection cmdlet to view the classification rule collections in your organization.
descriptions.Get-DlpDetectionsReport: Use the Get-DlpDetectionsReport cmdlet to list a summary of data loss prevention (DLP) rule matches for Exchange Online, SharePoint and OneDrive in your cloud-based organization for the last 30 days.
descriptions.Get-MailDetailATPReport: Use the Get-MailDetailATPReport cmdlet to list details about Microsoft Defender for Office 365 detections in your cloud-based organization for the last 10 days.
descriptions.Remove-RetentionCompliancePolicy: Use the Remove-RetentionCompliancePolicy cmdlet to remove retention policies from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. This cmdlet also removes the corresponding retention rule.
descriptions.Get-DkimSigningConfig: Use the Get-DkimSigningConfig cmdlet to view the DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) signing policy settings for domains in a cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-VivaOrgInsightsDelegatedRole: Use the Get-VivaOrgInsightsDelegatedRole cmdlet to view all delegates of the specified delegator. Delegate accounts can view organizational insights like the specified delegator.
descriptions.Get-ReportExecutionInstance: Use the Get-ReportExecutionInstance cmdlet to review the report execution instance in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Get-DlpKeywordDictionary: Use the Get-DlpKeywordDictionary cmdlet to view data loss prevention (DLP) keyword dictionaries in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Add-MailboxPermission: Use the Add-MailboxPermission cmdlet to add permissions to a mailbox or to an Exchange Server 2016, Exchange Server 2019, or Exchange Online mail user.
descriptions.New-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule: Use the New-HostedOutboundSpamFilterRule cmdlet to create outbound spam filter rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-MobileDeviceMailboxPolicy: Use the Get-MobileDeviceMailboxPolicy cmdlet to retrieve the Mobile Device mailbox policy settings for a specific Mobile Device mailbox policy.
descriptions.Remove-AntiPhishRule: Use the Remove-AntiPhishRule cmdlet to remove antiphish rules from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Enable-App: Use the Enable-App cmdlet to enable (turn on) a specific app for a specific user.
descriptions.Set-LabelPolicy: Use the Set-Label cmdlet to modify sensitivity label policies in your organization.
descriptions.Set-MigrationBatch: Use the Set-MigrationBatch cmdlet to update a migration request for a batch of users. For more information, see New-MigrationBatch.
descriptions.New-RoutingGroupConnector: Use the New-RoutingGroupConnector cmdlet to establish a connection between a Microsoft Exchange Server 2010 routing group and an Exchange Server 2003 routing group when the organization is running more than one version of Exchange.
descriptions.New-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy: Use the New-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy cmdlet to create audit log retention policies in the Microsoft Defender portal or the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-PowerShellVirtualDirectory: Use the Get-PowerShellVirtualDirectory cmdlet to view Windows PowerShell virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.Get-SafeAttachmentRule: Use the Get-SafeAttachmentRule cmdlet to view safe attachment rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-ContentFilterConfig: Use the Set-ContentFilterConfig cmdlet to modify the content filter configuration on a Mailbox server or an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Set-MessageClassification: Use the Set-MessageClassification cmdlet to configure an existing message classification instance in your organization.
descriptions.Export-FilePlanProperty: Use the Export-FilePlanProperty cmdlet to export file plan properties.
descriptions.Get-ManagementRoleEntry: Use the Get-ManagementRoleEntry cmdlet to retrieve management role entries that have been configured on management roles.
descriptions.Get-ClientAccessService: Use the Get-ClientAccessService cmdlet to view settings that are associated with the Client Access server role.
descriptions.Remove-OabVirtualDirectory: Use the Remove-OabVirtualDirectory cmdlet to remove offline address book (OAB) virtual directories from Internet Information Services (IIS) on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Resume-Queue: Use the Resume-Queue cmdlet to restart processing for a suspended queue on a Mailbox server or an Edge Transport server.
descriptions.Set-SensitiveInformationScanRule: Use the Set-SensitiveInformationScan cmdlet to modify sensitive information scan rules.
descriptions.Set-ExoSecOpsOverrideRule: Use the Set-ExoSecOpsOverrideRule cmdlet to modify SecOps mailbox override rules that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Remove-OrganizationRelationship: Use the Remove-OrganizationRelationship cmdlet to remove the organization relationship with an external Exchange organization.
descriptions.Set-MailboxSearch: Use the Set-MailboxSearch cmdlet to modify an existing mailbox search.
descriptions.Export-MailboxDiagnosticLogs: Use the Export-MailboxDiagnosticLogs cmdlet to export diagnostic data from user and system mailboxes in your organization.
descriptions.Remove-PhishSimOverridePolicy: Use the Remove-PhishSimOverridePolicy cmdlet to remove non-Microsoft phishing simulation override policies that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Enable-ComplianceTagStorage: Use the Enable-ComplianceTagStorage cmdlet to create the retention label policy in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. This is a one-time operation. Retention labels apply retention settings to content.
descriptions.Remove-PublicFolderAdministrativePermiss: Use the Remove-PublicFolderAdministrativePermission cmdlet to remove administrative permissions for a public folder or a public folder hierarchy.
descriptions.Remove-FilePlanPropertyDepartment: Use the Removet-FilePlanPropertyDepartment cmdlet to remove file plan property departments.
descriptions.Get-OutlookAnywhere: Use the Get-OutlookAnywhere cmdlet to view Outlook Anywhere virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.Stop-ComplianceSearch: Use the Stop-ComplianceSearch cmdlet to stop running compliance searches in Exchange Server 2016 or later and in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-ATPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Get-ATPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to view rules for Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protections in preset security policies. The rules specify recipient conditions and exceptions for the protection, and also allow you to turn on and turn off the associated preset security policies.
descriptions.Get-AuditConfig: Use the Get-AuditConfig cmdlet to view the auditing configuration in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-OnPremisesOrganization: Use the Remove-OnPremisesOrganization cmdlet to remove an OnPremisesOrganization object in a Microsoft 365 tenant.
descriptions.Set-HostedContentFilterRule: Use the Set-HostedContentFilterRule cmdlet to modify spam filter rules (content filter rules) in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-LogonStatistics: The Get-LogonStatistics cmdlet is deprecated and is no longer used.
descriptions.Get-ComplianceCase: Use the Get-ComplianceCase cmdlet to different types of compliance cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. See the CaseType parameter for a list of these case types.
descriptions.Get-RecipientFilterConfig: Use the Get-RecipientFilterConfig cmdlet to view the recipient filter configuration information for the Exchange server.
descriptions.New-AuthRedirect: Use the New-AuthRedirect cmdlet to create OAuth redirection objects that are used for legacy Microsoft Exchange 2010 Client Access servers in your organization.
descriptions.Get-DefaultTenantMyAnalyticsFeatureConfi: Use the Get-DefaultTenantMyAnalyticsFeatureConfig cmdlet to view the availability and status of Viva Insights features for the cloud-based organization: digest email, add-in, dashboard, meeting effectiveness survey, and schedule send suggestions.
descriptions.Get-UMDialPlan: Use the Get-UMDialPlan cmdlet to display the properties of a single Unified Messaging (UM) dial plan or to return a list of all UM dial plans associated with Mailbox servers running the Microsoft Exchange Unified Messaging service.
descriptions.Get-SmtpDaneInboundStatus: Use the Get-SmtpDaneInboundStatus cmdlet to view information about SMTP DNS-based Authentication of Named Entities (DANE) for inbound mail to accepted domains in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Enable-AntispamUpdates: The Enable-AntispamUpdates cmdlet was deprecated in Microsoft Exchange Server 2010 Service Pack 1 and is no longer used.
descriptions.Set-SearchDocumentFormat: Use the Set-SearchDocumentFormat cmdlet to enable or disable the file format for Exchange Search.
descriptions.New-ManagedContentSettings: Use the New-ManagedContentSettings cmdlet to create managed content settings for managed folders.
descriptions.Get-SensitiveInformationScanRule: Use the Get-SensitiveInformationScanRule cmdlet to view sensitive information scan rules.
descriptions.Set-UMServer: Use the Set-UMServer cmdlet to modify settings that are associated with the Unified Messaging (UM) server role.
descriptions.New-DlpFingerprint: Use the New-DlpFingerprint cmdlet to create document fingerprints that are used with data loss prevention (DLP) sensitive information types in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Because the results of New-DlpFingerprint aren't stored outside of the sensitive information type, you always run New-DlpFingerprint and New-DlpSensitiveInformationType or Set-DlpSensitiveInformationType in the same PowerShell session.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxRestoreRequest: Use the Remove-MailboxRestoreRequest cmdlet to remove fully or partially completed restore requests.
descriptions.Get-SpoofIntelligenceInsight: Use the Get-SpoofIntelligenceInsight cmdlet to view spoofed senders that were allowed or blocked by spoof intelligence during the last 30 days.
descriptions.Get-FilePlanPropertyAuthority: Use the Get-FilePlanPropertyAuthority cmdlet to view file plan property authorities.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxImportRequest: Use the Remove-MailboxImportRequest cmdlet to remove fully or partially completed import requests. Completed import requests aren't automatically cleared. Requests need to be removed by using the Remove-MailboxImportRequest cmdlet. Multiple import requests can exist against the same mailbox if you provide a distinct import request name.
descriptions.Move-DatabasePath: Use the Move-DatabasePath cmdlet to set a new path to the location of a database on the specified Mailbox server and to move the related files to that location.
descriptions.New-HoldCompliancePolicy: Use the New-HoldCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create new preservation policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-DeviceConfigurationPolicy: Use the Set-DeviceConfigurationPolicy cmdlet to modify mobile device configuration policies in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Remove-TenantAllowBlockListItems: Use the Remove-TenantAllowBlockListItems cmdlet to remove entries from the Tenant Allow/Block List in the Microsoft Defender portal.
descriptions.Get-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin: Use the Get-eDiscoveryCaseAdmin cmdlet to view eDiscovery Administrators in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. An eDiscovery Administrator is member of the eDiscovery Manager role group who can also view and access all eDiscovery cases in your organization.
descriptions.New-SupervisoryReviewPolicyV2: Use the New-SupervisoryReviewPolicyV2 cmdlet to create supervisory review policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Supervisory review lets you define policies that capture communications in your organization so they can be examined by internal or external reviewers.
descriptions.Test-MRSHealth: Use the Test-MRSHealth cmdlet to test the health of an instance of the Microsoft Exchange Mailbox Replication service.
descriptions.Remove-FilePlanPropertyCategory: Use the Remove-FilePlanPropertyCategory cmdlet to remove file plan property categories.
descriptions.Get-MailboxSpellingConfiguration: Use the Get-MailboxSpellingConfiguration cmdlet to retrieve the Outlook on the web spelling checker settings of a specified user. For example, users can set their dictionary language and configure the spelling checker to ignore mixed digits and words in all uppercase.
descriptions.New-PublicFolderDatabaseRepairRequest: Use the New-PublicFolderDatabaseRepairRequest cmdlet to detect and fix replication issues in the public folder database.
descriptions.Set-DlpSensitiveInformationType: Use the Set-DlpSensitiveInformationType cmdlet to modify sensitive information type rules that use document fingerprints.
descriptions.Get-DynamicDistributionGroupMember: Use the Get-DynamicDistributionGroupMember cmdlet to view the calculated membership list that's stored on dynamic distribution group objects. The results from this cmdlet are updated every 24 hours.
descriptions.Get-QueueDigest: Use the Get-QueueDigest cmdlet to view information about message delivery queues across database availability groups (DAGs) Active Directory sites, or Active Directory forests in your organization.
descriptions.Dismount-Database: Use the Dismount-Database cmdlet to dismount databases. You can run this command only if the Microsoft Exchange Information Store service is running.
descriptions.Add-IPAllowListEntry: Use the Add-IPAllowListEntry cmdlet to add IP Allow list entries to the IP Allow list that's used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Suspend-MoveRequest: Use the Suspend-MoveRequest cmdlet to suspend a move request any time after the move request was created, but before it reaches the status of CompletionInProgress. You can resume the move request by using the Resume-MoveRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Get-MailboxStatistics: Use the Get-MailboxStatistics cmdlet to return information about a mailbox, such as the size of the mailbox, the number of messages it contains, and the last time it was accessed. In addition, you can get the move history or a move report of a completed move request.
descriptions.Get-FederatedDomainProof: Use the Get-FederatedDomainProof cmdlet to generate a cryptographically secure string for the domain used for federated sharing in your Exchange organization.
descriptions.New-ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory: Use the New-ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory cmdlet to create Exchange ActiveSync virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.Set-DetailsTemplate: Use the Set-DetailsTemplate cmdlet to modify the attributes of a details template. To make changes to the details template format and layout, you need to use the Details Templates Editor in the Exchange Toolbox.
descriptions.Enable-JournalRule: Use the Enable-JournalRule cmdlet to enable an existing journal rule on a Mailbox server.
descriptions.Get-ProtectionAlert: Use the Get-ProtectionAlert cmdlet to view alert policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Update-DatabaseSchema: Use the Update-DatabaseSchema cmdlet to upgrade the database schema for one or more databases after an Exchange software update that includes database schema updates is installed on Mailbox servers in a database availability group (DAG). Some software updates for Exchange might include database schema updates. After such an update is installed on all members of a DAG, the administrator must run the Update-DatabaseSchema cmdlet for each database in the DAG and dismount/mount or failover the database to trigger the database schema update. The in-place database schema upgrade engine ensures that no schema updates occur until all members of the DAG have compatible versions of the software.
descriptions.Get-RecordReviewNotificationTemplateConf: Use the Get-RecordReviewNotificationTemplateConfig cmdlet to view the record review notification and reminder settings.
descriptions.Get-MailboxFolderStatistics: Use the Get-MailboxFolderStatistics cmdlet to retrieve information about the folders in a specified mailbox, including the number and size of items in the folder, the folder name and ID, and other information.
descriptions.Disable-ATPProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Disable-ATPProtectionPolicyRule and Disable-EOPProtectionPolicyRule cmdlets together to turn off the Standard preset security policy or the Strict preset security policy in organizations with Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
descriptions.Stop-MailboxSearch: Use the Stop-MailboxSearch cmdlet to stop a mailbox search that's in progress.
descriptions.New-MailboxExportRequest: Use the New-MailboxExportRequest cmdlet to begin the process of exporting contents of a primary mailbox or archive to a .pst file.
descriptions.Remove-DeviceTenantRule: Use the Remove-DeviceTenantRule cmdlet to remove your organization's mobile device tenant rule from Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Remove-CaseHoldRule: Use the Remove-CaseHoldRule cmdlet to remove case hold rules from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-ComplianceCase: Use the Set-ComplianceCase cmdlet to modify eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-ADSiteLink: Use the Set-ADSiteLink cmdlet to assign an Exchange-specific cost to an Active Directory IP site link. You can also use this cmdlet to configure the maximum message size that can pass across an Active Directory IP site link.
descriptions.Get-ExoInformationBarrierSegment: Use the Get-ExoInformationBarrierSegment to view information barrier segments in your Exchange Online organization.
descriptions.Set-PerimeterConfig: Use the Set-PerimeterConfig cmdlet to modify the list of gateway server IP addresses that have been added to the cloud-based safelists.
descriptions.Set-OutlookProtectionRule: Use the Set-OutlookProtectionRule cmdlet to modify an existing Microsoft Outlook protection rule.
descriptions.Dump-ProvisioningCache: Use the Dump-ProvisioningCache cmdlet to return a list of the cached keys and values for the specified server and Windows PowerShell application.
descriptions.Get-VivaModuleFeature: Use the Get-VivaModuleFeature cmdlet to view the features in a Viva module that support feature access controls. This cmdlet provides details about the features, including the feature identifiers and descriptions.
descriptions.Get-UnifiedGroupLinks: Use the Get-UnifiedGroupLinks cmdlet to view membership and ownership information for Microsoft 365 Groups in your cloud-based organization. To view other properties for Microsoft 365 Groups, use the Get-UnifiedGroup cmdlet.
descriptions.New-ActiveSyncDeviceAccessRule: Use the New-ActiveSyncDeviceAccessRule cmdlet to define the access levels for Exchange ActiveSync devices based on the identity of the device.
descriptions.Suspend-MailboxDatabaseCopy: Use the Suspend-MailboxDatabaseCopy cmdlet to block replication and replay activities (log copying and replay) or activation for a database configured with two or more database copies.
descriptions.Enable-TransportRule: Use the Enable-TransportRule cmdlet to enable transport rules (mail flow rules) in your organization.
descriptions.Set-RMSTemplate: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet is deprecated. If you use AD RMS with Exchange Online, you need to migrate to Azure Information Protection before you can use message encryption. For more information, see Verify that Azure Rights Management is active.
descriptions.Get-EXOMailboxPermission: Use the Get-EXOMailboxPermission cmdlet to retrieve permissions on a mailbox.
descriptions.New-TransportRule: Use the New-TransportRule cmdlet to create transport rules (mail flow rules) in your organization.
descriptions.Remove-SafeLinksRule: Use the Remove-SafeLinksRule cmdlet to remove Safe Links rules from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.New-DlpPolicy: Use the New-DlpPolicy cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) policies that are based on transport rules (mail flow rules) in your organization.
descriptions.Remove-RoutingGroupConnector: Use the Remove-RoutingGroupConnector cmdlet to remove a routing group connector between a Microsoft Exchange Server 2010 routing group and an Exchange Server 2003 routing group.
descriptions.Get-EmailTenantSettings: Use the Get-EmailTenantSettings cmdlet to view whether priority account protection is enabled or disabled in your Microsoft Defender for Office 365 organization. For more information about priority accounts, see Manage and monitor priority accounts.
descriptions.Set-AutodiscoverVirtualDirectory: Use the Set-AutodiscoverVirtualDirectory cmdlet to configure Autodiscover virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Get-UMIPGateway: Use the Get-UMIPGateway cmdlet to return a list of properties and values for a specified Unified Messaging (UM) IP gateway or a list of UM IP gateways.
descriptions.Get-SafeLinksPolicy: Use the Get-SafeLinksPolicy cmdlet to view Safe Links policies in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Disable-InboxRule: Use the Disable-InboxRule cmdlet to disable existing Inbox rules in mailboxes.
descriptions.Remove-SettingOverride: **Caution**: Incorrect usage of the setting override cmdlets can cause serious damage to your Exchange organization. This damage could require you to reinstall Exchange. Only use these cmdlets as instructed by product documentation or under the direction of Microsoft Customer Service and Support.
descriptions.New-InboundConnector: Use the New-InboundConnector cmdlet to create a new Inbound connector in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Disable-Mailbox: Use the Disable-Mailbox cmdlet to disable the mailbox of existing users who already have mailboxes. For this cmdlet, a user could also be a public folder mailbox or an InetOrgPerson object. The user account that's associated with the mailbox remains, but it's no longer associated with a mailbox.
descriptions.Set-OnPremisesOrganization: Use the Set-OnPremisesOrganization cmdlet to modify the parameters of the OnPremisesOrganization object on the Microsoft 365 tenant.
descriptions.Enable-UMCallAnsweringRule: Use the Enable-UMCallAnsweringRule cmdlet to enable a call answering rule that is created within a UM-enabled mailbox.
descriptions.Add-LdapDirectory: Use the Add-LdapDirectory cmdlet to create LDAP directory configurations.
descriptions.New-EcpVirtualDirectory: Use the New-EcpVirtualDirectory cmdlet to create Exchange Control Panel (ECP) virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers. This is a command that Microsoft Exchange Server Setup runs when you install Exchange in your organization. The ECP virtual directory manages the Exchange admin center.
descriptions.Set-SenderReputationConfig: Use the Set-SenderReputationConfig cmdlet to modify the sender reputation configuration on Mailbox servers or Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.New-ManagementScope: Use the New-ManagementScope cmdlet to create a regular or exclusive management scope.
descriptions.Remove-PublicFolderClientPermission: Use the Remove-PublicFolderClientPermission cmdlet to remove permissions from public folders.
descriptions.Add-AvailabilityAddressSpace: Use the Add-AvailabilityAddressSpace cmdlet to create availability address space objects that are used to share free/busy data across Exchange organizations.
descriptions.Get-MailFilterListReport: Use the Get-MailFilterListReport cmdlet to obtain values for various parameters that can be supplied to other reporting cmdlets.
descriptions.Search-MessageTrackingReport: Use the Search-MessageTrackingReport cmdlet to find the unique message tracking report based on the search criteria provided. You can then pass this message tracking report ID to the Get-MessageTrackingReport cmdlet to get full message tracking information. For more information, see Get-MessageTrackingReport. The message tracking report cmdlets are used by the delivery reports feature.
descriptions.Remove-GlobalAddressList: Use the Remove-GlobalAddressList cmdlet to remove an existing global address list (GAL).
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderItemStatistics: Use the Get-PublicFolderItemStatistics cmdlet to view information about items within a specified public folder. Information returned includes subject, last modification time, creation time, attachments, message size, and the type of item. You can use this raw information to better understand the distribution of items and item characteristics across public folders.
descriptions.Get-TransportConfig: Use the Get-TransportConfig cmdlet to view organization-wide transport configuration settings.
descriptions.Set-OwaVirtualDirectory: Use the Set-OwaVirtualDirectory cmdlet to modify existing Outlook on the web virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Get-SenderIdConfig: Use the Get-SenderIdConfig cmdlet to view the Sender ID configuration information for the Exchange server.
