descriptions.Set-WebServicesVirtualDirectory: Use the Set-WebServicesVirtualDirectory cmdlet to modify existing Exchange Web Services virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers.
descriptions.New-DynamicDistributionGroup: Use the New-DynamicDistributionGroup cmdlet to create dynamic distribution groups. A dynamic distribution group queries mail-enabled objects and builds the group membership based on the results. The group membership is recalculated whenever an email message is sent to the group.
descriptions.Set-AcceptedDomain: Use the Set-AcceptedDomain cmdlet to modify existing accepted domains in your organization. An accepted domain is any SMTP namespace for which an Exchange organization sends and receives email.
descriptions.Get-UMCallAnsweringRule: Use the Get-UMCallAnsweringRule cmdlet to view the properties of a Unified Messaging (UM) call answering rule that is created within a UM-enabled mailbox.
descriptions.Get-WorkforceInsightsDelegationAccess: Use the Get-WorkforceInsightsDelegationAccess cmdlet to view all delegates of the specified delegator. Delegate accounts can view organizational insights like the specified delegator.
descriptions.New-ComplianceRetentionEvent: Use the New-ComplianceRetentionEvent cmdlet to create compliance retention events in your organization.
descriptions.Set-MalwareFilterRule: Use the Set-MalwareFilterRule cmdlet to modify malware filter rules in your organization.
descriptions.Get-MobileDevice: Use the Get-MobileDevice cmdlet to get the list of devices in your organization that have active partnerships.
descriptions.Set-ExternalInOutlook: Use the Set-ExternalInOutlook cmdlet to modify the configuration of external sender identification that's available in Outlook, Outlook for Mac, Outlook on the web, and Outlook for iOS and Android.
descriptions.Set-MailboxRestoreRequest: Use the Set-MailboxRestoreRequest cmdlet to change restore request options after the request is created. You can use this cmdlet to recover from failed restore requests.
descriptions.New-ExoSecOpsOverrideRule: Use the New-ExoSecOpsOverrideRule cmdlet to create SecOps mailbox override rules that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.New-ClientAccessArray: Use the New-ClientAccessArray cmdlet to create an object that represents a load balanced array of Client Access servers within a single Active Directory site.
descriptions.New-FederationTrust: Use the New-FederationTrust cmdlet to set up a federation trust between your Exchange organization and the Microsoft Federation Gateway.
descriptions.Get-MailUser: Use the Get-MailUser cmdlet to view mail users and also guest users for Microsoft 365 Groups in cloud environments.
descriptions.Remove-LdapDirectory: Use the Remove-LdapDirectory cmdlet to remove LDAP directory configurations.
descriptions.Get-SweepRule: Use the Get-SweepRule cmdlet to view Sweep rules in mailboxes. Sweep rules run at regular intervals to help keep your Inbox clean.
descriptions.Test-ServicePrincipalAuthorization: Use the Test-ServicePrincipalAuthorization cmdlet to test the access granted by role-based access control (RBAC) for Applications. For more information, see Role Based Access Control for Applications in Exchange Online.
descriptions.Remove-ThrottlingPolicy: Use the Remove-ThrottlingPolicy cmdlet to remove a non-default Microsoft Exchange throttling policy.
descriptions.Get-DataRetentionReport: Use the Get-DataRetentionReport cmdlet to view information about data retention in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Test-TextExtraction: Use the Test-TextExtraction cmdlet to return the text from unencrypted email message files.
descriptions.Set-MailboxSpellingConfiguration: Use the Set-MailboxSpellingConfiguration cmdlet to modify Outlook on the web spelling checker options for a specified user. For example, you can set the dictionary language and configure the spelling checker to ignore mixed digits or words in all uppercase.
descriptions.Set-FederationTrust: Use the Set-FederationTrust cmdlet to modify an existing federation trust.
descriptions.New-EmailAddressPolicy: Use the New-EmailAddressPolicy cmdlet to create email address policies. In Exchange Online, email address policies are available only for Microsoft 365 Groups.
descriptions.Invoke-ComplianceSecurityFilterAction: Use the Invoke-ComplianceSecurityFilterAction cmdlet to view and set compliance boundaries for Microsoft OneDrive sites in cloud-based organizations.
descriptions.New-Fingerprint: Use the New-Fingerprint cmdlet to create document fingerprints that are used with data classification rules. Because the results of New-Fingerprint are not stored outside of the data classification rule, you always run New-Fingerprint and New-DataClassification or Set-DataClassification in the same PowerShell session.
descriptions.Get-DefaultTenantBriefingConfig: Use the Get-DefaultTenantBriefingConfig cmdlet to view the default Briefing email configuration in cloud-based organizations. For details about configuring the Briefing email, see Configure Briefing email.
descriptions.Remove-SharingPolicy: Use the Remove-SharingPolicy cmdlet to remove a sharing policy. Before you can remove a sharing policy, you must ensure that no mailbox users are provisioned to use that policy.
descriptions.Get-MailTrafficATPReport: Use the Get-MailTrafficATPReport cmdlet to view the results of Microsoft Defender for Office 365 detections in your cloud-based organization for the last 90 days.
descriptions.Get-MxRecordReport: Use the Get-MxRecordReport cmdlet to view information about the mail exchanger (MX) records that are configured for a specified domain.
descriptions.Get-MailboxDatabaseCopyStatus: Use the Get-MailboxDatabaseCopyStatus cmdlet to view health and status information about one or more mailbox database copies.
descriptions.New-OMEConfiguration: Use the New-OMEConfiguration cmdlet to create a Microsoft Purview Message Encryption configuration.
descriptions.New-OutlookProtectionRule: Use the New-OutlookProtectionRule cmdlet to create a Microsoft Outlook protection rule.
descriptions.Add-WorkforceInsightsDelegationAccess: Use the Add-WorkforceInsightsDelegationAccess cmdlet to add delegate access to the specified account (the delegate) so they can view organizational insights like the leader (the delegator).
descriptions.Set-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup: Use the Set-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup cmdlet to configure properties of a database availability group (DAG).
descriptions.Search-AdminAuditLog: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet has been deprecated in the cloud-based service. To access audit log data, use the Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet. For more information, see this blog post: <https://aka.ms/AdminAuditCmdletBlog>.
descriptions.Add-ContentFilterPhrase: Use the Add-ContentFilterPhrase cmdlet to define custom words for the Content Filter agent. A custom word is a word or phrase that the administrator sets for the Content Filter agent to evaluate the content of an message and apply appropriate filter processing.
descriptions.New-HybridConfiguration: Use the New-HybridConfiguration cmdlet to manually create the HybridConfiguration object and manually set up a hybrid deployment between your on-premises Exchange organization and Exchange Online in Microsoft 365 for enterprises.
descriptions.Set-DlpKeywordDictionary: Use the Set-DlpKeywordDictionary cmdlet to modify data loss prevention (DLP) keyword dictionaries in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy: Use the Remove-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy cmdlet to remove outbound spam filter policies from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-ComplianceSearch: Use the Get-ComplianceSearch cmdlet to view estimate compliance searches in Exchange Server 2016 or later and in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. After you use the New-ComplianceSearchAction cmdlet to define a preview action for the compliance search, use the Get-ComplianceSearchAction cmdlet to view the results of the compliance search.
descriptions.Get-LdapDirectory: Use the Get-LdapDirectory cmdlet to view LDAP directory configurations.
descriptions.Set-TransportConfig: Use the Set-TransportConfig cmdlet to modify the transport configuration settings for the whole Exchange organization.
descriptions.Remove-SecOpsOverridePolicy: Use the Remove-SecOpsOverridePolicy cmdlet to remove SecOps mailbox override policies that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Remove-ManagedFolder: Use the Remove-ManagedFolder cmdlet to remove a managed folder from Active Directory.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderMigrationRequest: Use the Get-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet to view information about serial public folder migration requests (requests created by the New-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet).
descriptions.Get-MessageTraceV2: Use the Get-MessageTraceV2 cmdlet to trace messages as they pass through the cloud-based organization.
descriptions.New-ComplianceTag: Use the New-ComplianceTag cmdlet to create retention labels in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Retention labels apply retention settings to content.
descriptions.Add-ResubmitRequest: Use the Add-ResubmitRequest cmdlet to add requests to replay redundant copies of messages from Safety Net after a mailbox database recovery.
descriptions.Set-ThrottlingPolicyAssociation: Use the Set-ThrottlingPolicyAssociation cmdlet to associate a throttling policy with a specific object. The object can be a user with a mailbox, a user without a mailbox, a contact, or a computer account.
descriptions.New-SafeLinksRule: Use the New-SafeLinksRule cmdlet to create Safe Links rules in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.New-FeatureConfiguration: > [!NOTE] > This cmdlet is currently available in Public Preview, isn't available in all organizations, and is subject to change.
descriptions.Set-Label: Use the Set-Label cmdlet to modify sensitivity labels in your organization.
descriptions.Get-ExoSecOpsOverrideRule: Use the Get-ExoSecOpsOverrideRule cmdlet to view SecOps mailbox override rules that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.New-ApplicationAccessPolicy: > [!IMPORTANT] > App Access Policies are replaced by Role Based Access Control for Applications. To learn more, see Role Based Access Control for Exchange Applications. Don't create new App Access Policies as these policies will eventually require migration to Role Based Access Control for Applications.
descriptions.Remove-PublicFolderMoveRequest: Use the Remove-PublicFolderMoveRequest cmdlet to cancel a mailbox move initiated using the New-MoveRequest cmdlet. After the move is finalized, you can't undo the move request.
descriptions.New-ComplianceSearchAction: Use the New-ComplianceSearchAction cmdlet to create actions for content searches in Exchange Server and in Microsoft Purview.
descriptions.Get-OutlookProvider: Use the Get-OutlookProvider cmdlet to obtain the global settings from the AutoDiscoverConfig object under the Global Settings object in Active Directory.
descriptions.Enable-OutlookProtectionRule: Use the Enable-OutlookProtectionRule cmdlet to enable an existing Outlook protection rule.
descriptions.Get-NetworkConnectionInfo: Use the Get-NetworkConnectionInfo cmdlet to view the network configuration information for all network adapters configured on the local server.
descriptions.New-ManagedFolder: Use the New-ManagedFolder cmdlet to create a managed folder object for messaging records management (MRM).
descriptions.Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy: Use the Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy cmdlet to view the properties of the audit log retention policies in the Microsoft Defender portal or the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-IPAllowListEntry: Use the Remove-IPAllowListEntry cmdlet to remove IP address entries from the IP Allow list that's used by the Connection Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Set-ActiveSyncOrganizationSettings: Use the Set-ActiveSyncOrganizationSettings cmdlet to set the Exchange ActiveSync settings for the organization.
descriptions.Remove-FederatedDomain: Use the Remove-FederatedDomain cmdlet to remove a federated domain from the federated organization identifier in the federation trust for the Exchange organization.
descriptions.Invoke-ProvisioningAcceptedDomainDiagnos: Use the Invoke-ProvisioningAcceptedDomainDiagnostic cmdlet to validate and repair accepted domain configurations in cloud-based organizations.
descriptions.Test-UMConnectivity: Use the Test-UMConnectivity cmdlet to test the operation of Unified Messaging (UM) servers.
descriptions.Set-ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory: Use the Set-ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory cmdlet to modify existing Microsoft Exchange ActiveSync virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Exchange servers.
descriptions.Add-HVEAppAccess: Use the Add-HVEAppAccess cmdlet to add applications to the Allowed Apps list of a High Volume Email (HVE) account.
descriptions.Remove-AvailabilityConfig: Use the Remove-AvailabilityConfig cmdlet to remove the availability configuration that specifies the Microsoft 365 organizations to exchange free/busy information with.
descriptions.Set-OutlookProvider: Use the Set-OutlookProvider cmdlet to set specific global settings using the msExchOutlookProvider attribute on the msExchAutoDiscoverConfig object in Active Directory.
descriptions.Get-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy: Use the Get-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy to view app retention compliance policies. App retention & labeling policies target new ways to scope and manage policies.
descriptions.Get-OutboundConnector: Use the Get-OutboundConnector cmdlet to view the configuration information for an Outbound connector in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Set-Group: Use the Set-Group cmdlet to modify group object settings. If the group is a mail-enabled security group or a distribution group, you can use the Set-DistributionGroup cmdlet to modify other Microsoft Exchange settings that aren't available by using the Set-Group cmdlet.
descriptions.Remove-AvailabilityAddressSpace: Use the Remove-AvailabilityAddressSpace cmdlet to remove existing availability address space objects and the associated credentials that were used to share free/busy data across Exchange organizations.
descriptions.Get-ServerComponentState: Use the Get-ServerComponentState cmdlet to retrieve configuration settings for Microsoft Exchange components and endpoints.
descriptions.Set-SenderIdConfig: Use the Set-SenderIdConfig cmdlet to modify the configuration of the Sender ID agent.
descriptions.Set-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration: Use the Set-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration cmdlet to configure Automatic Replies settings for a specific mailbox.
descriptions.Execute-AzureADLabelSync: Use the Execute-AzureADLabelSync cmdlet to start the synchronization of sensitivity labels into Microsoft Entra ID. This allows the application of sensitivity labels to Microsoft Teams sites, Microsoft 365 Groups, and SharePoint sites. This cmdlet is required if you were using sensitivity labels before September 2019.
descriptions.Test-EdgeSynchronization: Use the Test-EdgeSynchronization cmdlet to diagnose whether the subscribed Edge Transport servers have a current and accurate synchronization status.
descriptions.Get-TenantAllowBlockListSpoofItems: Use the Get-TenantAllowBlockListSpoofItems cmdlet to view spoofed sender entries in the Tenant Allow/Block List.
descriptions.Get-RetentionComplianceRule: Use the Get-RetentionComplianceRule to view retention rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-VivaOrgInsightsDelegatedRole: Use the Remove-VivaOrgInsightsDelegatedRole cmdlet to remove delegate access from the specified account (the delegate) so they can't view organizational insights like the leader (the delegator).
descriptions.Get-DeviceConditionalAccessPolicy: Use the Get-DeviceConditionalAccessPolicy cmdlet to view mobile device conditional access policies in Basic Mobility and Security in Microsoft 365.
descriptions.Remove-DlpKeywordDictionary: Use the Remove-DlpKeywordDictionary cmdlet to remove data loss prevention (DLP) keyword dictionaries from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-PublicFolderMoveRequestStatistics: Use the Get-PublicFolderMoveRequestStatistics cmdlet to view detailed information about public folder move requests.
descriptions.Add-RecipientPermission: Use the Add-RecipientPermission cmdlet to add SendAs permission to users in a cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Test-PopConnectivity: Use the Test-PopConnectivity cmdlet to verify that the Microsoft Exchange POP3 service is working as expected.
descriptions.Get-UnifiedGroup: Use the Get-UnifiedGroup cmdlet to view Microsoft 365 Groups in your cloud-based organization. To view members, owners and subscribers for Microsoft 365 Groups, use the Get-UnifiedGroupLinks cmdlet.
descriptions.New-MobileDeviceMailboxPolicy: Use the New-MobileDeviceMailboxPolicy cmdlet to create mobile device mailbox policies.
descriptions.Set-Mailbox: Use the Set-Mailbox cmdlet to modify the settings of existing mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-MailboxPlan: Use the Get-MailboxPlan cmdlet to view information about mailbox plans in the cloud-based service.
descriptions.Get-MailboxDatabase: Use the Get-MailboxDatabase cmdlet to retrieve one or more mailbox database objects from a server or organization.
descriptions.Set-ImapSettings: Use the Set-ImapSettings cmdlet to modify the settings of the Microsoft Exchange IMAP4 service on Exchange servers. This service exists on Exchange servers that have the Client Access server role installed, and is used by IMAP4 clients to connect to Exchange.
descriptions.Remove-DeliveryAgentConnector: The Remove-DeliveryAgentConnector cmdlet removes a specific delivery agent connector configured in your organization.
descriptions.Enable-PushNotificationProxy: Use the Enable-PushNotificationProxy cmdlet to enable a push notification proxy between an on-premises Microsoft Exchange organization and a Microsoft 365 organization.
descriptions.Update-RoleGroupMember: Use the Update-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to modify the members of a management role group.
descriptions.Get-PartnerApplication: Use the Get-PartnerApplication cmdlet to retrieve settings for a partner application.
descriptions.Set-ServicePrincipal: Use the Set-ServicePrincipal cmdlet to change service principals in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Get-X400AuthoritativeDomain: Use the Get-X400AuthoritativeDomain cmdlet to view the configuration information for the X.400 authoritative domains configured in your organization. For more information about how to configure an X.400 authoritative domain, see Set-X400AuthoritativeDomain.
descriptions.Get-MailboxSentItemsConfiguration: Use the Get-MailboxSentItemsConfiguration cmdlet to view the Sent Items settings on mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-DistributionGroupMember: Use the Get-DistributionGroupMember cmdlet to view the members of distribution groups and mail-enabled security groups.
descriptions.Enable-MailUser: Use the Enable-MailUser cmdlet to mail-enable existing users that aren't already mail-enabled.
descriptions.Get-CASMailboxPlan: Use the Get-CASMailboxPlan cmdlet to view Client Access services (CAS) mailbox plans in cloud-based organizations.
descriptions.Suspend-PublicFolderMailboxMigrationRequ: Use the Suspend-PublicFolderMailboxMigrationRequest cmdlet to suspend individual jobs in public folder migration batches that were created by using the New-MigrationBatch cmdlet.
descriptions.Set-DlpPolicy: Use the Set-DlpPolicy cmdlet to modify data loss prevention (DLP) policies that are based on transport rules (mail flow rules) in your organization.
descriptions.Get-DlpCompliancePolicy: Use the Get-DlpCompliancePolicy to view data loss prevention (DLP) policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-TransportService: Use the Get-TransportService cmdlet to view the settings of the Transport service on Exchange 2013 or later Mailbox servers or Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Get-MailTrafficEncryptionReport: Use the Get-MailTrafficEncryptionReport cmdlet to view the results of encryption in your cloud-based organization for the last 92 days.
descriptions.Get-DlpSensitiveInformationTypeRulePacka: Use the Get-DlpSensitiveInformationTypeRulePackage cmdlet to view data loss prevention (DLP) sensitive information type rule packages in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-RpcClientAccess: Use the Set-RpcClientAccess cmdlet to modify the settings of the Microsoft Exchange RPC Client Access service on Exchange servers that have the Client Access server role installed. These settings affect Outlook clients that connect by using Outlook Anywhere (RPC over HTTP).
descriptions.Connect-ExchangeOnline: Use the Connect-ExchangeOnline cmdlet in the Exchange Online PowerShell module to use modern authentication to connect to Exchange Online PowerShell or PowerShell for the Built-in security add-on for on-premises mailboxes. This cmdlet works for accounts with or without multi-factor authentication (MFA).
descriptions.Set-AvailabilityConfig: Use the Set-AvailabilityConfig cmdlet to set the access level for free/busy information.
descriptions.Get-ADPermission: Use the Get-ADPermission cmdlet to get permissions on an Active Directory object.
descriptions.Get-ManagementRole: Use the Get-ManagementRole cmdlet to view management roles that have been created in your organization.
descriptions.Get-Label: Use the Get-Label cmdlet to view sensitivity labels in your organization.
descriptions.Get-RegulatoryComplianceUI: Use the Get-RegulatoryComplianceUI cmdlet to view the status of the regulatory compliance UI in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal (whether the preservation lock checkbox is displayed for retention policies and the immutable label checkbox is displayed for retention labels).
descriptions.Update-OfflineAddressBook: Use the Update-OfflineAddressBook cmdlet to update the offline address books (OABs) used by Microsoft Outlook clients.
descriptions.New-ATPBuiltInProtectionRule: Use the New-ATPBuiltInProtectionRule cmdlet to create the rule for the Built-in protection preset security policy that effectively provides default policies for Safe Links and Safe Attachments in Microsoft Defender for Office 365. The rule specifies exceptions to the policy.
descriptions.Test-ReplicationHealth: Use the Test-ReplicationHealth cmdlet to check all aspects of replication and replay, or to provide status for a specific Mailbox server in a database availability group (DAG).
descriptions.Release-QuarantineMessage: Use the Release-QuarantineMessage cmdlet to release messages from quarantine in your cloud-based organization. You can release messages to all original recipients, or to specific recipients.
descriptions.New-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicy: Use the New-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicy cmdlet to create a new Microsoft 365 data-at-rest encryption policy.
descriptions.Resume-PublicFolderMoveRequest: Use the Resume-PublicFolderMoveRequest cmdlet to resume a public folder move request that is suspended or has failed.
descriptions.Get-MyAnalyticsFeatureConfig: Use the Get-MyAnalyticsFeatureConfig cmdlet to view the availability and feature status of MyAnalytics for the specified user.
descriptions.Disable-UMAutoAttendant: Use the Disable-UMAutoAttendant cmdlet to disable an existing Unified Messaging (UM) auto attendant that's enabled.
descriptions.Disable-CmdletExtensionAgent: Use the Disable-CmdletExtensionAgent cmdlet to disable existing cmdlet extension agents.
descriptions.Set-TransportAgent: Use the Set-TransportAgent cmdlet to modify existing transport agents.
descriptions.New-DlpComplianceRule: Use the New-DlpComplianceRule to create data loss prevention (DLP) rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. DLP rules define sensitive information to be protected and the actions to take on rule matches.
descriptions.Get-SupervisoryReviewPolicyReport: Use the Get-SupervisoryReviewPolicyReport cmdlet to view supervisory review policy events in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy: Use the Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy cmdlet to modify auto-labeling policies in your organization.
descriptions.Get-EXORecipient: Use the Get-EXORecipient cmdlet to view existing recipient objects in your organization. This cmdlet returns all mail-enabled objects (for example, mailboxes, mail users, mail contacts, and distribution groups).
descriptions.Set-SecOpsOverridePolicy: Use the Set-SecOpsOverridePolicy cmdlet to modify SecOps mailbox override policies that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Invoke-HoldRemovalAction: Use the Invoke-HoldRemovalAction cmdlet to view and remove holds on mailboxes and SharePoint sites. You can also see holds that were previously removed by using this cmdlet.
descriptions.Remove-SafeLinksPolicy: Use the Remove-SafeLinksPolicy cmdlet to remove Safe Links policies from your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.Remove-FilePlanPropertyCitation: Use the Remove-FilePlanPropertyCitation cmdlet to remove file plan property citations.
descriptions.Set-ReportSubmissionPolicy: Use the Set-ReportSubmissionPolicy cmdlet to modify the report submission policy in your cloud-based organization.
descriptions.New-OrganizationSegment: Use the New-OrganizationSegment cmdlet to create organization segments for use with information barrier policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Organization Segments are not in effect until you apply information barrier policies.
descriptions.Get-ImapSettings: Use the Get-ImapSettings cmdlet to view the settings of the Microsoft Exchange IMAP4 service on Exchange servers. This is the client access (frontend) IMAP4 service that clients connect to.
descriptions.Test-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicy: Use the Test-M365DataAtRestEncryptionPolicy cmdlet to test an existing Microsoft 365 data-at-rest encryption policy.
descriptions.Set-SupervisoryReviewRule: Use the Set-SupervisoryReviewRule cmdlet to modify supervisory review rules in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Search-Mailbox: Use the Search-Mailbox cmdlet to search a mailbox and copy the results to a specified target mailbox, delete messages from the source mailbox, or both.
descriptions.Get-PolicyConfig: Use the Get-PolicyConfig cmdlet to view the endpoint restrictions that are configured in the organization.
descriptions.Set-ActiveSyncDeviceAutoblockThreshold: Use the Set-ActiveSyncDeviceAutoblockThreshold cmdlet to change settings for autoblocking mobile devices.
descriptions.Start-ComplianceSearch: Use the Start-ComplianceSearch cmdlet to start stopped, completed or not started compliance searches in Exchange Server 2016 or later and in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.New-SiteMailboxProvisioningPolicy: Use the New-SiteMailboxProvisioningPolicy cmdlet to create provisioning policies for site mailboxes.
descriptions.Get-EXOMailboxFolderStatistics: Use the Get-EXOMailboxFolderStatistics cmdlet to retrieve information about the folders in a specified mailbox, including the number and size of items in the folder, the folder name and ID, and other information.
descriptions.New-AvailabilityConfig: Use the New-AvailabilityConfig cmdlet to create the availability configuration that specifies the Microsoft 365 organizations to exchange free/busy information with.
descriptions.Test-IRMConfiguration: Use the Test-IRMConfiguration cmdlet to test Information Rights Management (IRM) configuration and functionality.
descriptions.Stop-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup: Use the Stop-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup cmdlet to mark a member of a database availability group (DAG) as failed, or to mark all DAG members in a specific Active Directory site as failed.
descriptions.Set-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy: Use the Set-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy cmdlet to modify audit log retention policies in the Microsoft Defender portal or the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Get-HVEAccountSettings: Use the Get-HVEAccountSettings cmdlet to view the account settings of a High Volume Email (HVE) account.
descriptions.New-RetentionPolicyTag: Use the New-RetentionPolicyTag cmdlet to create a retention tag.
descriptions.Start-MigrationUser: Use the Start-MigrationUser cmdlet to start the migration of a user in an existing migration batch.
descriptions.Get-MoveRequest: Use the Get-MoveRequest cmdlet to view the detailed status of an ongoing asynchronous mailbox move that was initiated by using the New-MoveRequest cmdlet.
descriptions.Remove-SensitiveInformationScanRule: Use the Remove-SensitiveInformationScanRule cmdlet to delete on-demand classification scan rules. You can't delete a rule when a parent scan is in the ClassificationInProgress or ClassificationComplete state.
descriptions.Disable-UMCallAnsweringRule: Use the Disable-UMCallAnsweringRule cmdlet to disable a call answering rule that is created within a UM-enabled mailbox.
descriptions.Get-ConnectionInformation: Use the Get-ConnectionInformation cmdlet to get information about all REST-based connections in the current PowerShell instance with Exchange Online.
descriptions.Get-MapiVirtualDirectory: Use the Get-MapiVirtualDirectory cmdlet to view Message Application Programming Interface (MAPI) virtual directories that are used in Internet Information Services (IIS) on Microsoft Exchange servers. A MAPI virtual directory is used by supported versions of Microsoft Outlook to connect to mailboxes by using the MAPIHTTP protocol.
descriptions.Set-ATPBuiltInProtectionRule: Use the Set-ATPBuiltInProtectionRule cmdlet to modify the rule for the Built-in protection preset security policy that effectively provides default policies for Safe Links and Safe Attachments in Microsoft Defender for Office 365. The rule specifies exceptions to the policy.
descriptions.Disable-OutlookAnywhere: Use the Disable-OutlookAnywhere cmdlet to disable Outlook Anywhere on Exchange Server 2010 Client Access servers.
descriptions.Test-OAuthConnectivity: Use the Test-OAuthConnectivity cmdlet to test OAuth authentication to partner applications for a user.
descriptions.Get-AttachmentFilterListConfig: Use the Get-AttachmentFilterListConfig cmdlet to view the configuration of the Attachment Filtering agent on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Remove-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup: Use the Remove-DatabaseAvailabilityGroup cmdlet to delete an empty database availability group (DAG). Before you can delete a DAG, you must first remove all Mailbox servers from the DAG.
descriptions.Remove-AddressList: Use the Remove-AddressList cmdlet to remove existing address lists.
descriptions.Set-AuthRedirect: Use the Set-AuthRedirect cmdlet to modify the existing OAuth redirection settings for Microsoft Exchange 2010 Client Access servers in your Microsoft Exchange 2013 organization.
descriptions.Disable-UMServer: Use the Disable-UMServer cmdlet to set the status of an Exchange Server 2010 Unified Messaging (UM) server to disabled. This prevents the Unified Messaging server from processing UM calls.
descriptions.New-MalwareFilterRule: Use the New-MalwareFilterRule cmdlet to create malware filter rules in your organization.
descriptions.Set-MyAnalyticsFeatureConfig: Use the Set-MyAnalyticsFeatureConfig cmdlet to configure the availability and features of MyAnalytics for the specified user.
descriptions.Get-HVEAccountBillingPolicy: Use the Get-HVEAccountBillingPolicy cmdlet to view the billing policy mapping for a specified High Volume Email (HVE) account.
descriptions.Get-RetentionEvent: Use the Get-RetentionEvent cmdlet to view retention events in your organization.
descriptions.Get-QuarantineMessageHeader: Use the Get-QuarantineMessageHeader cmdlet to view the message header of a quarantined message. The command fails if the specified message is not in quarantine.
descriptions.Test-Mailflow: Use the Test-Mailflow cmdlet to diagnose whether mail can be successfully sent from and delivered to the system mailbox on a Mailbox server. You can also use this cmdlet to verify that email is sent between Mailbox servers within a defined latency threshold.
descriptions.Import-UMPrompt: Use the Import-UMPrompt cmdlet to copy or upload a custom audio file to be used by Unified Messaging (UM) dial plans and auto attendants.
descriptions.New-PhishSimOverridePolicy: Use the New-PhishSimOverridePolicy cmdlet to create non-Microsoft phishing simulation override policies that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Set-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy: Use the Set-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy to modify app retention compliance policies.
descriptions.Get-RetentionPolicy: Use the Get-RetentionPolicy cmdlet to retrieve the settings for retention policies.
descriptions.Get-SenderReputationConfig: Use the Get-SenderReputationConfig cmdlet to view the configuration information for sender reputation on the computer on which the command is run.
descriptions.Set-SystemMessage: Use the Set-SystemMessage cmdlet to modify custom system messages. System messages are delivery status notifications (also known as DSNs, non-delivery reports, NDRs or bounce messages) and quota messages.
descriptions.New-SystemMessage: Use the New-SystemMessage cmdlet to create custom system messages. System messages are delivery status notifications (also known as DSNs, non-delivery reports, NDRs or bounce messages) and quota messages.
descriptions.Set-TeamsProtectionPolicyRule: Use the Set-TeamsProtectionPolicyRule cmdlet to modify Microsoft Teams protection policy rules.
descriptions.Get-OutboundConnectorReport: Use the Get-OutboundConnectorReport cmdlet to view the Outbound connectors that are used to deliver mail to specific domains.
descriptions.Get-ExoPhishSimOverrideRule: Use the Get-ExoPhishSimOverrideRule cmdlet to view non-Microsoft phishing simulation override rules that bypass filtering. For more information, see Configure the advanced delivery policy for non-Microsoft phishing simulations and email delivery to SecOps mailboxes.
descriptions.Update-PublicFolderMailbox: Use the Update-PublicFolderMailbox cmdlet to update the hierarchy for public folders.
descriptions.Remove-FilePlanPropertyAuthority: Use the Remove-FilePlanPropertyAuthority cmdlet to remove file plan property authorities.
descriptions.Get-ComplianceCaseMember: Use the Get-ComplianceCaseMember cmdlet to view the members of eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Test-SiteMailbox: Use the Test-SiteMailbox cmdlet to test the site mailbox to Microsoft SharePoint connectivity and to test whether users have the correct permissions to use a site mailbox. This cmdlet should be used for troubleshooting and diagnostic purposes.
descriptions.Remove-MigrationBatch: Use the Remove-MigrationBatch cmdlet to delete a migration batch that either isn't running or is completed. If necessary, you can run the Get-MigrationBatch cmdlet to determine the status of a migration batch before you remove it.
descriptions.Get-MigrationUserStatistics: Use the Get-MigrationUserStatistics cmdlet to view detailed information about the migration requested for a specific user.
descriptions.New-UMCallAnsweringRule: Use the New-UMCallAnsweringRule cmdlet to create a call answering rule.
descriptions.Test-IPAllowListProvider: Use the Test-IPAllowListProvider cmdlet to test IP Allow list providers on Edge Transport servers.
descriptions.Set-GlobalAddressList: Use the Set-GlobalAddressList cmdlet to modify an existing global address list (GAL).
descriptions.Enable-AddressListPaging: Use the Enable-AddressListPaging cmdlet to enable Active Directory virtual list view for address lists. Virtual list view allows you to display the address lists in your organization as pages instead of loading and viewing the entire directory.
descriptions.Resume-PublicFolderReplication: Use the Resume-PublicFolderReplication cmdlet to resume public folder content replication when it's been stopped.
descriptions.Get-MigrationEndpoint: Use the Get-MigrationEndpoint cmdlet to retrieve migration endpoint settings for source or destination servers for cutover or staged Exchange migrations, IMAP migrations, and remote moves.
descriptions.Resume-MailboxRestoreRequest: Use the Resume-MailboxRestoreRequest cmdlet to resume a restore request that was suspended or failed.
descriptions.New-MailMessage: Use the New-MailMessage cmdlet to create an email message for the specified user mailbox and place the email message in the Drafts folder of the user's mailbox.
descriptions.Set-CaseHoldPolicy: Use the Set-CaseHoldPolicy cmdlet to modify existing case hold policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
descriptions.Remove-UMHuntGroup: Use the Remove-UMHuntGroup cmdlet to remove and delete an existing Unified Messaging (UM) hunt group.
descriptions.Set-MailContact: Use the Set-MailContact cmdlet to modify existing mail contacts.
descriptions.Check-PurviewConfig: Use the Check-PurviewConfig cmdlet to validate and review your organization's configuration settings in Microsoft Purview.
descriptions.New-PublicFolderMigrationRequest: Use the New-PublicFolderMigrationRequest cmdlet to start a serial public folder migration from Exchange Server 2010.
descriptions.Clean-MailboxDatabase: Use the Clean-MailboxDatabase cmdlet to scan Active Directory for disconnected mailboxes that aren't yet marked as disconnected in the Microsoft Exchange store and update the status of those mailboxes in the Exchange store. This cmdlet isn't able to update the Exchange store unless the Microsoft Exchange Information Store service is running and the database is mounted.
descriptions.Disable-JournalRule: Use the Disable-JournalRule cmdlet to disable a journal rule on a Mailbox server.
descriptions.Get-SenderFilterConfig: Use the Get-SenderFilterConfig cmdlet to view the Sender Filter configuration information for the Exchange server.
descriptions.Set-ComplianceSearchAction: Use the Set-ComplianceSearchAction cmdlet to change the export key on export compliance search actions in on-premises Exchange.
descriptions.Resume-MailboxExportRequest: Use the Resume-MailboxExportRequest cmdlet to resume an export request that was suspended or failed.
descriptions.Remove-MailboxExportRequest: Use the Remove-MailboxExportRequest cmdlet to remove fully or partially completed export requests. You can create multiple export requests for a specified mailbox provided that you specify a distinct name. Completed export requests aren't cleared automatically; they need to be removed by using this cmdlet.
